maps.title: SB Canto 11 · Class 31 · A Devotee Never Burns Out: Here's Why!

nodeData.topic: Class 31 · A Devotee Never Burns Out: Here's Why!
nodeData.note: SB 11.2.42 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Using the verse's image of a hungry person eating, Maharaj shows that devotion, direct experience of Krishna and detachment grow together and are real, tangible experiences, not fiction. Natural detachment means using everything for Krishna, since nothing is ours to renounce, so a devotee is free, nourished and satisfied and cannot burn out. Peace comes only to one who stops obeying the senses. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The verse uses the image of a hungry person eating to show three fruits of surrender growing together: devotion, direct experience of the Lord, and detachment from everything else.

children.topic: The nine Yogendras speak to Nimi
children.note:
Maharaj introduces the setting: King Nimi meets the nine Yogendras, sages who answer his questions on devotional service.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:29 (auto-transcript): “Mahajni meet the nine agendas. This is the text of my book. Chayisa, Chayisa, Tinka, Eka Kala, Eka Kala, Prabha Dhyamana Shya, Prabha Dhyamana Shya, Yathas Nota, Yathas Nota, Shush,”

After the reading Maharaj asks whether the devotees enjoyed it — this is nectar. He speaks of two ways of eating: with hunger and without it.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:24 (auto-transcript): “Did you enjoy it? Did you enjoy it? Did you enjoy it? This is nectar. This is nectar. Two ways to eat. To eat. You can eat. You can eat. The second way to eat. And that really goes for you, for what you eat, for what you eat, for what you eat, for what you eat, for what you eat.”

When you are not hungry no food tastes good; when you are very hungry, even plain food is delicious. Without hunger, the same plate seems unfit even for animals.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:25 (auto-transcript): “This is true, this is true, you know, when you don't have food, no food is delicious. Is it not? Yes. Is it not? Yes. But when you are hungry, it is when you are so hungry.”

children.topic: The advancing devotee can't stop eating
children.note:
Similarly, for those advancing in Krishna consciousness, the meal of devotional service tastes like nectar and they cannot stop.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:33 (auto-transcript): “Those who are making advancement in Krishna consciousness. Aqueles que estavam fazendo um avalço da consciência de fecha, o mal também é saboroso. É muito bom. Nectaria. E um não pode parar de comer. E aí, uma pessoa que nós não conseguimos parar de comer. Você diz, We are ready.”

Krishna, bhakti and the experience they bring are not from this world; they came from the spiritual world and are a tangible substance you can perceive.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:25 (auto-transcript): “There are three things. Bhagavad Gita. Bhagavad Gita. Bhakti. Bhakti. Bhakti. Three. They are not in this world. They came from the spiritual world. They are real. They are tangible. Tangible substance. It is a tangible substance. So you can feel it. I can feel it. So, for…”

Maharaj feels what he is doing even as he speaks into the microphone, and asks devotees to feel what they practise too. It is not fiction. — “You should feel it.”

🎙 Maharaj at 43:08 (auto-transcript): “So, you also have to feel what is that you are practicing. You should feel it. You have to feel it. Not fiction. Bhakti. Krishna. Bhakti. Bhakti. Bhakti. Not fiction. Not fiction. So here is devotion. So the devotion will bring us the vision of the supernatural. So, the…”

Devotion gives direct perception of Krishna as the natural result of one's practice.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:39 (auto-transcript): “So the devotion will bring us the vision of the supernatural. So, the bhakti, the emotion, will give you a direct perception, direct, direct, and it will be the result of your practice. So, the result of your practice is going to show Krishna directly. the moon, and how much,…”

Maharaj contrasts two words the acaryas explain carefully: detachment and renunciation. The verse speaks of natural detachment, not renunciation.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:53 (auto-transcript): “see two words our acharya have explained it beautifully Did you hear my mind? Did you hear my mind? Did you hear my mind? A big distinction between relative statement and realization. Did you see it? Distinction is not mentioned, the detachment is mentioned.”

There is a big difference between a theoretical statement and realisation; the detachment in this verse comes from experience.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:14 (auto-transcript): “A big distinction between relative statement and realization. Did you see it? Distinction is not mentioned, the detachment is mentioned. So, devotion to Krishna,”

To renounce something you must first own it. Everything, including our body, belongs to Krishna — so what do we have to renounce? Giving things up when they could be used in Krishna consciousness is not approved.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:26 (auto-transcript): “First of all, if you want to renunciar a something, you have to be the one, you have to be the one. You have to do something. You have to do something. But if you don't have anything, how do you renunciar a something? Everything. Everything, including our body, that pertence…”

Perfect renunciation is using everything in Krishna's service, giving nothing up.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:18 (auto-transcript): “Use everything. Use everything. Everything. When I say everything. For the nation. For the nation. That is a problem. Because it's perfect. Pure nation. So we use everything in the service of Christ. That is the question. No giving of anything. That's not a negotiation.…”

Maharaj appears to recount Maya-devi coming to tempt a devotee who stayed absorbed in hearing and chanting about Krishna; after three days she herself was changed.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:43 (auto-transcript): “tomo se volou depois de 3 dias somente 3 dias raridaz mudou and maya confess maya confess maya raridaz maya raridaz you”

children.topic: There is no problem for devotees
children.note:
Why do devotees have no problem? They never separate Krishna's energy from Krishna. — “There is no problem for devotees.”

🎙 Maharaj at 53:56 (auto-transcript): “What's the problem? There is no problem for devotees. No devotees. Why? They separate Christa's energy from Krishna. They don't have a problem. Few devotees. They don't suppress Krishna from this energy. They use Krishna's energy. So, not separated from Krishna. Utilize the…”

children.topic: Using Krishna's energy, they are free
children.note:
Pure devotees do not suppress Krishna's energy or keep it apart from him; they use it to serve Krishna, and so they are completely free.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:20 (auto-transcript): “Few devotees. They don't suppress Krishna from this energy. They use Krishna's energy. So, not separated from Krishna. Utilize the energy of Krishna and serve Krishna. So, the devotees are free. They are completely free. They are completely free. So, here, they are free. For…”

Following Jiva Gosvami, Maharaj walks through what happens to someone eating: satisfaction, nourishment and less hunger with every bite.

🎙 Maharaj at 55:02 (auto-transcript): “What is it? Tushy. Tushy. Tushy. Satisfy. Satisfy. Satisfy. Tushy. Satisfy. Satisfy. So there's a... What is the first appearance that a person is engaged in the world? Tushy. Tushy. Satisfy. Satisfy. Satisfy. Satisfy. Nutrição, a pessoa se está nutrindo, para quem está…”

As one eats or drinks, the hunger and thirst go down; that is natural for one who is eating, and the same happens in devotional life.

🎙 Maharaj at 55:44 (auto-transcript): “What happened? The taste of hunger goes down. If I drink water, the more you drink, The taste goes down. The hunger goes down. Why? Because that is meaningless. Why? Because that is meaningless. This is natural. For one who is eating.”

Jiva Gosvami pairs each result of devotion with a result of eating. Bhakti is paired with satisfaction because both take the form of pleasure. — “This is Bhakti mathematics.”

🎙 Maharaj at 57:33 (auto-transcript): “Shri Matipakushone has explained this analogy. Bhakti, or devotion, can we compare to Tushi and Satipastas? He's pairing them. This is Bhakti mathematics. He's pairing them. Bhakti is compared to trusty satisfaction. Why?”

One who practises pure bhakti cannot become depressed or burn out; Maharaj asks the translator for the Portuguese word for burnout, and says that is Krishna consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 58:25 (auto-transcript): “One cannot Una persona no puede practicar pure bhakti bhakti puro y ficar así depresivo no puede morrer mozo nunca no no es posible o de nuevo no puede ficar morrer mozo tempato In English, it is born, born out, born in.”

Experience of the Lord is paired with nourishment because both sustain life. Devotees become fresh, and someone once remarked on a devotee's glow — it comes not from food but from being happy in Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 60:37 (auto-transcript): “so yes, what happens become fresh if you become fresh if you become fresh you become fresh because you are nutrition in your body yes, indeed one devotee told me one devotee told me it's the sign because I don't see it I don't see it I don't see it it's the sign even though…”

Relief from hunger is paired with peace, since both free one from other longings. Whoever wants peace in this world must stop running after the senses.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:54 (auto-transcript): “Finally, the judgment ensured by cessation of hunger. may be compelled because both free one from other handkerchief so that when my experience I'm here if one wants to be peaceful in this world forget to submit A person who is not disturbed by the insensate flow of desires”
Maharaj reads the Gita verse on the ocean that stays steady while rivers flow in, the picture of a person undisturbed by desires.

children.topic: The attendant who answers every bell
children.note:
A shop assistant or flight attendant must answer every customer who presses the button — a drink, a coffee, something sweet, something to chew. One who always responds to the senses' demands like that can never be peaceful.

🎙 Maharaj at 66:26 (auto-transcript): “I'm going to show you another example. Shop boy. Shop boy. Shop girl. Shop. Supermarket. Store. If, for example, a lochista. Shop girl. Yeah, a job boy. Yes, a job boy. He's treating the feminine as a masculine. Or like in the plane. Or, for example, if you're in a plane.…”

Only one who disobeys the senses becomes peaceful. — “That is the secret of success.”

🎙 Maharaj at 68:34 (auto-transcript): “Disoper the senses. Disoper the senses. Disoper the senses. Is it not? That is the secret of success. Read it. Read it. You know, the mantra”

At weddings and birth ceremonies people chant 'shanti, shanti' — but do they get peace? As long as one keeps wanting something, there is no shanti.

🎙 Maharaj at 69:29 (auto-transcript): “When I'm doing wedding. Do you know when I'm at the ceremony of the nascimento? Do you know when I'm at the ceremony? Shanti, shanti. Shanti, shanti. Do you get shanti? Do you get shanti? Do you get shanti? Do you get shanti? I can't say. He's always a sacrifice. Shanti,…”

nodeData.topic: Class 29 · No Prema for Offenders
nodeData.note: SB 11.17.55 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Aparadha — offence — is what blocks the taste of the holy name and the mercy of Radharani, and only the offender can undo it. Maharaj works through the hellish misconceptions of seeing the deity as wood or stone and devotees as ordinary people, with Sacimata, Durvasa, Bhima and Kichaka, and several deity stories. In the Q&A he separates offence from sin and explains why seniority is measured by purity, not years. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The day's reading lists the mistakes of taking the deity, the guru, the Vaishnava and sacred water to be ordinary, and says where such thinking places a person.

Maharaj frames the class around offences: against Vaishnavas, in service, to the holy dhama, to the holy name, to prasadam, and even against other living beings. A devotee has to be very careful.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:21 (auto-transcript): “So, we are looking at offenses. And they are varieties of offenses. Vaishnava Aparad Seva Aparad Dham Aparad Naam Aparad Prasad Aparad Prashad ke pati apraad, Jeeva apraad, Jeevon ke pati Jeeva apraad, Yes, Jeeva apraad, Haan, Jeeva apraad bhi hota hai,”

He takes the word apart: apa means given up or denied, so aparadha means no Radharani, and no Radharani means no Krishna. — “So, Aparadha means no Radharani.”

🎙 Maharaj at 15:42 (auto-transcript): “APA RADH There are two words joined together APA RADH APA means Give up Throw away Denied Of what? So, Aparadha means no Radharani. No Radharani means no Krishna.”

Only Krishna lifted Govardhan, yet Rupa Gosvami writes that Srimati Radharani lifted Krishna together with the hill. Krishna is in her hand; that is why we say Radha-Krishna, and we approach her to reach him. — “To get Krishna, we have to approach Radha Rani.”

🎙 Maharaj at 18:18 (auto-transcript): “Rizharupa Goswami said, He was ordered to write this book by Lord Shiva. So in this book, Sri Rupa Goswami wrote that Sirmati Radharani He lifted Krishna along with the Govardhan hill. Who is superior?”

Caitanya Mahaprabhu says that if tears, hair standing on end and a faltering voice do not come while chanting, the cause is aparadha. Maharaj presses the room for the answer until they say it.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:38 (auto-transcript): “Right, Chaitanya Chaitanya Chaitanya Maita mentioned, if one is chanting Hare Krishna, the tears is not coming, the hair is not standing on end, our voice is not faltering. The body does not move. What is the cause? What is it?”

Bhaktivinoda Thakura sings that when offences are removed the pure taste for the name appears. Our acaryas have given and shown everything clearly; there is nothing to argue about.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:13 (auto-transcript): “Aparad nahin hona chiyye taw aisa hooga Shri La Bhakti Unawa Thakur ji Parada gucchi naam Shuddha Ruchi Shri La Bhakti Unawa Thakur ji ek geet mein bolte hain Aparada gucchi naam Ruchi Shuddha Naam Ruchi Is it not? Hai ki nahin? This is Bhakti Unawa Thakur ka I will get the…”

children.topic: Blasphemy: the surest way to hell
children.note:
Maharaj recalls Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati Thakura's stark remark that blaspheming Vaishnavas is the sure road to hell — there is no way around it.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:34 (auto-transcript): “Shaila Bhakti Siddhanta Sarafati Thakur Goswami Maharaj Prabhupada He said It is very good that they are blaspheming Vaishnavas because that is the surest way to hell Sure way, that is sure, you cannot circumvent it. It's Bhakti Siddhanta Siddhanta Siddhanta.”

children.topic: Even Sacimata had to clear it
children.note:
Mahaprabhu said he would not give his own mother prema because of an offence. She is a pure devotee and cannot really offend, but he used her to show how dangerous it is. When devotees begged him to break it, he said she must remove it herself. — “I can only teach her. To break it she has to do it herself.”

🎙 Maharaj at 24:38 (auto-transcript): “I will not give my mother a prayer. I will not give her. For prayer? She won't get it. Why? She is an offender. Such a matter cannot offend anyone. She is not a learner. Pure devotee. There is nothing like an offence from a pure devotee. But, to teach us how dangerous it is.”

No one else can rectify our offence, not even the Lord on our behalf; we ourselves have to do it.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:47 (auto-transcript): “We ourselves have to rectify. No one can rectify it. Ourself, we have to rectify it. We will be able to get the right of ourself. We will be able to get the right of ourself. We will be able to get the right of ourself. Shri Krishna He had the power”

Durvasa Muni had the power to enter Vaikuntha and meet Vishnu face to face. Krishna says those who reach his abode never return, yet Durvasa came back — the offence threw him out. The Lord told him he was not even a brahmana, because he had offended a devotee.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:27 (auto-transcript): “Shri Krishna He had the power He had the power He had the power He had the power He had the power Even entering into Baikuntha He had the power Even entering into Baikuntha But Gita Lord Krishna said In the Gita, Krishna says, Jat Gatva, Nadir Bhattata, Dham, Bharamamama.…”

Durvasa called the devotee a mere ksatriya while he was a brahmana. Some today belittle devotees by birth in the same way; the Lord says he is in charge of the acyuta-gotra, and what is done to his devotee is done to him. — “whatever you do to my devotee, who is under me, it is me”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:58 (auto-transcript): “Krishna said, I am in charge of Achuta Gotra. I am in charge of Achuta Gotra. I am in charge. He is my devotee. Therefore, Therefore, whatever you do to my devotee, who is under me, it is me. I am Bhakti Parajina. I am sheltered by devotees. Krishna did not say, Kamsa Adina.”

Krishna never says he is sheltered by Kamsa; he says he is under his devotees and begs their shelter. They have bought his independence; he is their property. — “Devotees have purchased Krishna's independence”

🎙 Maharaj at 31:38 (auto-transcript): “Krishna did not say, Kamsa Adina. I am protected by Kamsa Krishna didn't say like it Krishna begged devotee for shelter Krishna begged devotee for shelter Why? Devotees have taken Krishna's independence Devotees have purchased Krishna's independence Krishna is their property…”

children.topic: Beat the child, meet the father
children.note:
To reach someone you are angry with, you strike his child — and the father comes asking who beat his child. Offending a devotee works the same way.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:25 (auto-transcript): “You are angry with somebody I want to show the anger But not directly to him How do you do that? You beat the child.”

Duhsasana insulted Draupadi; he did not ask Bhima to sit on his lap. Bhima took the insult to his wife as an insult to himself, and Duhsasana was killed.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:35 (auto-transcript): “Dushashan told Drupadi. Come on, sit here. What happened to him? What happened to him? Talk to me. What happened to him? He told Drupadi. What happened to him? Did he tell Bhim to come and sit there?”

Kichaka, as strong as Bhima, kicked Draupadi before King Virata, who could do nothing. Draupadi went to Bhima; he put on a sari, waited in the bed at the appointed hour, and when Kichaka came, pounded him into a lump. The cause of his death was Vaishnava aparadha.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:06 (auto-transcript): “Kichaka He is totally equal to Bhim Sen 10,000 elephant He kicked Dhopadi And Dhopadi fell before Virat Maharaj He couldn't do anything He couldn't do anything she cried and went to Bhim Senna who did that who did that go and tell him”

There is no need to keep asking why our chanting is not good. The reason is aparadha. — “Our chanting is not good because of Aparad”

🎙 Maharaj at 37:35 (auto-transcript): “There is no need for us to ask questions about My chanting is not good, my chanting is not good Our chanting is not good because of Aparad So here it is mentioned Arche Vishnu Siladhi One who thinks the date in the temple to be made of wood or stone.”

One who thinks Jagannatha is wood or Radha-Govinda a doll already lives on a hellish plane; only time separates him from arriving there. Jagannatha feasts all day, gorgeous and happy — the envious mind that cannot enjoy like that calls him wood.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:34 (auto-transcript): “Jagannath Baladev Subhadra Fudarsan Chakra Wood. Radha Govind is my boy. He is already living in hell's planet. Already. He is living in hell. Just the time. Only time. After 50 years, our clean activities, our sinful activities is sending us to hell.”

Our consciousness shows what we really think. Walking past the deity without acknowledging him, or treating him as God at the morning darshan and ordinary for the rest of the day, means we think he is wood.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:48 (auto-transcript): “We should be careful with our consciousness. Consciousness is telling us that Jagannath is wood. How? Anyone who walk past here, what I offer a business of Jagannath is what? Would. If it is a supreme law, would you do like that? No.”

Sharing an ashram at Radha-Gopinatha, a senior devotee had Maharaj offer fruits to his deities in the morning and happily ate the remnants — but at night switched off the light on the deities to sleep. In the morning the Lord; at night, wood. — “Do we put the Lord in darkness?”

🎙 Maharaj at 44:31 (auto-transcript): “In the night, I put on the light. He wanted to sleep. Before I came, he put up the light. And he went to sleep. So when I came, in my mind, I was thinking, this Prabhu offered fruits to a deity this morning.”

A bhakti-sastri student in Mayapur asked how to be convinced that the deity is the Lord. If God is everywhere, why not in Jagannatha? Maharaj told him to cook two dishes, offer one, and taste: prasadam is no longer rice but the Lord's remnants. The student agreed completely.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:16 (auto-transcript): “Let's see a bhakti sastri student in Mayapur. A very senior devotee. Ask me. How can you convince me that this is Lord? The deity is really Lord. How can you convince me? How can you convince me that it's Lord?”

A pujari dressing Jagannatha pinned the cloth directly into the Lord's body. The moment he stepped outside, a nail pierced his foot; he ran back and removed the pins, understanding the Lord was not wood.

Thinking of the guru and devotees as ordinary people is very common, even among ourselves: we see a devotee and do not greet him, and inwardly ask why he has come and when he will leave. That mind is living in hell.

🎙 Maharaj at 55:39 (auto-transcript): “It is very common. Very, very common. Even not going to Guru. It's too far. It's too far. Among ourselves. among ourselves to see and not greeting”

Maharaj recalls a devotee who once walked past him as if no one were there, as if passing wood or stone. Treating a person as nothing is the same mentality as treating the deity as wood.

Quoting Gour Govinda Maharaj, sin is like dust you can wipe off, while aparadha is a thunderbolt you cannot brush away with your hand. Stealing a bag can be forgiven by asking; blaspheming, criticising or plotting against a devotee, physically or in the mind, is something very different.

maps.title: SB Canto 11 · Class 30 · More Sense Enjoyment Means More Suffering

nodeData.topic: Class 30 · More Sense Enjoyment Means More Suffering
nodeData.note: SB 11.8.29 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. From Pingala, who awoke the night no customer came, Maharaj draws the lesson that disappointment is a blessing: suffering pushes us to ask why, and real repentance burns away impurities. Sense gratification is like a drop of water in a desert, and trying to satisfy lust only feeds it and lengthens material life; the human body is meant for gaining a spiritual one. A long Q&A covers householder life, detachment, fear of losing things, knowing without doing, and the difference between repentance and depression. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The verse gives the prostitute Pingala's words as she recognises how foolish her uncontrolled mind has been in seeking pleasure from worthless men.

Experienced people say disappointment is a blessing, and Maharaj sees it as completely true. Pingala had worked as a prostitute for years and enjoyed it — for some, not even for money but from the force of past sinful desire.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:38 (auto-transcript): “Hare Krishna, those who are very experienced, they say that disappointment is a blessing. And I can see this 100% disappointment is a blessing. tingala has been doing the work of prostitution for many years and she is making money from it”

Maharaj recalls a sister in his childhood saying she had not finished enjoying a woman's body and would come back as a woman again. A strong desire sets up the next birth; Krishna fulfils our desires, spiritual or material.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:16 (auto-transcript): “so they are ready to do it not even for money that is a karma that they it is a pleasure i remember when i was a child one of my sisters said i did not enjoy this my woman i will come back again like this was a woman so I can enjoy this body so what would happen to my next…”

One night Pingala waited for customers, watching one man after another, and none stopped. She went home disappointed, without money, and lay awake asking why — and that contemplation brought realisation.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:28 (auto-transcript): “prostitution lying for years until Godmother Mahara said when they look for to my eyes the good person down on her so that night she was looking oh this one is come out here this one has one person ah the whole night she was looking at this one this one this one this one but…”

If karma is not finished, the next phase is to cry over one's predicament and ask why one suffers. Punishment is really Krishna's message to give our life a new turn; in deep pain one inquires, and then Krishna sends his representative. — “krishna is sending the representative”

children.note:

The soul, part of the supreme enjoyer, has real and eternal joy; illicit sex is an activity of the body, and the soul pays for every bodily act — gross, subtle or verbal. The so-called concessions of Kali-yuga entice the less intelligent. — “All bodily activities are dangerous.”

maps.title: SB Canto 11 · Class 28 · All of Us are Fools, Without Faith

nodeData.topic: Class 28 · All of Us are Fools, Without Faith
nodeData.note: SB 11.26.33–34 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Pure bhakti cannot be earned by our own effort: it is given by a pure devotee, and it reaches only the disciple who has faith, serves selflessly and follows instructions without twisting them. Maharaj draws on Prahlada in the womb, Narottama Dasa Thakura approaching his guru, disciples who would not buy their guru an umbrella, and Kamsa's dropped sword to show that sincere surrender and character, not cleverness, carry a disciple home. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: Why Prahlada heard in the womb
children.note:
Maharaj opens with a question to the room: what did Prahlada have that his mother lacked? Pain makes us pray, and the womb is where we begin praying to God. — “We start praying to God inside the womb.”

🎙 Maharaj at 00:21 (auto-transcript): “He is making a point. Because it is in the womb that we start praying to God. It's in the womb. We start praying to God inside the womb. and you may not breathe the good will come out very rare okay he says in better condition therefore it was the only year what else thank…”

Maharaj calls the session a study rather than a class and asks devotees to study scripture carefully, answering the questions together.

🎙 Maharaj at 01:43 (auto-transcript): “This is not a class, it's a study. Not a class, it's a study. We should study our scripture nicely. What was responsible? Kayadu did not hear any. Pranad had it. In a favorable situation, it's not always bad karma. on federal situation not always bad karma not always be the…”

Narada gave Kayadhu shelter and spoke right in front of her, but her attachment to her husband kept her mind elsewhere; she cooked and served and did not really hear. Prahlada received Narada's mercy.

🎙 Maharaj at 02:44 (auto-transcript): “reason she was attached to the husband for god even though the money was giving her shelter physical shelter right there because of another then they go they didn't kill her the another who saved her but the attachment for the husband made her to forget and narada was right there”

children.topic: Not an inch without a pure devotee
children.note:
Prahlada is an eternal associate, yet the principle stands for everyone: whatever we think we are, without a pure devotee's mercy we cannot move an inch. The acaryas and scriptures are displayed all around us for that reason. — “without the mercy of a pure devotee, you cannot go anywhere”

🎙 Maharaj at 04:46 (auto-transcript): “who will not go anywhere from here, will never go anywhere, you can be whatever you think you are, without the mercy of a pure devotee, you cannot go anywhere, not an inch from here, throw out our chariots, throw out our scriptures, you see these things being fully displayed,…”

children.topic: Pure bhakti is given, not earned
children.note:
Pure bhakti is handed down by those who have it, so a devotee needs unflinching faith in the spiritual master, along with sincerity and seriousness. Devotion means the mood of a menial servant without false prestige; only selfless service has the power to touch a pure devotee's heart. — “It is given by those who have it.”

🎙 Maharaj at 06:07 (auto-transcript): “Without the mercy of a pure devotee, you will never get bhakti, pure bhakti. You cannot get it. You need the mercy of a pure devotee to get Krishna. It is given. It is given. It is given by those who have it. Therefore, a devotee must have unflinching faith in spiritual…”

Narada became a pure devotee by serving pure devotees; the service qualified him to receive their remnants. Maharaj adds that many people took the remnants and not all were liberated: he recalls a fish freed by a great acarya's remnants while insincere companions were not.

🎙 Maharaj at 08:18 (auto-transcript): “Narada, how did he become a pure devotee? He served pure devotee. Before the remnant, he was saved. The service qualified him for the remnant. There are many people who were taking the remnant, many people, they were taking the remnant. Sama Anujachara also demonstrated that.…”

Disciples once asked their guru why a fish went back to Godhead after one taste of his prasadam while they, eating it for years, had not. The answer: the fish is not crooked, but you twist my instructions and do what you like. — “The fish is not crooked.”

🎙 Maharaj at 09:07 (auto-transcript): “The question here, Guru Day, we have been taking your prasadam every day. The fish took how many? Once. One lot to God's help. But we are taking for years. Our Guruji Chira said, all of you are crooked. The fish is not crooked. The animal is not crooked. But all of you, when…”

In Pune a devotee told Maharaj he saw no pure devotee in ISKCON, though he was initiated. Maharaj asks why take initiation at all, if not from faith that the guru will take you home; taking it without faith shows the problem is ours. — “taking initiation without faith, who is the problem, you or the Guru”

🎙 Maharaj at 09:59 (auto-transcript): “Last year, Pune, not far from here, a devotee came to my room. I don't see a pure devotee in his con. I said, oh, very good. I also, I don't see a pure devotee. So we are brothers. But did you take initiation? have you taken initiation he said yes i took him who is the guru…”

A sober person knows what to do and what not to do; Bhagavad-gita chapter 16 describes those who do not know as demoniac. A devotee knows what he is looking for in Krishna consciousness, and the sages direct him to a guru.

🎙 Maharaj at 12:29 (auto-transcript): “He knows what is right, he knows what is wrong. One who does not know what is right and what is wrong, in chapter 6, Babudgeta, he calls 16.6. What is it? Also in this world, there are two kinds of created beings. One is called divine and the other is called demoniac.”
The verse is about the pure devotee as the one shelter for those afraid of falling into a miserable life, set beside food, the Lord and religion as other kinds of shelter.

Maharaj asks whether anything in the verse is missing or ambiguous. Nothing is: the scripture, the acaryas and Krishna are clear, and confusion comes from our own confused self.

nodeData.topic: Class 27 · Serving Sri Guru in Separation
nodeData.note: SB 11.18.39 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Service to the spiritual master in separation is the highest service because it reveals what kind of disciples we really were. Krishna's mercy rests with his pure devotees, who are his form and his ambassadors; a bona fide disciple keeps hearing and carrying out the guru's order after his physical departure, while hero-worshippers and free riders fall away. In a long online Q&A Maharaj explains how to stay connected, test inner instructions, and act on the order with full acceptance. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Krishna tells Uddhava that until one clearly realises spiritual knowledge one should keep serving the guru personally, with faith and without envy, seeing him as non-different from Krishna.

And so depending on your genuineness and attentive hearing through Sabda is when you get the realization to…”

The Supersoul speaks within but we do not hear, so he comes outside where we can. We are patients: take the medicine as prescribed, not one-one-one when he said two-two-two. — “if we know better than him, why did we go to him?”

🎙 Maharaj at 51:56 (auto-transcript): “remain a faithful servant listening to what is we should see ourselves like a patient and the doctor the doctor is a special master and we are the patients so we have gone to the doctor and doctor diagnosed our sicknesses they will give medicine according to what they have…”

Arguing with an instruction you have not yet tried is foolishness. Do it, then report the result, and adjustment can come. Be obedient and submissive, then inquire.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:21 (auto-transcript): “I told one the devotee see a guru have told you to do something you have not done it yet but you are arguing what is your right what is your right to do that it is foolishness you should try it first and see that it doesn't work then you can ask I have done like this but this…”

A devotee fears that what she hears in the heart may be mental speculation.

🎙 Maharaj at 62:52 (auto-transcript): “we being still a bit immature and trying to follow and sometimes not being able my question relates to that but it's in regards to hearing in the heart so i understand we should when we're trying to advance we should be patient that the results will come but sometimes i am we…”

If a voice tells you to kill everyone in the temple for Prabhupada, that is the mind — and why would you alone get such an order? An instruction that is universal and beneficial to all, like improving one's japa or reciting a Gita verse daily, comes from the bona fide source. — “The mind will not tell me this.”

🎙 Maharaj at 63:50 (auto-transcript): “see if I hear if I hear a voice tomorrow I think I should kill all these in this temple because they don't like you they are they are all imposters kill all of them proper will be happy so we should know definitely we should know that this is this is a man probably probably…”

The guru's instructions seem far away; how can one serve happily while feeling insufficient?

🎙 Maharaj at 69:24 (auto-transcript): “Shia Gurudev, I was based on some personal experiences. I see that when we are trying to follow Guru's instructions, sometimes it looks so far away, all that Guru wants from us. And like seeing where we are and where the instructions are. So there is a lot of lamentation in…”

The strength to execute is inside the instruction, not brought from outside. First fully accept it; then the intelligence for how to do it comes. Doubting whether you are qualified blocks the miracle. — “the instruction carried the message the potency to execute it”

🎙 Maharaj at 70:31 (auto-transcript): “instruction the strength to execute it is inside the message inside that instruction it's not going to bring it from outside somewhere the instruction carried the message the potency to execute it so we should first of all accept it if you accept it then the realization how…”

In 2000 Maharaj's guru told him to finish a massive, abandoned temple with no money. Because he accepted the order, ideas came, he started acting, and everything came.

🎙 Maharaj at 72:30 (auto-transcript): “In the year 2000, we were constructing a temple. it was how it has some some challenges it was abandoned for some time and when they grew they told me you have you go and you go and fix it go and fix it very very difficult there's no money and i don't know the members to go i…”

Leave a pot on the fire while busy with your phone and it burns dry and sets the kitchen alight. Taking devotees casually leads to offences, and familiarity breeds contempt that goes from the devotee to guru and Krishna. Value the association Krishna gives.

🎙 Maharaj at 79:53 (auto-transcript): “Maharaj, my question is that you mentioned in the lecture that our fortune is where there is Krishna's devotee, by quoting Bhakti Vala Papaji Maharaj. So Maharaj, my question is that sometimes it happens like we start taking the devotees association very casual. So Maharaj,…”

nodeData.topic: Class 26 · How to Interact with Our Guru
nodeData.note: SB 11.17.27 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Krishna tells Uddhava to regard the acarya as non-different from himself. Maharaj explains that a guru is compulsory, that he is Krishna's supported representative, and that he must take real charge of his disciples rather than enjoy their facilities, while warning against self-made gurus and cheating disciples. Both guru and disciple must be bona fide, and real association means attentive hearing. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Krishna, describing the brahmacari's life to Uddhava, says the spiritual master is to be seen as his representative and never envied as an ordinary man. Srila Prabhupada's purport on it appears in Caitanya-caritamrta Adi-lila 1.46.

children.topic: As good as Krishna, yet not Krishna
children.note: A devotee asked Maharaj how the guru can be respected as Krishna while not being Krishna. Krishna himself says it plainly; the scripture is clear, and only our complicated application makes it difficult.

children.topic: No disciple grows without a guru
children.note:
Guru and disciple are connected; without that connection there is no question of advancement.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:03 (auto-transcript): “is written here many devotees if you have listened very carefully the spiritual master and disciples are connected together if there is no connection between the spiritual master and disciple there's no question of advancement there is connection an example is given here a…”

No child survives without parents, and Maharaj has seen children of separated families struggle badly. In the same way no one becomes Krishna conscious without the care of a spiritual master. — “No child can survive without the parent.”

🎙 Maharaj at 19:22 (auto-transcript): “no question of advancement there is connection an example is given here a child without a parent cannot maintain himself. No child can survive without the parent. No disciple can become Christian counselor without the special master. It is not possible. If it is possible,…”

The Upanisad's instruction makes the guru compulsory, not a matter of liking. Rupa Gosvami puts five items about the spiritual master right at the start of the sixty-four practices: the beginning of spiritual life is shelter of a bona fide guru. — “Spiritual master is compulsory. It is not an option.”

🎙 Maharaj at 20:57 (auto-transcript): “I'd be, either be, catch it. Means what? Spiritual master is compulsory. It is not an option. If I like, I will accept. If I don't like, I will do without a spiritual master. No. it is compulsory, compulsory and when you look at our teachings, Rupa Goswami has given five…”

If something happens to an ambassador, the whole country he represents is affected. Likewise, disturbing Krishna's representative disturbs Krishna and all of Vaikuntha.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:10 (auto-transcript): “master a bona fide special master is krishna representative ordinarily speaking if something happens to an ambassador it is not that single soul the whole country that ambassador representing will be affected similarly if a representative of krishna is disturbed krishna is…”

Citing Sanatana Gosvami's Brihad-bhagavatamrta, Maharaj says the residents of Vaikuntha choose a soul and send him down, and remain connected, monitoring and supporting him.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:40 (auto-transcript): “only krishna the whole vayakunta resident are disturbed because it's according to sanatana goswami's uh the resident to buy culture select among themselves one soul and sends him down here for her and while he's here they are connected they are monitoring supporting him from…”

Asked in Pune whether a tiny jiva can really be the exalted guru being described, Maharaj told how Sita asked Hanuman about his size after his leap across the ocean. Hanuman replied that he is eternally tiny, but carries the Lord's mercy.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:12 (auto-transcript): “One day in Pune, one day what he asked me, the topic was special master, and at the end, he asked me the question in the class. After the class, he asked me, this one tiny soul, Jiwa, his guru, is that person you are talking so wonderful like that? I said, yes, is that Jiwa,…”

A company sending a branch manager to Nigeria gives him every facility and he reports back to head office. Krishna does better than that for his representative. — “As it is working materially, it is working spiritually.”

🎙 Maharaj at 26:01 (auto-transcript): “If you have a company here and you send your branch to Nigeria, what will you do? You give him all the facilities necessary. So Krishna will not do the same thing. We can do like that, but Krishna cannot do. He can do better than that. So he has all the facilities. Necessary…”

Gurus function in three categories, and in Kali-yuga the kanistha, whose position is still partly material, is prominent. He may misbehave when enamoured of the facilities around him.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:16 (auto-transcript): “Yet we know that this spiritual master, they are functioning in three categories. We have a Kalista Guru, and in Kaliyoga is prominent. So we have difficulties Because a canister, two of his legs are immaterial. So he will misbehave if he is not careful. He will misbehave.…”

Maharaj describes people lobbying for signatures to be approved as guru. Such a person can still succeed if sincere, but he is disqualified from the start because he was not empowered. — “He has pushed himself there.”

🎙 Maharaj at 28:01 (auto-transcript): “But it is happening even in our movement. It's a campaign for someone, something like, they campaign to become spiritual master. They lobbied, please, can you all of you sign for me? They sign for me and they present it. I've been training you for 20 years now, is it not? So…”

In our system the community watches a person's activities and then asks him to lead. Even that has dangers: Nahusha was properly empowered and still fell from pride. Self-made gurus confuse many and push immature people to offend real devotees.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:13 (auto-transcript): “The community had looked into his activities carefully and then feeling satisfied and say, okay, please, we want you to be our leader here. That's empowerment. Our system is based on that. Even where that is dangerous, it happened to Nahusha. Nahusha was empowered. He still…”

children.topic: There is always a pure devotee
children.note:
Krishna never leaves his system without a pure devotee, though few recognise him. If we want Krishna, Krishna will show us such a person; if we want something else, we will not see him. — “Pure devotees do not flock. They are rare.”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:32 (auto-transcript): “that Krishna never put one pure devotee in his system. There are not many, but there is always somebody. That is the system. Pure devotees do not flock. They are rare. But Only very few people will be able to recognize that person. If our interest in Krishna consciousness is…”

The purport says the spiritual master does not enjoy the facilities offered by disciples. Maharaj illustrates what goes wrong when he does.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:47 (auto-transcript): “A spiritual master is not an enjoyer of facilities offered by his disciples. A spiritual master told me one day, Mother says, I want to go to Russia. Yeah, you are sunny. I said, you should go everywhere now. I want to go to Russia. Because I was told that if you go there,…”

A guru once told Maharaj he wanted to go to Russia because twenty or fifty disciples would come at once. Why more disciples? More facilities.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:56 (auto-transcript): “A spiritual master told me one day, Mother says, I want to go to Russia. Yeah, you are sunny. I said, you should go everywhere now. I want to go to Russia. Because I was told that if you go there, 20, 30, 50 disciples just approach you at once. So I want to go to Russia. I…”

A sannyasi should not visit temples to take donations and the best prasadam. He must stimulate people's Krishna consciousness, as Sukadeva Gosvami penetrated the hearts of his listeners. — “A sannyasi should not go to a temple just to go and eat.”

🎙 Maharaj at 34:02 (auto-transcript): “A sannyasi shouldn't go to a place to eat. A sannyasi should not go to a temple just to go and eat. Take donation, eat the best prasada, and go away. A sannyasi must affect the people whom he visit Krishna consciously. He must be able to stimulate their Krishna consciousness.…”

Quoting a leadership book by a senior sannyasi, Maharaj says a guru who accepts facilities must give spiritual nourishment in return; otherwise it is a cheating business.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:01 (auto-transcript): “In the leadership book, one of his Solonist Bautista Maharaj, there he mentioned, a special master taking facilities from the disciples must also do his duty by giving them spiritual nourishment. Otherwise, it is cheating business. It is cheating. A special master is not an…”

children.topic: The guru takes charge of disciples
children.note:
From a Second Canto lecture by Prabhupada: a guru must have real care over his disciples — control, not manipulation. One who does not take care of them is like a criminal; it is not a cheap business.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:57 (auto-transcript): “The second counter of Bhagavatam, in a lecture of proper gave, it is illegal for a special master not to have control over, not manipulation, control doesn't mean manipulation. The special master must take care of the disciples. If he does not take care of the disciples, he…”

Disciples proudly say their guru is too busy to see them. Yes, he should be busy, but busy with them. How does a wife feel when her husband has no time for her? — “He should be busy taking care of the disciples.”

🎙 Maharaj at 38:28 (auto-transcript): “These days you will hear, my Guru is very busy. Yes, the Guru should be busy. He should be busy taking care of the disciples. That is his business. So it is not business, it is not business if he is not responsible for the disciples. How does a woman feel that the husband is…”

Maharaj warns of counsellors who block devotees from initiation unless they are in their good books, and who build their own following among the guru's disciples, using the guru as bait.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:03 (auto-transcript): “he sees them and he knows what is happening then political counselors will not play on the guru and brothers and sisters understand political counselors if you are not in my good record I would not recommend you for initiation as counselors the counselor does not carry the…”

Cheating disciples get cheated. Everyone thought Duryodhana was Balarama's favourite, yet all along he was being prepared for his end. Maharaj adds the story of a 'best disciple' who fooled no one when he fell sick and the guru left him to manage it himself.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:51 (auto-transcript): “That is sure. We should not check out what it takes for us. Niscapata Bakhtar and Sakapata Bakhtar. Sakapata Bakhtar are cheaters. They were cheated. Clearly, Dirodan was cheated by Balaram. Perfectly cheated. The whole world knows that Balaram is the master of Dirodan. And…”

Narada Muni influenced his disciples; a bona fide guru transforms those around him, provided the disciples are also bona fide. Then the two are compatible.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:29 (auto-transcript): “mean he is taking charge of the disciple? Prophet said, first can't talk about Naradimuni, Naradimuni influenced his disciples. You don't see? Don't you see that in Bhagavatam? Naradimuni influenced his disciples. Don't you see properly influenced his disciples? Yes, a bona…”

When Gadadhara Pandita was introduced through Mukunda, it was said to be a great fortune to have such a disciple, and he was initiated. A guru wants such disciples.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:20 (auto-transcript): “When Gadadharapande was introduced to him, he told Mukunda, it is a great fortune to have a disciple like Gadadharapande. It's a great fortune to have such a disciple. It's not ordinary. So I will initiate him. We want such a disciple. So the Guru takes charge of disciples,…”

Sugar is naturally sweet; if someone tastes it as bitter, the fault is in him, not the sugar. Those blocked by their own mentality are not touched by the guru's potency.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:47 (auto-transcript): “by the spiritual master's potency. That is not the fault of the spiritual master. The sugar is naturally sweet, isn't it? The nature of sugar is what? It's sweet. But the person who is having to join this. Sugar is sweet? Who is fault? The fault of sugar? Who is fault? The…”

Pariksit and Sukadeva, Suta and the sages of Naimisaranya, Mahaprabhu and Sanatana, Vyasa and Narada, Vidura and Maitreya: in each pair, both were bona fide, and the association transformed.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:29 (auto-transcript): “We saw that with Prokshit Maharaj Sugadev Goswami. Srutia Goswami, Namir Saranya said this. Chitam Mahaprabhu Sanatam Goswami. Biasadev Naradamuni. See the transformation. Bidura Mahatma, Maitreya Mahatma. See the transformation that took place. By the association. There was…”

children.topic: Close in spirit, not in body
children.note:
Prabhupada was not physically closest to his guru, yet he was the best disciple. A householder who came reluctantly, he received the order to preach in English to the West, and his last letter repeated it. Free-rider disciples hang on the guru for their own agenda. — “The closeness to the spiritual master is not a physical closeness”

🎙 Maharaj at 48:13 (auto-transcript): “The closeness to the spiritual master is not a physical closeness, it is a spiritual closeness. We are spiritually close, very close, spiritually very close. That means physically many different locations, physically, but internally they are very, very close, very close. So…”

children.topic: Sudra is a mentality, not a caste
children.note:
In the purport, sudra means anyone who cannot be trained to become a devotee, whatever their birth. Maharaj recalls visiting holy places with devotees from West Africa and Brazil while their hired driver would not even step inside — that is the mentality being described.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:08 (auto-transcript): “This does not mean a caste. This is not a caste. That a particular person, this person is a sudra. It is not. A sudra here means any person, even if the person is born in a Brahmana family, whatever the position the person may have, but if he cannot become a devotee, it's…”

Questions from the room and from online devotees.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:06 (auto-transcript): “One question, it is different, a little bit different from this. Is it okay to ask? Special master? Yes. Can we finish with this place?”

children.topic: Q1 · Why doesn't hearing change us?
children.note:
We hear instructions again and again, yet they seem to have no effect.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:57 (auto-transcript): “Why does it happen that we hear the instructions and yet it doesn't really change us or, you know, it doesn't impact us at all? The sound is able, it is a new way. One who hears, was acting on it. That is hearing. If you eat your belly before, say, if you have heard, you do…”

One who has truly heard acts on it. The sound is going on, but that does not mean we have got it. Keep up prasadam, kirtan and chanting and the senses become purified to hear.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:22 (auto-transcript): “One who hears, was acting on it. That is hearing. If you eat your belly before, say, if you have heard, you do something, proper heard, you're executing it. So the sound is going on, but it doesn't mean you have got it. So we're not hearing. That's what we've been saying, we…”

A disciple excused his silence by saying he had lost his phone. Is that the only connection? If you think of the person, you are with him; this movement works beyond the body, heart to heart, and Krishna and guru can teach through many channels for one eager to learn.

🎙 Maharaj at 59:47 (auto-transcript): “One day I asked one disciple why I didn't hear it from you for a long time. I asked the disciple why didn't you hear from me for a long time. Ah yes Guru dear, please forgive me I lost my phone. So I said you can only communicate with me through a phone, no other way to…”

children.topic: Q2 · Remembering Krishna at the office
children.note:
After morning japa, meetings and problems absorb the mind. How can one remember Krishna at work?

🎙 Maharaj at 63:57 (auto-transcript): “I have one question. Normally we do our japa in the morning and then we go to office. But once we go to office, we have lot of meetings or analysis of a problem or something. Then we forget everything, like our whole mind gets into materialistic things because of the…”

Full-time devotion is direct; a devotee's job is indirect devotional service. If the morning japa is strong and the salary is used for Krishna, the work is still connected with him and protected.

🎙 Maharaj at 64:32 (auto-transcript): “We have direct Christian Consciousness and indirect Christian Consciousness. Direct Christian Consciousness is when one is fully devoted to that. No office, no other thing. We are fully devoted. That is direct. Indirect one is that we are also working in office. is the…”

Greed and envy keep coming up; and how can deeply materialistic people be pulled out?

🎙 Maharaj at 66:35 (auto-transcript): “Mahal, normally, I personally am talking about myself, I am also, a lot of unwanted thoughts come, like for example, body consciousness, for example, greed, envy, and these thoughts keep on coming in my mind and sometimes I take actions because they are always coming in…”

Public harinama and prasadam give people a connection with Krishna that stays with them, even to the next life. Prabhupada made sure everyone who came got prasadam.

🎙 Maharaj at 67:28 (auto-transcript): “Yes, so many things. What do we go out to do harinam? What do we do harinam in the public? It gives them chance to hear. That is the connection, their connection with Krishna consciousness. We, we, we are doing harinam in the Sri people. What is this? What is this? Krishna…”

children.topic: The struggle depends on the past
children.note:
Being fully fixed in the holy name is the end of the path, not the start. Sixteen rounds feel like punishment for beginners and sweet for those who practised before; those ahead of us went through the same and continued.

🎙 Maharaj at 70:16 (auto-transcript): “so now we should know that we have to put a lot of effort into the practice to get to that stage which will take some time according to our our load the load we are carrying on our heads some of them some of course the load is light based on the amount of practice we have…”

We have so many chances to associate with our spiritual master, yet we still do not progress.

🎙 Maharaj at 75:55 (auto-transcript): “Maret, like we sing, love, matre, sadhu, sang, services, we have so many chances to associate our spiritual masters, but still we are not understanding it's important and we think we are not getting progress even after associating him again again so what is the fault at our…”

children.topic: Pushing to the front, not hearing
children.note:
At a big 2014 programme in Guwahati, Maharaj watched a devotee push through the crowd to sit in front of the gurus, then take calls instead of hearing. Later he would say he had his guru's association.

🎙 Maharaj at 76:49 (auto-transcript): “At that time, it was in Guwahati, 2014, we had a program, a big hall, it was powerful with so many people, and we were all seated there. Hiswil-Japotaka Swami was sitting, the baptismal Swami was sitting, Mahavishnu Mahara was sitting, and a few proper disciples were sitting.…”

Two women heard seven days of class that Krishna's devotee is never drowned by the ocean of material existence. Crossing a flooded river home, one remembered Krishna and swam across; the other sank. Both were in the class; only one heard. Narada, by attentive hearing, became pure in four months.

🎙 Maharaj at 80:20 (auto-transcript): “i can take for sarah then who remain empty i give example of two ladies who were attending by what time class for seven days two ladies a daughter and a mother-in-law he attended the class for seven days and the speaker was speaking if you get krishna You become Krishna…”

children.topic: Q5 · Why not chastise a cheating disciple?
children.note:
A guru chastises only one who can take it; if it will break him, the guru leaves him where he is. The cheater wants the guru's opulence, not the guru, and gets position and facilities but not prema. With prema, everything is complete.

🎙 Maharaj at 82:38 (auto-transcript): “Sundari Mataji is asking, Hare Krishna Gurudev, please accept my humble obeisances. Why can't the Guru chastise a cheating disciple instead of bestowing upon him Nishkapat Kripa? She wrote Nishkapat but I think she means that. A Guru chastises a disciple who will not become…”

maps.title: SB Canto 11 · Class 25 · Deity Worship Removes Our Attachments

nodeData.topic: Class 25 · Deity Worship Removes Our Attachments
nodeData.note: SB 11.27.9–12 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Krishna describes to Uddhava where and how he may be worshipped: in the Deity and other forms, after purifying oneself, with mantras at the junctions of the day. Maharaj stresses that Deity service must be steady every day, not dropped when we are tired, and in answers to questions links Deity service with understanding we are not the body and with improving our chanting. Much of this short, partly Hindi recording is not intelligible. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Read first in Hindi: the verse names the places in which the Lord may be worshipped, such as the Deity form and the forms of the elements, or simply within one's own heart.

These verses describe preparing for worship by first cleansing oneself, then worshipping with the mind fixed on Krishna and with the prescribed mantras at the junctions of the day. Maharaj adds the plain instruction to clean the body, teeth and mouth first.
The verse lists the materials of which the Lord's form may be made, such as wood, metal, earth, a painted picture, or a form established within the mind.
Speaking in Hindi, Maharaj says that if we want pure love, Deity service must continue every day without a break, not only now and then.

He acts out our excuses: I came back from the office very tired, so today we will not do it. That is exactly what must not happen.

🎙 Maharaj at 08:51 (auto-transcript): “I came back from work very tired. I was very tired of working in the office. So, today we will not do regret. We will not do that. We will not do that. God has said not to come to you. We have done that. So, this is our job. That we will not do that. If you will keep your…”

If we keep our attention on the Lord in his Deity form, he keeps his attention on us. — “If you will keep your attention, then God will keep your attention.”

🎙 Maharaj at 09:27 (auto-transcript): “If you will keep your attention, then God will keep your attention. In our Krishna consciousness, there is no scope for us. The whole purpose of God is not to do any of this. We must never do any of this. We must do it. We must do it. We must do it. We must do it. Every day,…”

Two questions from the floor, partly in English and partly in Hindi.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:09 (auto-transcript): “Do you have any questions? How do you feel? Serving other deities. I don't understand how this connects serving the deities and realizing that your soul and your soul.”

children.topic: Q1 · Deity service and the soul?
children.note:
A devotee cannot see how serving the Deity connects with realising that we are spirit souls and not the body.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:42 (auto-transcript): “Serving other deities. I don't understand how this connects serving the deities and realizing that your soul and your soul. They are spirit souls and they are not body. How this directly connects to the deities? I have said that if we are able to serve our body, then we can…”

children.topic: Service lifts us beyond the body
children.note:
Maharaj answers that by rendering this service we come to understand that we are not the human body but the soul. The rest of his answer is not intelligible in the recording.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:07 (auto-transcript): “I have said that if we are able to serve our body, then we can understand that we are not a human body, but we are a soul. So, we can understand how we can understand how we can understand how we can understand. is big great sewa a a a”

A devotee newly serving the Deities in the temple wants to put his heart into it, but wonders whether he should give himself more to harinama sankirtana, the yuga-dharma.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:49 (auto-transcript): “I have been doing deity worship in temple recently and I am getting interest to do it first class and make it in my heart but yesterday I was thinking that that yuk dharma for this age is Hainam Sankirtan, chanting and dancing, so I should give my”
Answering in Hindi, Maharaj explains that Deity service is prescribed precisely to make our chanting of the holy name better, and that it helps bring the mind under control.

Even Caitanya Mahaprabhu honoured Deity worship: on his South Indian tour he stayed four months at Sri Rangam, where the Deity is worshipped to this day.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:20 (auto-transcript): “So, Chaitanya Mahaprabhu has made a minti of Daganath Ji. And in that puja, for 4 months, Shira ngam, they are vigrat today. Have you seen someone? Shira ngam. Where did you go?”

Deity worship needs to be taught, and its importance explained, especially in youth. Pure devotees may not need it in the same way, but the rest of us do.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:00 (auto-transcript): “We don't need them, but we need to teach them, or to teach them how important they are to teach them, especially in the early youth, so that we can teach them, so that we can teach them. Shuddha Bhakt, when they make a Buddha, then they don't need to teach them, because their…”
