maps.title: SB Canto 11 · Class 24 · How Should Devotees Associate

nodeData.topic: Class 24 · How Should Devotees Associate
nodeData.note: SB 11.3.30 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Devotees should meet to hear and chant about Krishna, not to discuss everything else; that is the process of purification and the source of real happiness. Maharaj asks how friendly our dealings really are, urges us to come to the sadhus with our ears rather than our eyes, and shows from the Pracetas and Narada that friendship among Vaishnavas, without envy, carries us back to Godhead together. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: 11.3.30 — Gather to chant the Lord's glories
children.note: The verse teaches how devotees should associate: by coming together to glorify the Lord, which purifies them and makes them happy. Maharaj's first point is simply that we must learn how to associate.
Hearing and chanting about Krishna is most effective in the company of like-minded devotees. Maharaj cites Kapila Muni in the Third Canto and Bhaktivinoda Thakura for the same point.

Envy is a terrible disease, and the best cure is to chant and dance together. While dancing we forget who we are, and envy is forgotten with it. — “While dancing and chanting we will never remember who we are”

🎙 Maharaj at 15:34 (auto-transcript): “the best way for us to overcome envy to chant and dance While dancing and chanting we will never remember who we are We will forget about envy This is a very terrible disease we mentioned this before This verse confirms it The process of purification is to come together and…”

children.topic: What is missing in our practice?
children.note:
A devotee asked Maharaj what is lacking in our Krishna consciousness when everything seems to be going nicely. His answer: our attitude towards the practice.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:25 (auto-transcript): “This afternoon, one devotee asked me many questions One devotee asked me many questions One of the questions was What is lacking in our Krishna consciousness? We are doing nicely But what is missing? So I mentioned Our attitude towards our practice”

Even in the material world, when lawyers meet they talk about law and when doctors meet they talk about medicine. So what do devotees talk about when they meet?

🎙 Maharaj at 17:39 (auto-transcript): “When lawyers meet, what do they discuss? They talk about law. They will never talk about anything about law. When the doctors meet, what do they talk? They talk about medicals. So, what is missing in us? When we as devotees meet, what do we discuss?”

Maharaj answers his own question: we discuss everything except Krishna. That is exactly what is missing, because the verse tells us to meet and talk about Krishna. — “We should discuss about Krishna only”

🎙 Maharaj at 18:14 (auto-transcript): “When we as devotees meet, what do we discuss? When we meet as devotees, what do we discuss? Bhagavad Gita 11.3.30 We discuss other things except Krishna so that is what is missing that we are not meeting to discuss about Krishna”

children.topic: No one advances by hearing frustration
children.note:
When devotees meet to share their frustrations in Krishna consciousness, who becomes advanced by hearing them? Nobody. We cannot expect purification while avoiding what purifies.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:08 (auto-transcript): “When we start to talk about frustrations in Krishna consciousness Who becomes advanced by hearing frustration frustration. Who becomes Krishna constantly hearing someone's frustration? Who? Nobody. That is what is affecting us and our Krishna consciousness. That we should…”

children.topic: Parikrama as the acaryas did it
children.note:
At this year's Navadvipa parikrama Maharaj's first talk asked devotees to walk the way the acaryas walked: no outside talk, only chanting and hearing about each place. We are not inventing anything new.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:35 (auto-transcript): “This year, Navadip Parikrama, the first speech I made was to tell devotees, we are here for Navadip Parikrama. We are going to pass through the way we are going to pass through for the many days of the Parikama. That is why we are doing it. We did our chari as they did, so we…”

Our difficulty is that we do not hear; the material mentality is too dominant. The medicine is to hear the glories of Krishna and chant them, as our acaryas did. — “And the medicine is to hear.”

🎙 Maharaj at 21:45 (auto-transcript): “I have been saying also that we have difficulties here We don't hear. It's part of the problem. That we don't hear. Why we don't hear? But the material saying the application is too dominant in our consciousness. And the medicine is to hear. the glories of Krishna”

As devotees develop loving friendship they feel mutual happiness. The result of right association is purification and happiness together.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:47 (auto-transcript): “As devotees develop their loving friendship they feel mutual happiness and satisfaction. This is the result, the result is that we are getting purified and we are becoming happy in our friendly dealing with each other, how friendly is our dealings How friendly is our dealings?”

Maharaj repeats the question several times and asks the room not to answer him but to answer themselves.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:18 (auto-transcript): “in our friendly dealing with each other, how friendly is our dealings How friendly is our dealings? How friendly is our dealings? Don't give me the answer. You give the answer to yourself. How friendly is our dealings? How friendly is our dealings? The same thing you find in…”

children.topic: The Pracetas did not act for blessings
children.note: In the Fourth Canto Krishna praises the Pracetas for their friendly dealings and offers them any benediction. They had not asked; they simply behaved properly and the blessing came. We, by contrast, act in order to get blessings.

Maharaj gives a second example of Krishna offering anything, and the devotee asking only for his blessing, since with it there is no false ego and nothing else is needed. With Krishna's mercy everything is complete; without it nothing has value.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:51 (auto-transcript): “The same thing he did to the Rzemoni Kessan told him ask me anything anything everything ask me i'm ready to give and the money said don't make me proud i said that is nothing is out i saw something better than that And I'm going to say, okay, I need your blessing, I need…”

By encouraging one another devotees can give up sense gratification, the cause of all suffering. The medicine is to hear and chant with devotees and not to discuss anything else.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:52 (auto-transcript): “And by those encouraging one another, they are able to give off material, sense, gratification, which is the cause of all suffering. And this kind of bhakti is a cause of all sufferings Krishna mentioned that in Marodita Varieties of sanctification Which basis is that? It's…”

Maharaj recalls the Gita's call to give up all varieties of sense gratification and asks the audience to find the chapter 2 verse on the spot, explaining that we should know our books well. — “we should be familiar with our scripture”

🎙 Maharaj at 28:24 (auto-transcript): “Krishna mentioned that in Marodita Varieties of sanctification Which basis is that? It's in chapter 2. Which basis is that? Varieties, varieties of sanctification. That is fine. That is fine. Varieties of sanctification, beginning of chapter 2. Which basis is that? Yeah, I'm…”

children.topic: Come to sadhus with your ears
children.note:
We should not approach sadhus with our eyes, because then we see only faults. Come with the ears, and they will pour nectar into them. — “don't go with the eye because you see nothing but fault”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:45 (auto-transcript): “we should not come to the sadhus to come and discuss something else we should come to the sadhus with the ears to hear not to see only ears we need to come with if it is about the sadhus don't go with the eye because you see nothing but fault You will go with the ears They…”

Sukadeva Gosvami speaks of drinking the Bhagavatam through the ears: we drink through the mouth for the body and through the ears for the heart. Hearing destroys material desire and lets love for Krishna sprout, so we should not be afraid to let Krishna take our heart.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:23 (auto-transcript): “Sukadeva Goswami used the word nivishta Nivishta means to hear through the eye No, to drink through the ears Not to drink through the mouth Drink through the ears Drink through the ears very very powerful purify the soul drink through the mouth to take care of your body drink…”

Not every speaker penetrates the heart; there is a qualification to speak and a qualification to hear, and both are needed.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:02 (auto-transcript): “Through hearing about Krishna from devotee ishukar penetrate the heart not all speakers penetrate the heart because there is qualification for everything qualification to speak qualification to hear both of them are necessary So we should hear, according to Prabhupada, from…”

The right source is a devotee who speaks not to entertain or for any material gain but because he cares for the audience and represents Krishna. Such words enter the heart.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:34 (auto-transcript): “So we should hear, according to Prabhupada, from the right source. What is right source? On a dautrete devotee, who is speaking, not to entertain the audience. He is speaking not for any material benefit in the world. He is speaking because He is geared for the audience. He…”

Suta Gosvami honours Sukadeva because he knew how to enter the hearts of his listeners. Without dividing himself he entered every heart with love, speaking to both conditioned and liberated souls while his father and others sat listening.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:28 (auto-transcript): “That's the first qualification Sudha Goswami used for Sukhadev Goswami. Let me offer my return to the best of the powerful Son of Shilad Vah Siddha in Sukhadev Goswami. Why? He knows how to enter the heart of the audience. Sukhadev Goswami didn't divide himself by entering…”

Following Sridhara Svami, envy and quarrelling among devotees simply show that we are still neophytes. Advanced devotees deal with one another in friendship.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:09 (auto-transcript): “So, according to Sridharaswani, Those who advance in Krishna consciousness should not envy one another or quarrel among themselves. Envy Correlling among ourselves Means what? We are not advanced Neophytes Advanced devotees”

We sit together for each other's sake, not for my benefit or yours but for all of us. — “not for me, not for you, but for us”

🎙 Maharaj at 37:09 (auto-transcript): “Why? We are sitting together for each other. We are sitting together for each other, not for me, not for you, but for us. As we say from our short devotees, very powerful, very purifying, so powerful that in the 5th Canto, it is mentioned. Even if your devotees are not…”

Even if devotees are not speaking to you, sit and hear what they discuss. The sages did not talk to the boy Narada, yet by listening their nature became attractive to him and he took up Krishna consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:27 (auto-transcript): “As we say from our short devotees, very powerful, very purifying, so powerful that in the 5th Canto, it is mentioned. Even if your devotees are not talking with you Don't worry, don't worry about that Just sit down there And hear what they are discussing You will get…”

Those with an appetite for Krishna consciousness catch it first, just as those with weak immunity are first to catch a disease in the environment.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:07 (auto-transcript): “Those who have an appetite for Krishna consciousness, they will be affected. Just like those who have weak mood system, they will be the first people to get in contact with the disease that comes in that environment. So, we should not quarrel with each other, we should not…”

children.topic: Celebrate our exit from the world
children.note:
Instead of fighting we should dance together, celebrating our successful exit from the material world, and keep devising ways for people to come together and hear about Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:35 (auto-transcript): “So, we should not quarrel with each other, we should not fight with each other, we should come together to dance together celebrating our successful exit from material world That should be our celebration, so we should always come together, we should devise many”

Maharaj speaks from practical experience: the devotees are attached to harinama sankirtana, and after hours of dancing in the street they return transformed.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:19 (auto-transcript): “Practical experience. We are attached to Hainam Sankirtan. Vishnu Prabhu was saying yesterday, we are attached to Hainam Sankirtan. And when the Sankitan is performed for hours we are dancing, we will turn back to the temple.”

children.topic: Why do you all look so bright?
children.note:
A devotee told Maharaj that everyone returning from harinama looked bright. He did not see it himself; the reason is the potency of the holy name. — “There is potency in the chanting.”

🎙 Maharaj at 43:17 (auto-transcript): “One devotee came to me and said, all of you are looking so bright. I didn't see but somebody else was seeing it. You are looking bright. Why? The harina potency. There is potency in the chanting. Potency in the harina. Have you seen his fallenness, but his mother is sitting…”

We do not need to go to the Himalayas to sit and practise yoga. For devotees the yoga exercise is dancing in kirtan, and the acaryas recommend it. — “Our yoga exercise is dancing, very powerful.”

🎙 Maharaj at 44:20 (auto-transcript): “We are yogis, we don't have to go to Himalayas to sit down and do a Sangha Yoga. Our yoga exercise is dancing, very powerful. If you are not dancing, the mind is sharp. Practice dancing. If you practice dancing, that's what our charis are recommending here.”

Visvanatha Cakravarti Thakura adds that we must increase our love for each other, and Madhvacarya extends friendship even to the demigods. All the acaryas point to one thing: friendly dealings.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:42 (auto-transcript): “But Vishuddha Thakuripra continued, we should increase our love for each other. This is why we mentioned before, how is our dealing with each other? Mishwanath Chakravati is saying we should increase our lovely dealing with each other.”

Krishna told the Pracetas that they were all engaged in one occupation, devotional service. If we are all going to the same place, why should I envy you? — “Why should I envy you?”

🎙 Maharaj at 47:17 (auto-transcript): “Lord Krishna told the protectors, all of you are engaged in one occupation, not two occupations, not three, one occupation, devotional service, means we are going to the same place. Why should I envy you? Narayamuni said Because devotees are going back to God's head They are…”

Narada Muni explains that devotees are free from envy because they are going back to Godhead. If you are moving to something far better, you do not envy someone in a small rented room; compared to going home, the paltry things of this world are nothing.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:49 (auto-transcript): “Narayamuni said Because devotees are going back to God's head They are free from envy How do you feel? They are living in one room If you are living in one BSK And now, you are going to imagine Will you envy a person in one BSK? Like that? No, you are going for something better”

This should be our focus: by supporting each other we enter fully into Krishna consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:08 (auto-transcript): “Nothing compared to that. This will be our focus. And by supporting each other we will allow the entrance into a Krishna consciousness. Hare Krishna! Anything else?”
Two questions from the floor; the first was not captured in the recording, only Maharaj's answer.

children.topic: Q1 · To whom should we open our mind?
children.note:
Maharaj's answer: do not reveal your mind to someone who is not of the same mind. Opening the mind is recommended, but only to a person with the right qualities, who can give the advice you need.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:21 (auto-transcript): “Don't reveal your mind to a person who is not of the same mind with you. Don't reveal your mind to a person who is pure. We see a person who has this technique.”

children.topic: A poor man begging from a poor man
children.note:
If you have no money and go to another man without money, what will you get? Go to the person who has it. In the same way, take your heart to one who can actually help.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:54 (auto-transcript): “If you are a poor man, they are going to beg another poor man. What will you get? You have no money. I send another person who has no money. What will happen? You will get no money? No, because he doesn't have. Go to a person who has the money. He will give you. I have that…”

Maharaj recalls asking a well-off devotee to take him to someone who had just lost his job. The devotee laughed, then on the way back asked what he needed and gave it himself. Going to the wrong person costs the fare and leaves you frustrated.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:38 (auto-transcript): “I have that experience before. I went to Midworld Devotee. And I told, a devotee who has money, a devotee who has money, I asked him to take me to the one who doesn't have money. He was laughing at me When I was talking to He was laughing at me”

children.topic: Q2 · Serving with someone who hurt me
children.note:
A devotee may soon have to serve alongside a senior devotee who mistreated him and fears it will happen again. Maharaj's reply at the end of the recording is not intelligible.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:50 (auto-transcript): “You mentioned that we cultivate a friendship with all the devotees, and that our problem is that we have a lot of envy and duplicity in our society. I have a personal question because in the future maybe I would be serving with a devotee who is here than me but he is treated…”

maps.title: SB Canto 11 · Class 23 · Piety Is Not Necessarily Bhakti

nodeData.topic: Class 23 · Piety Is Not Necessarily Bhakti
nodeData.note: SB 11.21.7–8 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Krishna sets what is proper and improper among times, places and things in order to restrain materialistic life; such piety makes one eligible but does not qualify one for Krishna's abode — only Krishna consciousness does. Maharaj explains why real good tastes bitter first, how places become pure or contaminated and how Mahaprabhu's devotees sanctify every land, why deities at home are fully present, and how 'working on ourselves' means becoming considerate human beings first. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Maharaj continues Canto 11, chapter 21, Krishna's explanation of the Vedic path to Uddhava, from text 7, and goes on to text 8.
The verse says Krishna established proper and improper among times, places and objects in order to restrict materialistic activity.

Being initiated as a brahmana does not qualify one to go back to Godhead. One must become qualified by ardent, rigid practice.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:15 (auto-transcript): “a condition so to go back to home back to godhead do you understand i've been given the initiation brahmana right brahmana does not qualify one to go back to godhead that doesn't mean naivari brahmana a brahman realized person you have to get qualified for it by practice”

Knowing how to cook is an ability, an eligibility; it does not make one Krishna conscious. Krishna does not take our expertise; he takes the love with which we do things.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:35 (auto-transcript): “If one knows how to cook, one may know how to cook. To cook is an ability. It's eligibility. One is eligible to cook. That does not qualify your consciousness to be Christian conscious. We need Christian consciousness. better for one to have christian consciousness than to…”

Rupa Gosvami says giving gifts develops love — not because of the object, but because the wish to make you happy is carried through it. Whenever you see it, you think of me. — “is how love is developed so consciousness matters a lot”

🎙 Maharaj at 23:43 (auto-transcript): “Rupa Goswami told us giving gifts will develop love. If I give you an eyeglass, if you start loving me, I give you an eyeglass. No, it will not. What motivated me to give you the eyeglass? I want to make you happy. That is transferred through the object. It is transferred.…”

children.topic: Piety alone does not give bhakti
children.note:
It takes a very high level of accumulated piety to become fortunate enough to take up Krishna consciousness, and piety alone is not sufficient.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:14 (auto-transcript): “so it takes it takes on a high level a very high level of piety to become fortunate to take to christian consciousness piety alone is not sufficient to make on the devotees you see lord brahma is amazed to see the cow head boys cow hell girls the gopis they also they also…”

Lord Brahma is amazed at the cowherd boys and girls: what did they do to come to this level, eating with Krishna and playing hand-to-hand, face-to-face — 'shall I beat you again today? Have you forgotten?'

🎙 Maharaj at 26:34 (auto-transcript): “lord brahma is amazed to see the cow head boys cow hell girls the gopis they also they also appreciate christians flute the parental this bomb very very happy what i did they have performed to come to this level that this dry stick is enjoying what is our light and giving us…”

children.topic: The dry stick of the flute
children.note:
The flute, a dry stick, enjoys the nectar of Krishna's lips and leaves us only the remnant — so what piety did it perform?

🎙 Maharaj at 27:04 (auto-transcript): “to come to this level that this dry stick is enjoying what is our light and giving us a remnant can you imagine that the remnant we are taking the remnant the stick is taking the everything and we are taking the rain out of his stick can you see that the budget but”

In her letter to Krishna she wrote that if she could not have him now, she would not change her mind but increase her austerity to get him in a later life. Such fortune is not made in a day.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:14 (auto-transcript): “fortune if you bring one to fortune the community we talk Krishna in the letters he wrote if I cannot get you now as my husband problem I'm not going to change my mind I will never what I will do I will increase my austerity so that next night I'll get you so my party cannot…”

What gives immediate pleasure is nectar at first and poison at the end. What is truly good begins with heavy austerity, like poison, and ends as nectar. — “In the beginning, it is nectar. At the end, poison.”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:25 (auto-transcript): “immediate that will give you immediate pleasure a current of our gator that is a signal that we test beta in the beginning is not not tasty but the end is nectar that is goodness means what this is what I get us what does that In the beginning, it is nectar. At the end,…”

At the start of Krishna consciousness come nasty behaviour from godbrothers and sisters, insults and disturbance of body and senses, and everyone complains about the mind. Keep practising with force; that austerity purifies, and then the nectar comes.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:47 (auto-transcript): “so many nasty behavior from brothers sisters and insults so many unnecessary things you have to pass through disturbance of the senses the body and so many things but okay channel education also everybody complain are the mind the mind the mind the mind but he won't continue…”

children.topic: The cook in the summer kitchen
children.note:
You cannot eat before you cook, and cooking in summer is the bitter part: sweat pouring, fingers burned, while everyone waits. Whoever perseveres makes something everyone enjoys. — “You persevere and continue with good heart.”

🎙 Maharaj at 32:55 (auto-transcript): “your food so which is which is bitter it's cooking especially in summer you have to go and cook in the kitchen every day we are waiting when the person is going to be ready but when the person is going to be ready look at the time but The person who is cooking in the kitchen,…”
The verse lists lands considered impure: without the spotted antelope, without respect for brahmanas, without decent people, such as Kikata, or where cleanliness and purifying rites are neglected.

Where the antelope lives the place suits practice: sages sit on its skin because snakes and scorpions will not climb onto it, and it is also a sign of renunciation. Where fear of dangerous creatures prevails, practice is disturbed. — “a snake will not climb there”

🎙 Maharaj at 36:23 (auto-transcript): “spotted antelope spotted antelope it means conducive environment for practicing christian concept because when one one sit on a jeskin or spotted antelope a snake will not climb there so the sages have to sit there snake will not climb scorpion will not climb there therefore…”

Since Mahaprabhu's time devotees have been sent to such places — Haridasa among Muslims, Prahlada in a demonic family, Hanuman among monkeys — and today devotees everywhere make the land holy, as Prabhupada established.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:37 (auto-transcript): “they do not disturb. Therefore it is necessary. But now all the time Mahatma Prabhu has done something wonderful. Since the time Mahatma Prabhu has sent devotees to these barren places. So all the places have become worshipful. Nithya never went to Ikka Chakra. Harada Sakura…”

children.topic: A disciple expands the master's work
children.note:
One is truly a disciple only by expanding what the spiritual master established, which needs empowerment from loyal, obedient following. It is not just a new name and dress, then eating and quarrelling and wasting the master's time. — “We become disciples because you have a higher responsibility.”

🎙 Maharaj at 39:42 (auto-transcript): “continue to expand it that is how a disciple should live his life a disciple is considered a disciple or is qualified to be disciples only if the disciple is expanding what the special master has established as a disciple and that requires empowerment it requires empowerment…”

Kikata is Bihar, traditionally called uncivilised, yet Mahaprabhu's associates such as Paramananda Puri came from there. The Lord is equal to all.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:10 (auto-transcript): “Chita Mohan Prabhu, he sent Swarudamodara Goswami, Swarudamodara Goswami is from Bihar, Parava, what is his name? He is also from Bihar. Therefore, the place is Swarudamodara Goswami. Yes, that's what I said. He is the first person I called. I was trying to call the second…”

children.topic: Culture is a quality, not a country
children.note:
A cultured person knows what not to do; a barbarian will cheat, insult and misbehave without shame. Good and bad people are found everywhere — children of brahmanas who drink, others who never touch it — and Krishna consciousness has now gone to every land.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:26 (auto-transcript): “living as a christian's equality as a lesson so places one a person is considered a decent person if one is cultured one one has a good behavior it's a good behavior a decent person who has who is cultured he knows i shouldn't do this thing as a cultural person no this is not…”

children.topic: Where the deity is, the house is pure
children.note:
Mahaprabhu accepted prasadam in householders' homes that worshipped the salagrama; without a deity, whose prasadam would it be? Places without deities are counted contaminated.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:08 (auto-transcript): “sri titan mahaprabhu accept prasada in the household house the house house means that house there is saragam silla means householders are is composed for householders who have deities saniasism don't have data because they are traveling this day we are having traveling…”

children.topic: A hundred thousand — names, not rupees
children.note:
One day Mahaprabhu said he would only eat with those who could give a hundred thousand. The householders despaired — until they understood he meant chanting a lakh of names, and begged for beads. — “one who is chanting 100,000 names”

🎙 Maharaj at 50:20 (auto-transcript): “And then one day Chita Mahou said, I will accept them only from one who has, who can pay 100,000 rupees. I will accept them from only those who have, who can pay 100,000 rupees. And the whole, all the house said, oh my Lord, where are we going to gain that? Where? 100,000?…”

Visiting a family that was not chanting, Maharaj declined their cooking: how can I eat? So that they could cook for him, they had to chant.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:35 (auto-transcript): “years ago I want to visit some devotees and I notice and notice the family are not chanting so they came want to cook for you I'm sorry I'm not eating why you're not chanting how can I eat so because they want to cook they have to chance and after i left at least we have to…”

Four questions from devotees.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:05 (auto-transcript): “I didn't say, it's in the scripture. I don't repeat it. If you have pictured, pictured deities in the water, that is the same, the same. The picture is the same. is the same we can keep that and do the offering yes give them nicely and offer your food yes they will eat and…”

Are picture deities the same? Yes — offer to them nicely and take the remnants.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:27 (auto-transcript): “If you have pictured, pictured deities in the water, that is the same, the same. The picture is the same. is the same we can keep that and do the offering yes give them nicely and offer your food yes they will eat and they will take the remnant like what makes very different…”

A temple and an ordinary building use the same cement and iron; the deity, scripture, chanting and kirtan make the difference. Prabhupada made temples everywhere, so wherever we go Krishna is there. — “Make every place a temple, everywhere it should be a temple.”

🎙 Maharaj at 56:15 (auto-transcript): “Make every place a temple, everywhere it should be a temple. Let there be temples everywhere, in Kredbhundavan everywhere. And Papa did it. Papa did that. 🎙 Maharaj at 57:03 (auto-transcript): “So, I want you to ask, if the rule of the Kanyoga is only on earth, or if it is in all the potent energy systems, so even he can harass Brahma, or it will be earth? Brahma is here. Brahma is here. He is in charge. So, whatever happens here, whatever happens here, he's…”

Brahma is responsible for everything here, but by his position he is not affected as we are; his work simply becomes harder.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:31 (auto-transcript): “So, whatever happens here, whatever happens here, he's responsible. He's not affected as we are, because of his position. He's wooden, he's wooden, he's cleaned up, so he's aware. He's controlled by the mode of passion, so he's in the mood. Kali has effect in everything.…”

Kali affects everything: less interest in the Bhagavatam, gambling and intoxication as the new religion. If you want to be famous, do something bad. — “you do something bad become famous”

🎙 Maharaj at 58:09 (auto-transcript): “Don't you see everything is going? People have less understanding about black water, less understanding, less appreciation, no interest. As brilliant and beautiful and as blind as it is, we have no interest it's a fact we don't appreciate the brahma's position because we…”

Minimising them is ignorance: once you start worshipping, the deities are present, seeing us and accepting every offering. — “Otherwise, how are they taking your, accepting your offerings?”

At a temple in Brazil the householders had moved away and stopped offering to the picture deities. Maharaj says the deities told him at night they were not being fed; next morning he corrected the devotees, taught the caretaker the mantras, and pointed out their Damodara was actually Laddu Gopal.

maps.title: SB Canto 11 · Class 22 · The Conception of Good and Bad

nodeData.topic: Class 22 · The Conception of Good and Bad
nodeData.note: SB 11.21.5–6 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. All bodies are made of the same five elements coming from Krishna, so good and bad are decided by the Lord's will, not by matter itself — giving grains on Ekadasi looks pious but is not. Maharaj explains that the problem is godlessness, that varnasrama gives names and forms so each person can work according to nature and progress, and that approaching the absolute good, Krishna, makes one good. Questions cover Ajamila's chanting, weakness versus deliberate sin, and when spiritual knowledge becomes visible. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: On Ekadasi, Maharaj continues Canto 11, chapter 21, Krishna's explanation of the Vedic path, from text 5.
The verse says that every embodied being, from Brahma down to the plants, has a body of earth, water, fire, air and ether, all coming from the one Lord.

All material activity rests on these five elements. Even the tiniest ant's body is the same stuff; Brahma simply gives it different shapes, small or large, and it all came from Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:38 (auto-transcript): “and sin yes five point b is the primary ingredient for material transactions all material activities are based on this element our material body is made from this the whole universe”

Today many people feed thousands of poor people grains in the name of piety. Maharaj says it is very dangerous: Krishna gave two days a month as a chance to get free, and on Ekadasi sin personified resides in grains. Good and bad must be learned from Krishna. — “But it is not piety. It is impious activity”

🎙 Maharaj at 20:12 (auto-transcript): “is auspicious today a courtesy people are going to this wood grains for people many people are going to be given grains in the name of piety this is piety so what is the piety here for the person who is doing it that is his consideration i'm feeding poor people who have less…”

A devotee is directed by Krishna and sees that everything belongs to him and is to be used for his pleasure, so rejecting anything is ignorance.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:38 (auto-transcript): “Because a devotee is directed by Krishna. So a devotee can apply things which doesn't look nice, literally speaking, in Christian consciousness. Because the understanding of a devotee is that everything belongs to Krishna and everything is to be used in Krishna's pleasure.…”

No one drinks gasoline, but it has a purpose. Maharaj argues it is not meant for transport or grease — a bullock cart needs none — but was placed in the ground by Krishna to fertilise the soil from which we get our food.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:25 (auto-transcript): “may not drink gasoline may not drink gasoline although it is liquid may not drink it because when it is bad for the body but the gasoline has a purpose for the universe. That is why Krishna put it in the soil, so that we can take it in a different way. How do we take gasoline…”

He remembers his father's harvests, so plentiful they could not all be gathered; now the same soil gives far less. And where people once died one at a time, accidents now kill ten or fifty at once — a misuse of Krishna's property.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:20 (auto-transcript): “soil for farming. I remember very clearly, it cannot completely harvest my father's crops because it's so much you harvest and leave some and continue the same soil you plant something there you don't get as before what has happened our demonic activity in using christmas…”

In earlier days cooking vessels, gold and gems were gathered from rivers, not factories; even now in parts of Nigeria special stones are found in the water. Digging for oil pollutes the whole atmosphere.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:23 (auto-transcript): “for those days those days the utensils for cooking were collected from barona from the risk from the river not from factory they were all pure from from the rivers you get to all these things they are pure diamond gold all of these things you don't have to dig down to get…”

Some fear that if good and bad are minimised people will become immoral. Maharaj says that is not the problem; the problem is that we are not godly. Those who follow nature's law are satisfied and prosperous; manipulating nature is unnecessary struggle. — “if we are godly we will not misuse anything”

🎙 Maharaj at 29:41 (auto-transcript): “meaning people will become immoral or anarchistic that is not the problem the problem is that we are not godly if we are godly we will not misuse anything we will use things as ordained by nature if we follow nature's law those who follow nature's law they are always happy…”

Prabhupada called it a struggle for existence, not happiness; a struggling person full of anxiety cannot be peaceful. Devotees have only spiritual anxiety — how to save the world from the danger now and ahead.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:55 (auto-transcript): “with nature so prophet said it is a struggle for existence it is not happiness it is a struggle for existence a struggling person cannot be peaceful because the amount of passion it's a struggle anxiety one can only be filled in so much anxiety one is peaceful without anxiety…”

Mundane piety without God is useless: poison drunk nicely is still poison. People on water beds take pills to sleep and wake with the same anxiety, while a dog sleeps peacefully on the floor.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:59 (auto-transcript): “modern piety is nothing useless modern piety is still useless if one drink poison very nicely it will act poison was here because he didn't very nicely poison it will act if you drink it nicely people sleep on their water bed but they don't have peaceful rest a dog is…”

children.topic: 11.21.6 — Names and forms for our goal
children.note: Though all bodies are made of the same elements, the Vedas give them different names and forms so that living beings can reach the goal of life — the varnasrama system.

Krishna created the four divisions by quality and work so that we can function and progress; it is material, not spiritual. Society is like a body with four departments, and the self-controlled brahmana is naturally the head.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:49 (auto-transcript): “these are necessary. The divisions are necessary. And Okwesha himself personally created it to give us a division so we can function. This is not spiritual. It is material. It is material to help us do something which is necessary for our progress. Without Baranasra, one…”

Human civilisation begins at the sudra, and that is an elevated place. Today we leave a master, a husband or a wife at the first discrepancy — when the money goes or beauty is lost; the sudra stays loyal whatever the master is. — “Sudras are very truthful and are very loyal to the master.”

🎙 Maharaj at 36:42 (auto-transcript): “if a sutra is the beginning of civilization civilization begins from sudra not less Yes, militia, java, ambiras, castles, polinas, tiratas, and loo, lower than sudra. Sudra position is very elevated, very elevated, because it's the beginning of civilization, the beginning of…”

Someone asked Maharaj where Mandodari went after a lifetime with a demon. She is counted among the five chaste women: she accepted Lord Ramacandra and remained with Ravana out of duty, and duty performed purifies. — “When you read the scripture, this is what you should think.”

🎙 Maharaj at 40:03 (auto-transcript): “taught the teachings of the scripture. Somebody asked me, where did Mandodari go, Mandodari? Yeah, where did he go? Everybody said demon, so where did he go? Calculating the stars. Just say the planets, I'm going to check it. Somebody asked me the question, now I am asking…”

Ajamila lived with a prostitute until death, yet the Yamadutas could not take him: he chanted Narayana, and the Visnudutas told them they did not know what religion is.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:11 (auto-transcript): “One who associates was the argument between Vishnu Duttas and Yama Duttas. Jamila were living with his property till death. So, you're not qualified for hell? It's qualified for hell. But Vishnu Duttas said, no, you don't understand what is religion. You understand? The…”

Without varnasrama everyone copies whatever makes money — a road lined with people all roasting corn, or everyone becoming a musician. Work that suits one's nature may not make one rich, but brings peace; Prabhupada said he would have established varnasrama had he had more time.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:28 (auto-transcript): “In the material world, if trading on clothes makes someone rich, everybody will start trading on clothes. So, when you go to market, you see the whole community doing the same thing, right? From indoor to village, by the roadside, the long queue. Everybody was roasting con on…”

The absolute good is Krishna himself, and whatever approaches him becomes good, as an object approaching the sun grows hotter until it becomes fire. Varnasrama connects us to him, and we develop his qualities.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:01 (auto-transcript): “The absolute good is the Supreme Lord himself and that which approaches the Supreme Lord becomes similarly good. The absolute good is the Supreme Lord himself and that good approaches the Supreme Lord”

Connected with Krishna, we develop his qualities and enter his nature. What else do we want?

🎙 Maharaj at 53:45 (auto-transcript): “until it merges into fire you understand paranasana is still connected with krishna and when we are connected with krishna what will become our experience we will also develop krishna's qualities right we develop krishna's qualities krishna is so also we develop this quality…”

Four questions and comments from devotees.

🎙 Maharaj at 55:45 (auto-transcript): “knowledge becomes visible all right Hare Krishna he comments yes understand the glories of women that the other side is that it is one of the offences to you know have a sinful life while you're chanting you are being yes so then how do we understand it”

Living sinfully while chanting is an offence — so how was Ajamila delivered?

🎙 Maharaj at 56:15 (auto-transcript): “understand the glories of women that the other side is that it is one of the offences to you know have a sinful life while you're chanting you are being yes so then how do we understand it ajayamela did namabas not namah paratha his chanting was namabas not namah paratha what…”

Ajamila simply called his son, with no plan to sin on the strength of the name. Chanting extra rounds on Ekadasi so that one can break principles — that is the offence. — “he simply called his son”

🎙 Maharaj at 56:34 (auto-transcript): “ajayamela did namabas not namah paratha his chanting was namabas not namah paratha what is namah paratha let me oh today is a kadhasi i will break principle i will chant 64 and pray to Jagannath. That is Namabas. Namabas, he simply called his son. It was his son he called. No…”

Weakness is not something we justify with pride. Krishna in the heart knows our intent: one who feels bad, condemns his weakness and prays seriously for strength gets help; one who uses scripture to justify sin does not. — “pray seriously for strength you get help”

🎙 Maharaj at 58:14 (auto-transcript): “So that means the practicing devotees, who, out of their weakness, if they are committing some mistakes, there is none of us yes if but someone weakness someone's weakness weakness weakness is not something we do with pride those who does not justify their weakness they don't…”

children.topic: Q2 · When does knowledge become visible?
children.note:
The purport says one comes to material goodness, where spiritual knowledge becomes visible. What is that?

🎙 Maharaj at 60:22 (auto-transcript): “to the platform of material goodness where upon spiritual knowledge becomes visible yes so with this what i understood is with our sadhana we come to the material goodness but the spiritual knowledge your spiritual experience becomes visible what is that thing we start to…”

At first we practise because we are told to; with purification we chant whether or not anyone is watching, because now we understand the purpose.

🎙 Maharaj at 61:47 (auto-transcript): “practicing christian consciousness because we are told to do this okay we are doing that but we have not realized it it is not about decision yet by doing this we'll get prepared and come to the stage that ah okay yes yes yes we are doing it now deliberately not because okay…”

When practice is purpose-driven, everything about it changes. Gadadhara Pandita saw this in Pundarika Vidyanidhi: devotion shining in his life, fixed and unshakable. — “Determination will be different, understanding is different, the progress will be different.”

🎙 Maharaj at 62:41 (auto-transcript): “realized become known so now we know the purpose so if we are christian conscious purpose driven many of us are not we are not christian purpose driven for so many reasons we are here for those Because you are Christian purpose-driven, their practice will be different.…”

children.topic: Q3 · Grains for birds on Ekadasi?
children.note:
Then why are birds fed grains every day, even on Ekadasi?

🎙 Maharaj at 64:29 (auto-transcript): “but then why let people feed the grains to birth every day even on Ekadashi is not the fire for birth is okay but not for human beings, animals don't have Russian regulations The human beings we have rules and regulations, therefore to give human beings grains is very…”

Feeding birds is fine; animals have no rules. Human beings do, so giving people grains on Ekadasi is not piety.

🎙 Maharaj at 64:36 (auto-transcript): “for birth is okay but not for human beings, animals don't have Russian regulations The human beings we have rules and regulations, therefore to give human beings grains is very dangerous, it's not piety, it's not religion, it's demonic. In continuation to your answer on…”

Does keeping inner dialogue positive while admitting mistakes and working on weaknesses help?

🎙 Maharaj at 65:17 (auto-transcript): “In continuation to your answer on weakness, if we try to keep our internal dialogue positive despite our mistakes, weaknesses, But we do completely, we are at mistake and need to rectify while diligently working upon our weakness by reminding ourselves. Does such mentality…”

Yes: constantly feeling remorse, praying seriously for help and working on it — that is where we get help. Keep this mentality.

🎙 Maharaj at 65:46 (auto-transcript): “No, that is good. That is good. That is where we get the help. When one is constantly feeling remorseful about one's weakness and we are trying to be seriously praying for help and working towards that. We are looking towards that, we get help. This is positive. We are…”

Thinking 'this is my karma, nothing can be done' is dangerous; we have been given the chance to rise above our weaknesses. — “That is dangerous mentality.”

🎙 Maharaj at 66:13 (auto-transcript): “We are thinking, well, this is my karma, so there's nothing I can do. That is dangerous mentality. No, no. We have been given chance. We have been given chance to rise above the weaknesses. We get help with this kind of mentality, very good. So keep the mentality. Praying, we…”

maps.title: SB Canto 11 · Class 21 · What To Do and What Not To Do? How to Decide?

nodeData.topic: Class 21 · What To Do and What Not To Do? How to Decide?
nodeData.note: SB 11.21.3–4 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Material ideas of pure and impure, good and bad, auspicious and inauspicious are necessary but relative, shifting with time, place and person; only Krishna can say what is truly good. Mundane religion with endless rules becomes a burden and breeds doubt, while devotion depending on Krishna's mercy is joyful for the pure soul. In the questions Maharaj speaks on truth, regulated enjoyment, Indra's envy of serious practitioners, and why Krishna waits until we are tired of sin. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: After a sound check, Maharaj continues Canto 11, chapter 21, Krishna's explanation of the Vedic path to Uddhava, from text 3.
The verse explains that to know what is proper one must evaluate things within each sphere: purity in religion, good and bad in ordinary dealings, auspicious and inauspicious for bodily survival.

What is good for me may be bad for you, and what I call auspicious you may not. These dualities are imperfect because they change with time, place and circumstance — even philosophies. — “anything which is affected by time and place or circumstances is relative”

🎙 Maharaj at 11:12 (auto-transcript): “what is good what is bad because what is good for me may not be good for you what is bad for you will be good for me what i consider auspicious or inauspicious this is relative religion and”

Even acaryas seem to differ: one says a pastime took place on the bank of the Yamuna, another on the Ganga. Both are correct, because at that spot the two rivers flow together.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:16 (auto-transcript): “our own acharyas they say something quick they say they contract it one acharya said sugare goswami spoke about them at the bank of jamuna one acharya said it is the bank of ganga we know that the jury was different persons came in to say that what of them are going the jewa…”

Each sphere has its own language: in social dealings we say good or bad; of water we say pure or impure; in religious life we say an activity is auspicious when it helps our practice, and a holy place is called sanctified, not merely good.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:51 (auto-transcript): “understood in our social dealings, in our social dealings, in a civil way, in a civil way we say you is good we say the best we say is not the pure water in Canada we'll say good and bad but there's something like water we don't say good”

children.topic: Only Krishna decides good and bad
children.note:
Neither of us can say finally what is good and bad; only Krishna can. The scripture says do not lie — yet what each of us calls a lie is relative.

🎙 Maharaj at 16:22 (auto-transcript): “so this is bad this is good both of us are not correct the only person who can tell what is good what is bad is only Krishna can say the scripture said do not tell a lie so what do you understand to be lying what I understand to be”

At Kurukshetra Krishna asked not Arjuna but Yudhisthira, the most truthful, to tell a lie. He hesitated, and Maharaj says his chariot, which never touched the ground, then came down. The absolute authority is Krishna; we should not hesitate to do what he says.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:34 (auto-transcript): “For Krishan to Yudhisthya Maharashto, he didn't tell a Jun to say it. Krishan didn't tell a Jun to say it. The main character of Krishetra is a Jun. For Krishan didn't tell a Jun to tell a, he told Yudhisthya Maharashto, tell the lie. So Krishan is lie. Krishna or Yudhisthya?…”

Bhima drinking blood, and other deeds done on the Lord's word, raise the question which is religion and which irreligion. Maharaj's answer: draw the conclusion from Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:18 (auto-transcript): “What Christian said, you should do. Bim Senna, he drank the blood. The Godhead's word, he sold somebody. He didn't change anybody. Which one is religion? Which is irreligion? Which one? It is illegal to hesitate to draw our conclusion from Krishna, our conclusion from God.”

During the pandemic many people became wealthy while others went bankrupt. Good and bad fortune here are relative.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:31 (auto-transcript): “The time of pandemic is the time most people make money. People became wealthy. What if you became bankrupt? Pfizer company was bankrupt. 2019 became big.”

children.topic: Clean and dirty depend on who
children.note:
Distinctions of clean and dirty, healthy and unhealthy, exist as long as we are in the body, but they differ by person: what is clean for one class is dirty for another, and food one can eat would make another sick.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:51 (auto-transcript): “this distinction is as far as the living entity spiritual is there there may be distinction what is religion what is irrelevant what is good what is bad bad for the health good health bad health this is dirty this is clean these distinctions are out there what is clean is…”

A careful driver still has accidents. Now machines let us check our blood every five minutes, yet a person can be declared perfectly fine and be dead five minutes later; many devotees have been told one day they have only days to live. — “Just check everything, just check and everything is perfect.”

🎙 Maharaj at 26:20 (auto-transcript): “One may be a good and experiencing careful driver. Still, we have accidents. A person can go every day to go and check. Medical checkup every day. You can do that. Every day, check your blood. Now we have easy machine. Easy machine, you don't have to even go to hospital.…”

We distinguish things so that we can be careful, but ultimately the outcome is in Krishna's hands.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:15 (auto-transcript): “to distinguish one thing from another, so you can be careful. But ultimately, Krishna has a financier. That's the ultimate concern. Krishna has the financier. Desperse one's careful calculation of that which is materially healthy and unhealthy, the physical body will collapse…”

There is a transcendental good beyond relative good. Everything we see, hear and do is a success if it takes us to Krishna consciousness, where life is eternal and full of bliss and knowledge. — “Outside this, it's a failure.”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:42 (auto-transcript): “That is the culmination of everything. It is the culmination of everything. Everything that we do, everything that we do, we see, we hear, we experience, we go. Whatever it takes us to, that is success. Outside this, it's a failure. Where life is eternal, full of bliss and…”
Krishna says he has revealed this path for those weighed down by mundane religious rules; without Krishna consciousness, endless rules and prohibitions are only a burden.

Many people became faithless not for lack of religious knowledge but because of it: Kanada says this, Jaimini that, Patanjali, Gautama and Kapila something else. Which is correct? A foolish person concludes: I believe none of them.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:15 (auto-transcript): “prescribing countless religious duties. Where do they lead one to? People became faithless. Many people became faithless not because they are left of religious knowledge, but because of the knowledge Israel makes people become faithless. People became doubtful. People became…”

The first lesson of journalism school, Maharaj says, is to believe nobody; whatever you tell a journalist, he will write something different.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:24 (auto-transcript): “would conclude, I don't believe all of them. For those who have gone to journalism school, the first thing they will teach you is don't believe anybody. So if a journalist intervenes you, talk what you want to do, he's going to write something different. that's the training…”

Some years ago Maharaj was very sick; allopathic, homeopathic and natural doctors each forbade different foods until almost nothing was left. You go to be cured and come back with rules you cannot keep — religion becomes the same when it only confuses. — “You have gone to the doctor to get cured.”

🎙 Maharaj at 35:26 (auto-transcript): “So there's so many rules. And also, if you look at our doctors, I'm a party, homeopathy, natural party, that's why I said, don't take this, don't take this, don't take this one, no, no, no, no, take this, take this, don't take that, no, no, no, don't take that, don't take…”

Religion is meant to destroy doubt. A pure teacher gives a direction leading to Krishna, not to more confusion and suffering; Kali-yuga's religious wars push people to follow no one. — “the path is made clear so we can see where we are going”

🎙 Maharaj at 37:43 (auto-transcript): “to be able to distinguish clearly, there is confusion and nothing else. Confusion. Is that what religion is supposed to do? Or doubt supposed to be destroyed? All he's given is destroyed. And the path is made clear so we can see where we are going. That is a perfect teacher a…”

children.topic: The Gita kept as a magic book
children.note:
On sankirtana in Nigeria a man ran after Maharaj's party; they hoped for a customer, but he already had the Gita — kept among mystical books and read secretly to cheat people. Many editions of the Gita exist without understanding who Krishna is.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:17 (auto-transcript): “souls in thousands of millions one day in nigeria one sankita one man was running after us sankita when running wait wait there's somebody calling us so literally we expected yeah a good customer is coming to buy a book and he can't have your book it's power guitar in nigeria…”
Quoting the Gita's final instruction, Maharaj explains that dharma, artha, kama and moksa are all set aside; devotion is a fifth goal, outside the four, and through it one understands Krishna.

Devotion is called joyfully performed, but we are struggling. Maharaj explains it is joyful for the pure soul, its eternal occupation; for the struggling neophyte it is still an effort. — “On the conditioned platform it is not a joyful activity.”

🎙 Maharaj at 43:26 (auto-transcript): “This word, Sushukam, devotional activities, and joyfully performed. That word is this means Sushukam, means what? It is joyfully performed. How joyfully is the regularity principle? How joyfully is the regularity principle? It's easy, regularity principle, simple. Everybody…”

How many struggle just to give up garlic and onion! One man said his doctor told him he would fall sick without them; Maharaj told him the doctor did not know. Two years later the man was initiated with his family. — “tell that doctor, he doesn't know what he's doing.”

🎙 Maharaj at 45:28 (auto-transcript): “How many people are struggling to give up garlic and onion? What is this? Garlic and onion. How many people are struggling just garlic and onion? People are struggling seriously to give it up. But some of the philosophers, one man told me, you know, doctor said if I don't get…”

Three questions from devotees.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:26 (auto-transcript): “In general when I used to define good and bad, so to teach something to other devotees, so I define it like what is good for yourself and society both can be termed as good and if it is not citing this criteria, then it is termed as bad, so that usually fits in all the…”

A devotee defines good as what benefits oneself and society, and asks how good can be relative.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:26 (auto-transcript): “In general when I used to define good and bad, so to teach something to other devotees, so I define it like what is good for yourself and society both can be termed as good and if it is not citing this criteria, then it is termed as bad, so that usually fits in all the…”

What do you mean by true? Honesty is one thing, but the truth is Krishna; approach those who have seen him. — “But truth is only Krishna.”

🎙 Maharaj at 51:21 (auto-transcript): “is good in this world in this world what is good what is truthfulness what is truthfulness truthful in this world say what is true or right what is true what is true what do you mean by true that i can say this is true ultimately what you said to be true that is krishna…”

We say 'good money', yet it keeps us anxious and sleepless. If I cheat you, it feels good to me — until I start paying for it.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:43 (auto-transcript): “So I said good money. good money sir how good is the money you're full of anxiety didn't sleep well in the night and you're praying the days will not come but i'm telling you good money sir yeah good money but how good is it relative yes if i cheat you that is good for me…”

People accept that alcohol damages the liver, yet in certain circumstances a ksatriya may drink or eat meat. What suits a ksatriya does not suit a brahmana — the same soul in different lives.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:02 (auto-transcript): “You don't see that. Who thinks that alcohol is batting? It's enjoyment. Yes! Right? That's enjoyment. People in general accept it, that it damages your liver, so it is bad. We have that line. A satire can drink alcohol and the liver will not be damaged. Like Bhim said, I am…”

Why does sense gratification advance us when done by the Vedas? Maharaj: acting on the scripture's authority restrains us from acting like animals and gradually purifies; doing it on our own, even little by little, is still poison.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:52 (auto-transcript): “We can make advancements by the... Because it was mentioned in the Vedas. Yes. I do not understand anything. If you gratify the senses according to the scripture, you make advancements. If we do it on our own, we don't make advancements. Even if you think that, yeah, I will…”

children.topic: Q3 · Does Indra cause our troubles?
children.note:
Is Indra simply the instrument of our karma, or can he trouble us without it? Maharaj: something will be connected.

🎙 Maharaj at 58:16 (auto-transcript): “One of the challenges we face in our lives is caused by Indra, which we don't know. What? Indra, which we don't know. And then in the procedure, you heard that there are three causes of our suffering. One is ultimate cause, which is me, which is my karma. Second, there is the…”

Anyone in serious tapasya attracts Indra's eye; he disturbed Nara-Narayana and Prthu Maharaja, whose hundredth sacrifice was halted when the Lord intervened. Fools he ignores; serious devotees meet more challenges, which become stepping stones.

🎙 Maharaj at 59:29 (auto-transcript): “Any person who is engaged in serious tapasya will become attracted to Indra. They start looking at you carefully. What is he looking for? What is he looking for? My position? No. You start to attack. So our activities are attracting him. he did to Pritho Maharaj. Pritho…”

Envy is very dangerous: the envious person cannot see reality and only wants others to stay and suffer with him. — “it blinds the person who is envious”

🎙 Maharaj at 61:31 (auto-transcript): “envy is a very tick cotton thick cotton envy very dangerous very dangerous cotton Yes, it's dangerous, it blinds the person who is envious and sees the reality. And this person is not looking for me, not because of me, not because of my position. They will not see that. Why…”

Let us suffer together, cry more than me — devotees also hold pity parties when frustrated in their hearts because they are not practising.

🎙 Maharaj at 62:04 (auto-transcript): “You're supposed to be suffering like me. Why do you want to leave me here alone? Stay here, let us suffer together. If we are many suffering together, it's peaceful. Don't don't leave me so I will feel empty no person to share my frustration what? The good they say we have a…”

When devotees once asked why their progress mattered to anyone else, Maharaj said: if you do not advance you will envy those who do and spread your anxiety to everyone. Advancing, we appreciate others.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:14 (auto-transcript): “And then a few years ago in Benda, when I was speaking about the importance of making advancement, and the devotees asked me, what is important? Because if I don't make advancement, it's my problem. I said, no, it is not their problem. If you don't make advancement, it will…”

Something good feels like a challenge to the impure, just as a criminal hates hearing the police and pays before eating so he can run. Maharaj's spiritual master said Prabhupada did not create a society for us to come and suffer.

🎙 Maharaj at 66:13 (auto-transcript): “anything good will become a to challenge your impurity anything good so sometimes you see people are really devilish they don't want to see the water because it's a challenge when they see the water become disturbed like a thief is seeing a police how does he feel even though…”

children.topic: Krishna waits until we are tired
children.note:
While we are enjoying sin, Krishna will not take it away; when we are tired of it and seriously beg, he takes it. He forces no one.

🎙 Maharaj at 68:03 (auto-transcript): “if we are enjoying our sinful life we are attached to the simple thing we do christian will not take it out only when christian sees that we are tired of it then christian will take it out if christian see we are tired and we are seriously begging and freeing freeing the…”

When Maharaj's guru received a chief's title in Nigeria, a visitor said, you are a king now — don't you need a queen? He laughed: I have seen everything inside; there is nothing there for me.

🎙 Maharaj at 69:30 (auto-transcript): “But when one is tired, one devotee, his grace said, Sureshwarafam, he was telling him how When Guruji was given a cheap tensile title in Nigeria, so he came to Guruji family and he said, Maharaj, you have become a king now. A senior disciple told how, as a young American girl into everything, she dropped it all the moment Prabhupada said it was dangerous, and never went back. Why can't it happen to us?

🎙 Maharaj at 72:17 (auto-transcript): “So in the lectures, she told us how, as an American girl, I was into everything, everything, everything. But the moment Prabhupada said this is a dangerous thing, she said give it up. she dropped everything completely till today why it happened to her cannot happen to us…”

We tell ourselves, nobody has ever had my problem, so the solutions do not apply to me. Maharaj asks how special we really are. — “But how special are you that your problem is the only in the whole universe?”

🎙 Maharaj at 73:38 (auto-transcript): “You don't know, you don't know my problem. Nobody has ever had my problem. My problem is different from your problem. nodeData.topic: Class 20 · Check Where You Are in Spiritual Life
nodeData.note: SB 11.21.1–2 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Krishna names three ways of rising — devotion, philosophical analysis and regulated duty — and warns that those who drop them for sense gratification keep falling. Maharaj explains how duty purifies, purification brings knowledge and knowledge brings renunciation, and he warns against artificial renunciation: we should honestly see that we are still at the stage of rules and regulations, and engage our senses practically. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: The chapter: Krishna explains the Vedic path
children.note: Srimad-Bhagavatam Canto 11, chapter 21, in which Lord Krishna explains the Vedic path to Uddhava. This class begins from text 1.

children.topic: 11.21.1 — Three ways up, one way down
children.note: The verse contrasts those who take up devotion, analytic philosophy or regulated duty with those who give them up for petty sense pleasure and keep turning in material existence.

Maharaj cites the Gita's description of how one falls step by step through sense gratification, and adds that we are already falling, because sense gratification is meant for lower species, not for human beings.

Citing the Gita's third chapter, Maharaj calls lust the soul's eternal enemy: it keeps the conditioned soul in prison, just as prisoners are kept behind bars.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:45 (auto-transcript): “three the enemy the pure soul nature virena nature virena the eternal enemy of the soul sanctification the proper proper said christian keep conditional soul in prison by lost just as prisoners are kept behind bars a disobedience or deviance now so”

These three processes are the way up, and there is no second way. No one can say, I am just neutral: either we are going up, or we are staying conditioned and extending our suffering. — “either we are following the process of going up”

🎙 Maharaj at 21:42 (auto-transcript): “educational prescribed duties these three processes are for going up there is no second way about it there's no question of imagine I'm not there I'm not there i'm just neutral this that does not exist either we are following the process of going up or we are following the…”

Those who are tired of suffering will hear this and take up Krishna consciousness; those not yet tired will not hear it and will carry on as before.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:18 (auto-transcript): “tired of suffering they will take the christian consensus they will hear this and take the issue those who are tired of suffering but those who are not tired of suffering yet will not hear this we will continue with our sinful process so we should know very carefully the…”

Maharaj says no one can enjoy the senses better than the animals, for whom it is designed — like a language you learn but can never speak as well as one born to it. Animals do not cook meat; we must cook and salt it to bring it to our level, and still it is never the same. We are trying to become animals by force.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:29 (auto-transcript): “we will continue with our sinful process so we should know very carefully the question of sanctification we cannot do it better than the animals it's for saying education no one can do it more than the animals it is meant for them it is meant for them no one can do it better…”

children.topic: Human by consciousness, not by body
children.note:
One is considered human only when one voluntarily and happily avoids what is meant for animals and does what is meant for human beings. — “We are not human beings because we carry the body.”

🎙 Maharaj at 24:39 (auto-transcript): “avoid activities meant for animals and activities that we should do, we should voluntarily, happily follow the path. That is when one is considered to be a human being. We are not human beings because we carry the body. We are human beings because we have the consciousness of…”

Analytic philosophy and prescribed duties are both laborious, and that austerity is what purifies.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:14 (auto-transcript): “analytic philosophy Sankhya studying all the material element that make this universe it is a laborious part but eventually one will come to who is the owner of all this element that is the conclusion of analytic story eventually one come to this point who is the master the…”

Studying the material elements in detail is a long road, but eventually one asks who the owner and master of all of them is, and then takes to Krishna consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:27 (auto-transcript): “universe it is a laborious part but eventually one will come to who is the owner of all this element that is the conclusion of analytic story eventually one come to this point who is the master the Lord of all this as a conclusion when one study this philosophy you come to…”

When the senses are satisfied according to the Vedas, one advances; outside the scripture there is no advancement. The Vedic way has austerity in it; sense gratification on its own has none. — “the part of sense gratification there is no austerity”

🎙 Maharaj at 26:06 (auto-transcript): “are designed for human beings in the vedas if one gratified essence is based on the scriptures you make advancement if you gratify the senses outside the scripture will be condemned no advancement because the vedas will theorize it why because one is fooling the vedas there…”

children.topic: A king who followed the scripture
children.note:
Maharaj gives the example of a king (apparently Pracinabarhi) whose activities were all based on scripture and who therefore received the blessing. By these processes one attains Krishna's mercy; by other ways we only continue our suffering.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:13 (auto-transcript): “so it is regulated prescribed duties prescribed duties in the scripture it was this prescribed duties that Prachina Barai Sallamahara was doing and he got the blessing of the community he was doing that all his activities were based on the scripture so he got the message…”
The verse defines piety as remaining fixed in one's own position and impiety as deviating from it.

Material or spiritual, nothing succeeds without steadiness. Steady practice will succeed; deviation is the opposite.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:05 (auto-transcript): “Steadiness. Variegated location I recommend being steady. 1426. I want to be steady in anything that we do, material is spiritual if we are not steady we cannot succeed steadiness in our position steady in our practice will succeed deviation is the opposite in the previous…”

Maharaj traces the progress: duty performed and offered to Krishna, even with some expectation, purifies; purification brings knowledge; knowledge brings renunciation; renunciation helps one become a pure devotee who understands his relationship with Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:02 (auto-transcript): “this is the progress from karma yoga when one to perform his prescribed duty offering the result of fund the result fructively to Krishna with some expectation there is purification the purification that brings one to the stage of knowledge by regulated devotion series it…”

Real renunciation is not ignorance; one knows why one gives something up and why one does something else. — “Renunciation is due to knowledge.”

🎙 Maharaj at 33:15 (auto-transcript): “will bring us to the stage of renunciation. Renunciation is true wisdom, proper said. It is not ignorance. Renunciation is due to knowledge. Why should I give up this? Why should I do this? Why shouldn't I do this? And prescribed duty brings us to knowledge. Knowledge takes…”

Tell someone, give me your paycheck, and they will ask why — who are you in my life? One who has knowledge never asks Krishna why, because he knows that by giving everything to Krishna, Krishna removes his sins and takes care of him.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:53 (auto-transcript): “that why should I do that if you tell someone give me your paycheck why naturally the question be why why should I give to you who are you in my life I will give you my paycheck why are you going to take care of my necessities who are you but one who has knowledge one will…”

Krishna did not simply tell Arjuna to fight; he gave him the reason and showed him the result, and asked him to think of him while doing his duty.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:14 (auto-transcript): “our prescribed duty how to how to perform a prescribed duty what what kind of consciousness christian explained it by gita christian thought that june while you are doing your duty you should think of me should think of me christian did not just tell adjun to fight he gave…”

Devotional service is taken up by greatly fortunate persons. When piety accumulates to a very high level, it becomes the fortune that gives us the chance to practise Krishna consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:55 (auto-transcript): “devotional service is performed by greatly fortunate persons not people who have piety when our piety accumulates to a high level then one becomes fortunate that fortune will give us chance to practice this unconsciousness yes he then sees that his conditional life as well as…”

children.topic: Disgust is a sign of advancement
children.note:
As one advances, sense gratification looks abominable, something a human being should not do. Looking back, one wonders how one spent so long competing with animals and calling it human life. — “If we are still appreciating, it means we are still low, very low in consciousness.”

🎙 Maharaj at 37:20 (auto-transcript): “consciousness this is the process material sanctification will be considered obnoxious activity we considered this eating stew they will be considered an abomination the thing which a human being should not do. When we look at sanctification, we are disgust. And this is a…”

A devotee told Maharaj he only wanted to sit and read and hear about Krishna, doing nothing else. Maharaj asked: will you also eat? Then you should chant and preach too. Artificial renunciation does not come from realisation, and it will uproot you into something worse.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:18 (auto-transcript): “One devotee asked me, I just want to sit down and read, just read about Krishna, not doing anything else. want to read about krishna just hear krishna continuously no other activities i say will you eat also will you eat just read i would eat then if you will eat you should…”

children.topic: Krishna's pastimes are not for imitation
children.note:
Krishna performed his intimate pastimes for himself and his qualified friends; they are shown to attract the fortunate. Thinking we are there simply by hearing is artificial, and it ends up fuelling our own sense gratification.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:36 (auto-transcript): “is called artificial it is not real so it is not recommended when one hear about krishna's transcendental activities yesterday we explained krishna did not perform this thing for us he didn't do it for us he did it for himself and his intimate friends who are qualified for…”

children.topic: Envy shows we are not there
children.note:
No one is envious when everyone has the same plate. Asking why Krishna does this or that comes from envy: it is his property, and nobody asks why I use my own phone or my own glasses.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:52 (auto-transcript): “because they are qualified they are participating one does not become envious of someone who is eating the same food to others right because on this one someone is eating more than what we oh it has a other preparation which is not my plate thank you what is that if…”

children.topic: Where are we? Yama and niyama
children.note:
Yoga begins from rules and regulations, before posture and breath control. Maharaj asks the room where we stand — and our bodies are not getting younger. — “yama niyama that is where we are we still struggling with principles”

🎙 Maharaj at 43:50 (auto-transcript): “of transcendence and we're explaining look at our stage what are we doing in our christian consciousness yoga begins from where yoga begins from where yama and niyama right rules are regulations before you go to to asana to then to pranayama right where are we where are we at…”

Our senses have been dulled by sense gratification, so we do not yet appreciate Krishna consciousness. Maharaj recalls Mahaprabhu's teaching that karma and jnana dull the senses while bhakti makes them sharp.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:33 (auto-transcript): “dealing with the detection of the senses which is mastered by the mind this is what we're still dealing with the mind is not clear about anything what is christian consciousness our senses are not sharp about christian consciousness our senses have been dull due to…”

We are only beginning to see how dangerous sense gratification is; we still plan it seriously, and Krishna consciousness becomes secondary while the chanting beads hang unused. — “The bead is hanging there, starving.”

🎙 Maharaj at 47:30 (auto-transcript): “the illusion of entire life beginning beginning not realizing just trying to realize how dangerous is sanctification still is deeply appreciated single person is deeply appreciated and we meditate and plan seriously how to execute it by doing that no time for most devotees…”

Do something practical: learn to cook, to clean, to present Krishna consciousness. The mind's old training is sense gratification, our addiction; we should do what eventually leads to bhakti — deity worship and chanting.
