We can begin from offensive chanting; the holy name is so powerful that even that has great effect.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:38 (auto-transcript): “bhakti engage in deity worship so practice how to chant the holy name at least we begin from offensive chanting at least beginning from it the holy name is so powerful that even offensive chanting is very powerful very boss no nothing compared harida securie cannot campaign…”

Maharaj tells how Haridasa Thakura said that even a glimpse of the holy name surpasses the highest impersonal realisation, and a proud brahmana mocked him as an illiterate. Haridasa answered humbly that he had heard it from them — they recite the scripture but do not hear it.

Someone may speak the Bhagavatam without any ecstasy, without knowing what it is, and Maharaj says this happens even in our movement. Parrots memorise and repeat perfectly, but without bhakti they do not go back to Godhead. — “they repeat it perfectly but they're not going to go”

children.topic: The godbrother who left his family
children.note:
In Maharaj's early days a godbrother, married with two children, abandoned them to live in the temple. Years later his family brought the wife and children, and the wife said she was ready to follow; he refused, quoting philosophy. Some years later he married again improperly, broke the principles and was caught.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:16 (auto-transcript): “stage of directly practicing christian consciousness yes during our early days one god brother he was married before he came to know about christian consciousness he was married yeah with two kids so when he came to understand christian consciousness he abandoned the wife and…”

He called it Maya and asked whether they wanted him to take back his vomit. Maharaj, new then, admired his philosophy and was ashamed — but it was whimsical, and whimsy was punished. — “Prabhu, you want me to take my vomit?”

🎙 Maharaj at 59:10 (auto-transcript): “This devotee said he would never. He was quoting philosophy. Prabhu, you want me to take my vomit? That's what you are telling me to do? You are encouraging me to take my vomit? Prabhu, what is this? Maya! What are you talking? Krishna saved my life. You want me to go back?…”

In anything, and especially in Krishna consciousness, we must learn from the acaryas and those who have succeeded. Pure devotees share their realisations; following them we succeed. — “Those who are successful in the process, we should learn from their wisdom.”

🎙 Maharaj at 61:52 (auto-transcript): “So we should learn from what experienced devotees, we should learn from those who are experienced in anything that you want to do, especially in Christian consciousness, we must learn from our chariots. Those who are successful in the process, we should learn from their…”

One question from the floor.

🎙 Maharaj at 62:43 (auto-transcript): “So we understand the traditional bhakti and when they are trying to force ourselves to don't know, they look the same? Do you understand the difference between artificial practicing and genuine practice? Because they look the same. And even if you look carefully, the…”

children.topic: Q1 · Real or artificial — how to tell?
children.note:
Genuine and artificial devotion look the same, and the artificial is often more prominent. How do we identify which is real?

🎙 Maharaj at 62:43 (auto-transcript): “So we understand the traditional bhakti and when they are trying to force ourselves to don't know, they look the same? Do you understand the difference between artificial practicing and genuine practice? Because they look the same. And even if you look carefully, the…”

It is not difficult. Krishna in the heart directs even the conditioned soul; a sincere person will be shown who is doing right and who is not. If we are crooked, everything becomes difficult. — “We don't need perfection yet, just sincerity.”

🎙 Maharaj at 63:12 (auto-transcript): “So how do you identify which is real, which is artificial? Not difficult. A devotee who is very, very sincere. We don't need perfection yet, just sincerity. Krishna will direct us. We don't need to become a pure devotee before Krishna direct. Christian's duty in staying with…”

children.topic: Both are placed together on purpose
children.note:
Krishna deliberately keeps the genuine and the artificial in the same place so that we can make our choice, because many of us are not clear about what we want.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:42 (auto-transcript): “Christian's duty in staying with the heart is to direct us at the conditional stage or at the professional stage. It's always directing. The person who is very sincere Christian will show you who is doing the right thing and who is doing the wrong thing. And Christian leave…”

A snake charmer sang a mantra glorifying Ananta; Haridasa Thakura heard it and fell unconscious in ecstasy. The charmer stood aside respectfully until he recovered. Then a brahmana, envious that a 'sudra' was honoured, threw himself on the ground imitating — and the charmer beat him until he ran away.

nodeData.topic: Class 19 · Guru, the Disciple's Life and Soul
nodeData.note: SB 11.3.22 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Maharaj explains what it means to accept the spiritual master as one's life and soul: a disciple has offered his head and no longer acts for himself, hears with an attentive mind, and deals without duplicity. Krishna, who sells himself to his devotees, gives himself to such a faithful disciple — real life begins there, and only then is the Bhagavatam truly revealed. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Prabuddha's instruction to Nimi: accept the spiritual master as one's life and worshipable deity and learn from him the devotional service that satisfies the Lord, who then gives himself.

children.topic: Guru as one's life and soul
children.note:
Everyone has heard 'accept a spiritual master'. Maharaj asks: with what attitude? The verse says — as one's life and soul. That is the disciple's state of consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:56 (auto-transcript): “If you look at this verse carefully, the recommendation is given here that one should accept the spiritual master. What condition? It's a common word which we use. Accept the spiritual master. We have heard this many times. Accept the shelter of the Guru Pada Ashraya. who…”

The relationship between guru and disciple is not mechanical or merely physical; if it is only external it is hero worship, not guru worship. — “hero worship is different from guru puja”

🎙 Maharaj at 22:17 (auto-transcript): “If we want to experience what exists between the Guru and if we want to experience it, it is not a mechanical thing. thing it is not just a physical thing it is not if it is physical it is not guru worship it is hero worship hero hero worship is different from guru puja a…”

children.topic: The essence of association is hearing

Prabhupada said the essence of association is to hear. One should go to the spiritual master to learn by hearing.

nodeData.topic: Class 18 · Pingala Day 09 · Cut Off the Sinful Desires
nodeData.note: SB 11.8.43 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Pingala cuts off her desire and sleeps in peace. Maharaj shows that material desire never lets anyone 'make ends meet' — the next one is never better — and that the best way to satisfy the senses is Krishna consciousness, learned from those who have already seen it all. In the questions he explains how much material desire a devotee needs (zero: everything is for Krishna), where Pingala found the strength (a devotee's mercy, received by hearing), and why demigod worship is a secondary thing. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The avadhuta describes Pingala, her mind made up, giving up her hopes of pleasure from lovers and lying down peacefully — desire is the cause of misery, freedom from it the cause of happiness.

These verses show both the cause of our suffering and the cause of happiness. Every conditioned soul has a strong desire to enjoy the senses and struggles hard for it.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:00 (auto-transcript): “So we see in this verse, these two verses, the causes of our suffering and also the causes for happiness. Tingala is representing all of our conditions. Every conditions have a strong desire to enjoy the senses.”

People speak of making ends meet, but no one ever has, because desires have no end. — “Nobody has ever made the ends meet.”

🎙 Maharaj at 28:02 (auto-transcript): “They have the language, what to make the ends meet. Who has ever made the ends? Nobody has ever made the ends meet. Because until their desires have no end. One of my music friends has one song. He is not a devotee, but he has a material experience.”

A musician friend, not a devotee, named an album after a gambler: the more you get, the more you want. That is the struggle — we are never satisfied.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:38 (auto-transcript): “One of my music friends has one song. He is not a devotee, but he has a material experience. So he named this album Norman the Gambler, Norman the Gambler, N-O-R-M-A-N, Norman the Gambler. is a gambler the name of his friend the more you get the more you want so there”

The newest phone has just arrived; we think we will be completely happy when we get it — and once we have it, we are miserable again.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:16 (auto-transcript): “Apple, the latest Apple 15. Just arrived. When you get this, you are completely happy. When you get it, you are completely miserable. Nobody has ever made the ends meet in this world. Because they are all sources of misery. our desire to gratify the senses because of our…”

children.topic: The next one will be better
children.note:
Pingala changed partners again and again, never satisfied; material energy makes us think 'this one is no good, the next will be complete'.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:14 (auto-transcript): “so Pingala who is representing all of us has a strong desire to gratify the senses and they have been changing different, different men, different men every day, no satisfaction, always miserable, but material energy is so strong that makes us think This one is not good. The…”

Maharaj recalls the Peugeot cars of West Africa — 304, 404, 504 and on. Each new number was 'the best', yet underneath it was the same car. — “engine is the same only the name is different”

🎙 Maharaj at 32:06 (auto-transcript): “Yes, all the same thing. You don't have Pujokas in West Africa. you have three or four four or four five or five five or six five or seven the engine is the same only the name is different so when you have three or four is the best”

No material desire can make anyone happy. When Pingala realised this she cut off the desire completely, became happy and slept peacefully.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:54 (auto-transcript): “It is true that material desire cannot make anyone happy in this world. when Pingala realized this, he changed his mind, he said here he completely cut off the desire to enjoy all of us then she became completely happy she went to sleep happily so if we want to be happy in this”

children.topic: Learn from those who've seen it all
children.note:
If we want to be happy, we should learn from those who walked the road before us.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:02 (auto-transcript): “We should learn from those who have started it before us. In a movement we have Ambarish, the grandson of the number one American believer. He has seen all varieties of same notifications.”

Ambarisa Prabhu, from one of America's wealthiest families, had seen every variety of sense pleasure, concluded it was not the way to happiness, and took to Krishna consciousness — now he is completely happy.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:06 (auto-transcript): “In a movement we have Ambarish, the grandson of the number one American believer. He has seen all varieties of same notifications. So he concluded that this is not the way to be happy.”

Preaching in an Indian village, he told the crowd: where you are trying to go, I have come back from; there is nothing there. Our system is to learn from those with experience. — “don't waste your time if you learn from us we have seen it all”

🎙 Maharaj at 36:08 (auto-transcript): “So he told in one of his lectures, we were in India, in a village, we were preaching in a village. So many people like this were there. Baris Peribou said, all of you here should listen to me, where you are trying to go, I'm coming from the end, I have seen it all, there's…”

The best way to gratify the senses is to become a devotee: the prasadam, the dancing, the philosophy, the scripture and the altar are all the best.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:45 (auto-transcript): “The best way to gratify the senses is to become a devotee. A devotee, prasadam is the best, dancing is the best, philosophy is the best, Scripture is the best, the altar is the best. I have seen many altars, their deities eat only coconuts, and they change their dress after…”

Maharaj has seen altars where the deity gets only coconuts and a new dress every few months. In a Krishna temple he saw the deities' dress changed five times in a day, ending with a nightdress.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:16 (auto-transcript): “Scripture is the best, the altar is the best. I have seen many altars, their deities eat only coconuts, and they change their dress after three months or after one year. When Krishna comes in every day, sometimes, the deities change dresses five times in the day.”

Prasadam, philosophy, deity — all of it is sinless and complete. So don't waste time anywhere else. — “You have everything without sin.”

🎙 Maharaj at 41:03 (auto-transcript): “The solution is to be a devotee of Krishna. You have everything without sin. The Prasada is sinless. The philosophy is sinless. The deity is sinless. Everything is complete. So if we want to be happy Don't waste your time anywhere Not even demigods”

Not even the demigods are free; they are full of anxiety. Who is the greatest person in the universe? Brahma.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:35 (auto-transcript): “So if we want to be happy Don't waste your time anywhere Not even demigods They are not free All wasteful of anxiety Who is the greatest person in the universe? Who is the greatest person? Who? The Brahma. This is our Brahma and other Brahmans.”

Two demons existed before Brahma began creating. When they appeared Brahma had to run. Is that peace? If the greatest being is not peaceful, our anxiety is immeasurable.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:28 (auto-transcript): “In this creation, there were two demons that were existing before the Brahma started his creation. they are not created by Brahma they are not created by Brahma they were existing before Brahma so once once the Brahma he saw this big sky big sky cloud”

So approach only one who is completely free from misery: the Supreme Lord and his pure representatives. Pingala was miserable until she met a pure devotee and was transformed.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:00 (auto-transcript): “We should not approach any person. We should approach a person who is completely free from misery. The Supreme Personality of Godhead and His pure representatives. They can make us completely happy. Like Pingala. Pingala has been gratified in his senses but she has always…”

Take shelter of Gaura and Nitai, who brought the holy name. Their business is to dance and to get all of us dancing; serving them makes us happy.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:30 (auto-transcript): “And especially, taking a sort of Gauranitaya Who are the teacher of the inaugurator of the holy name of Krishna Panchatatua appeared in Moïse. The business is to dance. And to engage all of us in dancing. So we will do them service.”

Two questions: how much material desire a practising devotee should have, and when demigod worship began.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:29 (auto-transcript): “Questions? Comments? Thank you very much. In this material world, to sustain ourselves, we need some amount of material desires, for example, shelter, house. Some amount of material desires should be there. Yes, he mentioned in the verse that it is the cause of the greatest…”

children.topic: Q1 · How much material desire is okay?
children.note:
To live we need some things — shelter, a house, work. If material desire is the greatest cause of misery, where does a practising devotee draw the line?

🎙 Maharaj at 46:50 (auto-transcript): “In this material world, to sustain ourselves, we need some amount of material desires, for example, shelter, house. Some amount of material desires should be there. Yes, he mentioned in the verse that it is the cause of the greatest unhappiness. So how do we, practicing…”

Maharaj's answer is zero — not even a fraction of a percent. — “Zero. We are taking zero. Zero.”

🎙 Maharaj at 48:00 (auto-transcript): “Zero. We are taking zero. Zero. Zero. Zero. But with point percent. Point zero percent. Zero. We don't understand that renunciation is one of the six populaces of Krishna. Renonciation is opulence, it is not starvation.”

Renunciation is one of Krishna's six opulences; it is opulence, not starvation. We make a mistake thinking renunciation means looking poor.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:19 (auto-transcript): “We don't understand that renunciation is one of the six populaces of Krishna. Renonciation is opulence, it is not starvation. Starvation is not poverty. Opulence.”

In the Himalayas rags may be fine, but to preach in Kali-yuga we wear clean clothes, cook nice prasadam and build magnificent temples — all for Krishna, not for oneself.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:19 (auto-transcript): “To think that renunciation means that you put on So, if you are going to stay at the Himalayas, it's okay, but if you are going to preach in Kali Yuga, you have to wear fresh, clean dress, nice prasada, for Krishna, cooking”

Rupa and Sanatana were so renounced they did not sleep under the same tree twice, yet on Mahaprabhu's order they built temples. There was no material desire in it.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:23 (auto-transcript): “That Rupa Goswami, Sanatana Goswami, they are brothers, they are brothers, Sanatana Goswami. They are completely renounced. Up to the point that they don't sleep under one tree. They sleep secretly. That's how serious the religion is.”

Raghunatha dasa Gosvami threw away a bigger cup a servant filled for him and asked for his own small one. Yet when he needed money to dig Radha-kunda, Krishna sent a devotee from afar with the funds. That is not material desire.

children.topic: Q2 · When did demigod worship begin?
children.note:
At what point did living beings start worshipping demigods?

There is no demigod worship in the kingdom of God. It begins when we fall from our position — a secondary thing, not the primary one. Confused, we grab the nearest thing we see.

🎙 Maharaj at 68:02 (auto-transcript): “There is no worshiping of demigods in the kingdom of God. In the local Vietnam, there is no demigods worshiping. children.note:
It is not an insult: Krishna says it in the Gita, and Lord Shiva himself says that of all worshippable persons Vishnu is the best. Brahma says the same.

🎙 Maharaj at 70:17 (auto-transcript): “Krishna said it very clearly in Babagita. And the persons who are worshipping themselves, they say it themselves, Lord Shiva. A friend preferred Shiva's temple because there he could do as he liked. Maharaj replies that doing whatever we like is the life of a baby; without discipline, life is animal life. — “A responsible person will have rules and regulations in his life.”

🎙 Maharaj at 72:23 (auto-transcript): “One friend told me see my friend I don't like your Krishna because don't do this. say I'm on jeans trouser I enter into Lord Shiva temple but I cannot do that in I am a Krishna. I am a Shiva.”

children.note:

🎙 Maharaj at 56:42 (auto-transcript): “God, the mercy of a devotee, the mercy of a devotee is very powerful. But the mercy of a devotee, she was able to give up all the material desires. She had the mercy of Dr. Treya.”

nodeData.topic: Class 17 · Pingala Day 08 · Protecting Oneself
nodeData.note: SB 11.8.42 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Pingala sees that the whole world lies in the jaws of time, and that sight makes her detached and able to protect herself. Maharaj contrasts selfish 'salvation' and mixed devotion with her pure turn to Krishna, shows how imperceptibly time takes everything, and describes how a devotee prepares for death — with the holy name, Krishna's pastimes, and a life that lets the spiritual master see his training has borne fruit. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Pingala's verse is about the soul who sees the whole universe swallowed by time, becomes sober and detached, and so can protect itself.

Maharaj explains that seeking salvation is self-centred — 'my own deliverance' — and the same is true of most pious works.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:02 (auto-transcript): “salvation salvation or liberation is the same thing salvation is selfish selfish self-centered my own idea just my situation my deliverance is salvation which includes all the auspicious activities all the specific activities like giving charity providing water for people to…”

People give charity, plant trees, open hospitals and free schools not because they care for you but to be promoted to the heavenly planets. Krishna's call to abandon all varieties of religion means giving up such self-interested dharma.

Kapila Muni describes devotion in the modes: approaching Krishna out of fear of sin is devotion in goodness; approaching him for protection, health or power is devotion in passion or ignorance. None of it is pure.

Most people come to Krishna for their own sake — money, mystic power, promotion, protection. It is not about Krishna; we simply use him.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:04 (auto-transcript): “they're taken to Krishna consists for our own sake so so we are using Krishna for our own personal gratification so it's not really for Krishna and majority of people are like this we are looking for Christians but for linear Christians a properties the mystic power promotion…”

Pingala is not in that category: the mercy of a pure devotee turned her away from sense gratification toward Krishna, without any desire to merge.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:00 (auto-transcript): “so pingala is not in this category because she has been blessed by that i three influence is messy affected her to take the christian consciousness so she turned away from sense gratification positively not to look for something as as a person merging into krishna that is the…”

children.topic: A pure devotee won't bless merging
children.note:
A pure devotee never merges into Krishna and will not give that blessing; he is after the Personality of Godhead and has a direct relationship with him.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:34 (auto-transcript): “as a person merging into krishna that is the the special quality of having the mission of a pure devotee the beauty which will not give us the blessing to merge into krishna because he's not merged into krishna and he's against that so he will not give us that kind of…”

First one realises the self, then one can speak of realising God. Seeing oneself as separate from the Lord was the illusion that distracted us from our real duty.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:40 (auto-transcript): “after self-realization self-realization then there is god realization we have to be so realized then we can talk about god realization civilization is compulsory necessary realizing the self so automatically one would like in the money said in the first counter this is a…”

When we say 'time', what comes to mind? Time takes away everything, but imperceptibly. Only a self-realised soul sees it; a conditioned soul never does.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:55 (auto-transcript): “and when we when we look at time when we say the word time what are we doing at the same time time what come to the mind when they say time that we are looking at that name takes away everything but imperceptibly imperceptibly we don't see how time is taking away everything”

children.topic: Parents don't see the child grow
children.note:
A visitor says, 'How the child has grown!' The parents never noticed — they see the baby every day, lying, then crawling, then standing.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:14 (auto-transcript): “how time is taking away everything. A conditioned soul will never see. For example, the parent will not see how the child is growing. You don't see. Someone who has not seen a child will tell you oh this child has grown so much they are growing so fast but the parents will…”

children.topic: We cannot eat or run as before
children.note:
Quietly, time changes us: we can no longer eat, digest or run the way we once did.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:00 (auto-transcript): “we don't see that and a certain is is changing everything that you will not be able to eat the way we're eating before yeah the quantity of food you used to eat in you know you to eat that again this time you know you to run the way you surround before if you you cannot you…”

Morning becomes afternoon, evening becomes night, and one day is out of our life. 2023 is nearly finished — one more year gone.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:44 (auto-transcript): “different but very very slowly that we don't see that time is changing everything the morning has become afternoon and afternoon has become evening light is night and one one day is out of our life then one year is out so 2023 is finished in few days now we are counting 20…”

If a conditioned soul is told the end is near, the next thing is the doctor: what can you do, how much money, can I get an extension?

🎙 Maharaj at 31:49 (auto-transcript): “soul if if a conditional soul inform that the days are very close the next thing is to ask a doctor what can you do how much money you need can i stand i need extension but when we look at the life of this civilized devotee what did you do the moment pressure when i was…”

Told he had seven days to live, Maharaja Parikshit did not seek more time; he gave up everything at once and went to hear. — “he didn't ask for extension immediately he abandoned everything”

🎙 Maharaj at 32:17 (auto-transcript): “life of this civilized devotee what did you do the moment pressure when i was informed they're living in seven days he didn't ask for extension immediately he abandoned everything and he went to us so what is the duty for a person who will leave this is a a save realized…”

What should my thinking and activity be now? There is no time for fear or procrastination or looking for remedies. The only remedy is to turn to Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:53 (auto-transcript): “should be my activities what should I remember what should I do now understand there's not it did not time for fear did not time for procrastinating there's no time for looking for remedy the only one remedy to turn to krishna that one is very fortunate to get your notice get…”

Every living being is on the roll call: Chitragupta marks the register each day. If we are fortunate, Krishna lets us know our days are few so we can prepare.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:30 (auto-transcript): “role let's call it register we have register quick chitra gupta marks every day chitra gupta Marks the register. He marks the register every day. He is marking for us. If we are very fortunate, a Christian will arrange that we will be informed according to your register. You…”

Krishna may come directly, as for Bhishmadeva or for Haridasa Thakura through Mahaprabhu, or he comes as the holy name, with devotees chanting kirtan as one leaves the body.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:12 (auto-transcript): “like bismadev the supreme position of body will come before before us who come before us directly or he comes as the holy name the devotees this is the two ways the devotee so he leaves the body the two ways the devoted to live the body the christian come directly like…”

When medicine stops working, that is the message: resign from everything and take shelter of the holy name. Maharaj describes how his spiritual master left his body at Gita Nagari.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:06 (auto-transcript): “level that we are taking medicine and nothing is working we are taking all the necessary medicine nothing is working that is the message there's a message just resign from everything and resign and take shelter the holy name let the name be chanted and like he's only about…”

children.topic: Only the name and the pastimes
children.note:
In those final hours there was not a pin drop of other sound — only the holy name and a senior sannyasi reading Krishna's pastimes.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:34 (auto-transcript): “this time not even a pin drop when they pin nothing no nothing only the holy name and his Holiness Radha Maharaj is reading pastimes of Krishna. Only two things. The pastimes of Krishna and the Holy Name. Nothing else. There is no sound, no extra sound than the Holy Name and…”

Two devotees from Barsana arrived uninvited at a forest village in America just before the departure — a sign Maharaj takes to heart. The time a soul appears and disappears is very important.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:08 (auto-transcript): “narration of Krishna. Only two things. That's how he learned about teacher Maharaj. Unfortunately, two devotees from Barasana came to America. Without any invitation, they were not informed that someone was leaving the border. Gitanagri is not a famous place. People are from…”

children.topic: The only doctor is the holy name
children.note:
At that stage we should not keep calling 'doctor, doctor'. The only medicine left is the holy name and hearing Krishna's pastimes. — “there's only doctor the holy name”

🎙 Maharaj at 37:56 (auto-transcript): “gets get himself i said prepare not not that we all continue to oh doctor doctor the only doctor now is the holy name of christian there's only doctor the holy name and hearing persons of christian no no no no time for anything else at his height is what happened the…”

Devotees long to leave the body in a holy place. His spiritual master said he would make Vrindavan at Gita Nagari and left his body there; Maharaj has heard godbrothers say the same of their own places.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:47 (auto-transcript): “So he said, I will create Vrindavan in Gita Nagiri, so that people can also testify. It's the proper statement that he has created Vrindavan in the way. So he decided to leave his body there. He becomes a place of people with his brothers. And I heard from two of his…”

children.topic: Don't leave the guru a failure
children.note:
Being a disciple is more than a new name. The spiritual master should be able to leave the world happy, seeing what his investment in us has produced.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:39 (auto-transcript): “is has any meaning and as disciple we have we also have to put ourselves in the situation the special masters will see us and and be happy with where we are spiritually that is part of it to be a disciple you're not just the changing name to be a disciple has a lot of meaning…”

Do not come to the departing guru miserable, so that he sees how useless we are and that he leaves with no representative. Srila Prabhupada said if he could make one pure devotee, he would consider his attempt a success.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:28 (auto-transcript): “so he can be happy to so krishna told you this time don't go to the grandfather lamenting don't go to me in the miserable way for him to see how useless you are that he's leaving the body without having a representative this is a failure the disciples should not be like that…”

As with a child, the teacher wants to see that we can now stand and carry on what he established after he disappears. Those who take the teaching seriously have the power to maintain it. — “now we can stand on our feet.”

🎙 Maharaj at 41:22 (auto-transcript): “This is what the special master wants, you want to see that now we can stand on our feet. When you train the child, you can stand on the feet and you can invest more to continue with what you have established. So you feel very happy that, yes, the establishment you have…”

Not every day complaining and calling ourselves failures. If there is crying, let it be crying for Godhead — a prayer, not lamentation.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:22 (auto-transcript): “not every every single moment is complain I say failure every day is a lamentation you should cry at the pillar for Godhead not lamentation what we we are not as a failure so in that condition the living entity is qualified to be his own protector our own protector means what…”

To be one's own protector means knowing clearly what to do and what not to do. It is not an amulet: one sees illusion and reality side by side and cannot be deviated, so maya cannot disturb him.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:38 (auto-transcript): “are not as a failure so in that condition the living entity is qualified to be his own protector our own protector means what now we know what to do and what not to do we have come to that level it's protection protection not a amulet that is different it's different one can…”

children.topic: No time in the spiritual world
children.note:
Everything with duration is within time; the soul has no duration. In Goloka there is no past, present and future, because time there is Krishna himself — here everything deteriorates and is ruled by the clock.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:13 (auto-transcript): “gray serpent of time everything is controlled by time there is nothing good outside nothing so anything that has duration is within the time the duration means time they can count the soul the soul there's no duration you're not at it is not within the time that's why in the…”

When the Pandavas knew it was time, they did not even call their wives or mother; they simply left. Elders like Gandhari also departed without fuss, following that science.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:36 (auto-transcript): “when the panda was with they know the time has it's time to they didn't even call their wife they didn't even call their their mother just left if we have sense after follow they follow on their own singer like gandari the husband didn't call him he just left he said no i…”

Maharaj describes celestial airplanes carrying devotees away in jubilation. Our leaving the world should give joy to others. — “our departure should be spiritually celebrated”

🎙 Maharaj at 47:55 (auto-transcript): “seeing that oh i see them they're going to seven day flowers jubilating their success this is how our life should be our our departure should be spiritually celebrated it should give joy to into the another woman again that is uh the message yes yes yes every devotee likes to go”

A question about inner guidance, and a closing remark on goodness.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:40 (auto-transcript): “Is there any difference between the voice of the Supersoul and the Conscience which is built? Because Pingala was getting the realisation, so was it her own Conscience speaking or the voice of the Supersoul guiding? When we say conscience is the individual soul, that means…”

When Pingala received her realisation, was it her own conscience speaking or the Supersoul guiding her?

🎙 Maharaj at 50:40 (auto-transcript): “Is there any difference between the voice of the Supersoul and the Conscience which is built? Because Pingala was getting the realisation, so was it her own Conscience speaking or the voice of the Supersoul guiding? When we say conscience is the individual soul, that means…”

The conscience belongs to the individual soul; the Supersoul is a different person who instructs it. When the soul is realised it hears that voice clearly, and the pure devotees are guided by it, so their acts are perfect.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:11 (auto-transcript): “When we say conscience is the individual soul, that means that the voice of the super soul is different, because the individual soul is a person, and the super soul is a person, so both of them are conversing. So the voice of the super soul is different, instructing the…”

In Mumbai devotees wanted a busy place; Srila Prabhupada pointed to an empty jungle at Juhu. Today long queues come there from morning to midnight. He accepted hardship there without complaint — that is acting on the Supersoul's message.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:10 (auto-transcript): “mumbai they were they were telling the prophet they wanted the akash akash because it's a post place and many people are there the proper was pointing hand to where we have temple now then nobody was there it's a jungle nobody lives there proper this we have preacher we need…”

It is much easier to rise from goodness than from passion or ignorance, so Prabhupada places us in goodness to begin from there.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:38 (auto-transcript): “activity no confusion yes if you continue if you continue because the mode of goodness is very conducive to rise very easily than to rise from ignorance and passion so goodness is best therefore better for us to raise our standard to goodness and you see this is what prophet…”

maps.title: SB Canto 11 · Class 16 · Pingala Day 07 · Dark Well of Material Life

nodeData.topic: Class 16 · Pingala Day 07 · Dark Well of Material Life
nodeData.note: SB 11.8.41 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. On Gita Jayanti in Mauritius, Maharaj explains Pingala's image of the soul fallen into a dry, dark well: sense gratification pushes us down, no one can climb out alone, and the demigods, themselves bound, cannot pull us out — only Krishna, Mukunda, can. Devotees are mocked for 'only chanting', but cleaning the heart is the real welfare work, and the Bhagavad Gita should be our lifelong companion. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Pingala's verse pictures the living being dragged down by sense pleasure into a dark well and caught there by time, and asks who but the Lord could save such a person.

children.topic: Gita Jayanti — the Gita is real
children.note:
The class falls on the appearance day of the Bhagavad Gita, so Maharaj links Pingala's lesson with the Gita and the month of serving it.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:24 (auto-transcript): “Today is the auspicious appearance of Bhagavad Gita, very auspicious. So we have double. So Bhagavad Gita, which is in India, we also discuss how to serve Bhagavad Gita.”

Maharaj recalls visiting Kurukshetra and the spot where the Gita was spoken. The Pandavas and Kauravas were real persons who lived; this is history, not a story. — “It is not fiction, but Gita is real.”

🎙 Maharaj at 21:03 (auto-transcript): “I was a devotee in Khrushitra, where the temple is established as the Jyotisha. Jyotisha is a place where Gita was spoken by modern fighters a year ago. It is not fiction, but Gita is real. Khrushitra is real, the Pandavas are real, the Kauravas are real, they are all…”

Their capital still stands: go to India and you will find New Delhi where Hastinapura was. Maharaj lists the many holy places he has visited on yatras.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:41 (auto-transcript): “Their capital was Hastinapur, which is now New Delhi. New Delhi is there in India, if you go to India, you can say New Delhi, you'll see New Delhi is there. And how the city is the Pandavas Baras, the national devotee, Safari, Free of Isolines, Diabodakaswa, Militants,…”

Krishna spoke to Arjuna, but the Gita came down for our own benefit.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:54 (auto-transcript): “So for our own benefit, Baba Gita descended to them. So what Ngella said here, in connection with Baba Gita, we're gonna say the intelligence of the living entity is stolen away by activities of science certification she used the word party time you also hear the same word…”

Maharaj reads Pingala's words through the Gita: our intelligence is stolen by the urge to gratify the senses.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:10 (auto-transcript): “So what Ngella said here, in connection with Baba Gita, we're gonna say the intelligence of the living entity is stolen away by activities of science certification she used the word party time you also hear the same word about it but”

The word Pingala uses, also found in the Gita, means falling down — like gliding down a slope. Maharaj asks the room what is pushing the living beings toward hell.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:01 (auto-transcript): “tanti tanti the same the same thing party time say fall down patita means gliding down it's a gliding they're wonderful if a slope from the slope is gliding so it's it's good like that so we are gliding down what is pushing the living entities to hell what what is it what is…”

The answer from the audience: sense gratification. Bewildered by illusion, the conditioned souls become strongly attached to it, and that attachment drives them down.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:41 (auto-transcript): “to hell what what is it what is pushing living entities well being gonna say yes sense gratification the vishaya by sense gratification the same thing you This is 1616.”

Pingala uses the word andha-kupa: not just a dark well but a dry one, where you cannot see left or right. That is how dangerous sense gratification is.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:19 (auto-transcript): “So Pingada said, Brother Maharaj used the word, Andakupa. Andakupa, this is in the seventh capital, Andakupa. not only dark well there's no water in the world it's a dry dark well that one falls in there dark you you don't see your left and right that is how dangerous…”

Whoever falls into such a well cannot deliver himself. Even someone who knows how to swim cannot swim in a well.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:05 (auto-transcript): “we have fallen into this way a dark world of illusion ignorance one who falls in the world cannot deliver himself it's not possible to deliver myself but the world is very small and the water did not fall to the top they could say i can swim even if you know how to swim you…”

Seized by the serpent of time inside the well, our situation is truly hopeless — so the only question is who can save us.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:36 (auto-transcript): “cannot swim in the way so very dangerous so pingala said wouldn't that well he is then seized by the deadly serpent who asked for the supreme position of god here could could save the poor living entity from such a hopeless condition our situation is hopeless because what is…”

What hope does a drowning person have? Fallen into the ocean you are finished, unless a ship comes or you have the mercy of the Lord's incarnations like Matsya and Kurma.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:11 (auto-transcript): “what is the hope for a drowning person what is the hope then there's no way you can have a swimmer who can cross an ocean we don't have a swimmer that can cross an ocean by swimming impossible you fall in the ocean you are finished you cannot get out except a ship come there…”

The demigods have many followers but cannot deliver anyone, because they themselves are under the clutches of maya. One whose hands and feet are tied cannot untie another. — “Only a person who is liberated can liberate somebody else.”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:07 (auto-transcript): “many disciples they have many followers demigods have many followers but demigod God cannot deliver anyone. Why? They themselves are under the clutches of maya. They are under the clutches of maya. A person who is bound, legs and feet cannot deliver somebody else. Only a…”

Krishna alone is Mukunda, the giver of liberation, because nothing binds him. He made the rope of the three modes that ties everyone in this world, even the demons.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:42 (auto-transcript): “So one of the Christians is Mukunda. They deliver. One who can deliver. Why? because christian is not bound by anything christian is not bound by anything right by anything nothing binds christian but christian has created the road to bind everyone in this medicine world…”

From Gita chapter 16 Maharaj explains that those who think sense gratification is life's prime necessity are full of immeasurable anxiety. Whoever makes sense pleasure their deity must be miserable; whoever worships Krishna becomes free.

Krishna is tri-adhisa, master of the three modes. The modes bind only those who turn their faces away from him, so it makes sense to take shelter of him.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:08 (auto-transcript): “he's triadish he is free from the three modes of material nature triadish the mode of nature does not bind christian christian created the mode to bind those who turn their ways then turn their face away from him he's triadish he's not bind by the rule of network of illusion…”

children.topic: Brahma and Shiva know their place
children.note:
Pingala's advice is true: Brahma and Shiva cannot ultimately help us. They are not called Mukunda, and they never claim all beings as their own — they know their position and Krishna's.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:46 (auto-transcript): “so let us take seriously today advice of a pingala pingala said even brahma shiva they cannot help us ultimately they cannot help us only the supreme procedure of godhead can help us and that is true it is true the shiva and the brahma they are not called mukunda and anyone…”

children.topic: 'What do you do for the world?'
children.note:
Once one takes shelter of Krishna, everything else, even demigod worship, loses its taste — and people without understanding call such a devotee proud or useless to society.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:51 (auto-transcript): “of the supreme position of godhead if you take shelter of the supreme lord could this day work of an intelligent person an intelligent person take shelter of krishna who will never take who said since i have taken shelter of the supreme person the enemy of comes since i have…”

Maharaj voices the critics: other spiritual groups run hospitals and social work — what do you do except chant Hare Krishna? In Nigeria people ask, 'Hare Krishna — is that what I will eat?'

🎙 Maharaj at 36:27 (auto-transcript): “What is the benefit of society? What do you do for the world? Hare Krishna, Hare Krishna, and then? And then somewhat. But what is their what? Can you make miracles for people? Can you make miracles? So what is the value? Can you make miracles for people? Can you seek prayer?…”

A famous miracle healer came to Nigeria. Maharaj laughed: he was curing others while wearing tinted glasses for his own weak eyes — cheaters and cheated.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:09 (auto-transcript): “I saw one Christian, a very famous Christian, he came to Nigeria, he's making miracles, curing people. When I look at him, I laugh. Cheaters and they cheated. He's curing people, but he's wearing eyeglass. He's not tinted, he's not a sun shape, it is tinted glass. Means what?…”

Cure the eyes today and tomorrow it is the stomach, the head, the back. Every material body carries these troubles, and time brings them out, life after life.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:09 (auto-transcript): “Krishna has no time, no worse is time to cure our sight for today. the next life you come back you have the same problem. You cure the eyes today, tomorrow the stomach is there, tomorrow the headache is there, tomorrow the hand is there, tomorrow the leg is there, the back is…”

children.topic: Cleaning the heart is the real help
children.note:
Hospitals treat bodies and peace groups chant 'peace, peace', yet no peace comes. What Hare Krishna devotees give is a clean heart; with a clean heart there is no more crime, and disease is no longer the problem.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:06 (auto-transcript): “see the peace so what can harry christian people do the harry christian people can clean the heart clean the heart if the heart is cleansed no more crime if the heart is clean no more disease disease will never be a problem if the soul is pure the horizon is the impediment…”

Was illness a problem for Sanatana Gosvami, or poverty for poor devotees in Mahaprabhu's pastimes, or illiteracy for Haridasa Thakura? For a pure devotee the problem is zero.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:30 (auto-transcript): “will never be a problem if the soul is pure the horizon is the impediment for the for a peaceful sick body you have no it's not an impediment for a pure soul was the sickness a problem for sanatana goswami what should the vipra was a problem nakula brahmachari poverty was his…”

The varieties of misery we face are reactions to a contaminated heart. Chanting Hare Krishna and reading the Gita purify it. — “We have problem because the heart is not pure.”

🎙 Maharaj at 42:51 (auto-transcript): “They have no problem. We have problem because the heart is not pure. pure. The heart is contaminated, full of contamination. Therefore, the reaction of the contamination comes in so many ways to the miseries, varieties of miseries which you are facing. So the heart is pure,…”
Krishna promises in the Gita that one who takes shelter of this knowledge attains his nature — eternity, knowledge and bliss — and is no longer disturbed by creation, destruction, birth or death.

Maharaj closes with how the holy name and the Gita carry us through.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:17 (auto-transcript): “Chita Maha went to Kolabe Sridhar and said, Kolabe Sridhar, tell me, you are chanting Hare Krishna every day. You are wasting your time, you are wasting your time, you are wasting your time, Hare Krishna, Hare Krishna, see a dhoti, Kolabe Sri Dharaseya, see, everyone has a…”

Mahaprabhu teases the poor devotee Sridhara for wasting his time chanting. Sridhara answers that everyone covers the body and eats according to their karma — finer cloth or simpler, the principle is the same.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:17 (auto-transcript): “Chita Maha went to Kolabe Sridhar and said, Kolabe Sridhar, tell me, you are chanting Hare Krishna every day. You are wasting your time, you are wasting your time, you are wasting your time, Hare Krishna, Hare Krishna, see a dhoti, Kolabe Sri Dharaseya, see, everyone has a…”

The holy name fulfils all desires, material and spiritual. Chanting with offences may bring position and facility, but not love; for prema one must practise for prema.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:53 (auto-transcript): “chita muhabib said the holy name blue register fulfill all everyone's design all desires or means both material spiritual especially if you change only the alphabet you get you get big positions you have material facilities but the premium you don't get that's the reason…”

Take the Gita everywhere as a friend for eternity. Maharaj calls it Krishna's love letter to his friend — confidential, heart to heart. — “make Bhagavad Gita your companion you are saved”

🎙 Maharaj at 50:22 (auto-transcript): “you should make Bhagavad Gita your companion your companion everywhere we go make Bhagavad Gita your companion you are saved this is my friend for eternity I will think the instruction Krishna gave instruction this is Lord Krishna's love”

One question about reciting the Gita on Gita Jayanti.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:45 (auto-transcript): “We live on the day of Jitajanthi. You also read about Jitajanthi. They recite the Sanskrit. Is it okay if we only recite without reading the translation or we recite along with translation? We do both. When I do, we do both. We recite also the translation. Sanskrit and…”

children.topic: Q1 · Recite with or without translation?
children.note:
On Gita Jayanti devotees recite the whole Gita. Is it enough to recite only the Sanskrit, or should the translation be read too?

🎙 Maharaj at 52:00 (auto-transcript): “Is it okay if we only recite without reading the translation or we recite along with translation? We do both. When I do, we do both. We recite also the translation. Sanskrit and English? No, not Sanskrit. This is not Sanskrit. I mean... This is Sanskrit. The English? No, this…”

When Maharaj leads it, they recite the verses and the translations, though that takes longer.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:11 (auto-transcript): “We do both. When I do, we do both. We recite also the translation. Sanskrit and English? No, not Sanskrit. This is not Sanskrit. I mean... This is Sanskrit. The English? No, this is transliteration. This is translation. Then they pop out. Yes, it will take longer time if you…”

Some recite only the verses and leave out the translation, and they still get the benefit; reading the translation helps us understand what we are saying.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:55 (auto-transcript): “That's why some people do it. Yes, they recite only that and leave the translation. You get the benefit. Research and translation is good for us to understand what we mean.”

nodeData.topic: Class 15 · Pingala Day 06 · Enjoying Life With The Lord
nodeData.note: SB 11.8.40 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Pingala reaches full satisfaction: she trusts the Lord's mercy, accepts what comes of its own accord and resolves to enjoy life with him alone. Maharaj shows how hearing about Krishna at once puts out the fire of lamentation, tells how Krishna brought milk to Madhavendra Puri, and urges us to hand Krishna our risks. In the questions he speaks on offensive chanting, why child Krishna never prayed, and how devotees 'control' the Lord without pride. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Pingala declares herself fully satisfied, with faith in the Lord's mercy, ready to live on what comes by itself and to find her enjoyment with him alone.

Maharaj calls this a complete realisation: 'I am completely satisfied' is what happens when one comes to Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:41 (auto-transcript): “This is a complete realization. Pingala is speaking I am completely satisfied that is what happens when one comes to Krishna so Rupa Goswami said in letter of devotion pure devotional service has six characteristics One is automatically promoted to transcendental joy.”

Rupa Gosvami lists six characteristics of pure devotional service; one is that it brings transcendental joy, because it ends misery.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:04 (auto-transcript): “so Rupa Goswami said in letter of devotion pure devotional service has six characteristics One is automatically promoted to transcendental joy. Because pure diversity put an end to misery.”
Suta Gosvami says that simply by hearing the Bhagavatam, the feeling of loving devotion to Krishna appears.

Not even seeing Krishna face to face — just hearing about him — makes love sprout and puts out the fire of lamentation that everyone in this world is burning in. — “if you really hear about krishna the feeling for pure love for krishna will sprout”

🎙 Maharaj at 16:13 (auto-transcript): “to hear just to hear about krishna if you really hear about krishna the feeling for pure love for krishna will sprout how do you know he said it will extinguish the fire or lamentation everybody lamenting in this world come in contact with krishna immediately freeze one from…”

children.topic: The fire is put out immediately
children.note:
The nectar enters through the ear, reaches the heart and removes contamination. The word used is 'immediately': lamentation, illusion and fear disappear. Pure devotional service extinguishes fire.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:31 (auto-transcript): “contamination so krishna use the word siplam immediately immediately one will feel it lamentation will disappear illusion will disappear fearfulness will disappear. So pure devotional service is fire extinguishing. By extinguishing”

When Ajamila called the name, the Lord's messengers came and he was saved; it did not take long. This is Krishna consciousness — it is happening.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:25 (auto-transcript): “Jamila feels that Immediately the woman said now I am It does not take them long time to appear Immediately well christian descended jamila was saved it didn't take long now a moment there were sinful activities that destroyed it's happening this is christian consciousness”

Pingala has full faith that the Lord is there to protect her. Krishna has fulfilled everyone's desires since time immemorial; no one else can, because he alone has real love for us.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:45 (auto-transcript): “mercy i have full faith in the lord's mercy the faith in the lord's mercy the lord is there to protect me Krishna is the supreme philosopher who has been fulfilling everyone's desires since time immemorial, not today, time immemorial. memorial here the christian who can…”

Krishna is the supreme eternal, the real friend of all living beings. Pingala experienced it: once in contact with him, she is completely satisfied.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:47 (auto-transcript): “he is the supreme eternal the real friend of all living entities real friend The real friend as Krishna, Pingala has experienced it, coming to Krishna, he said now, now that I have contact with Krishna I'm completely satisfied so with this condition she”

children.topic: Whatever comes of its own accord
children.note:
'I will maintain myself with whatever comes' means depending on Krishna alone and on nothing else.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:45 (auto-transcript): “said therefore I will maintain myself with whatever comes of its own accord what is that depending on Krishna this is depending on Christian I will not depend on anything only Christian Christian himself he told madame in the please why are you fasting if you have nothing to…”

Krishna came as a boy with milk for the fasting Madhavendra Puri: why are you fasting? If you have nothing, beg — and if I see you not begging, I will come and give it myself. Maharaj asks: philosophy, or reality?

🎙 Maharaj at 22:13 (auto-transcript): “depend on anything only Christian Christian himself he told madame in the please why are you fasting if you have nothing to eat you beg and if i see that you are not begging i will personally come and give you take the music take the milk”

children.note:
Madhavendra Puri asked how the boy knew where he sat; the boy said the village ladies told him. Our mistake is to think anything is unknown to Krishna — he is Vasudeva, present in everything, the great jewel of cleverness.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:29 (auto-transcript): “but when the police say who are you how you know i knew i'm sitting here that is our mistake hi god no i'm sitting here is anything christian does not know is it anywhere any any anything christian is a big guy a strong heart christian is a big guy a bigger means he”

children.topic: He hides, but not from devotees
children.note:
Krishna did not say 'I am the Supreme'; he hid himself — later revealing himself as the deity who had waited long for Madhavendra Puri. Whatever trick he plays, his devotees catch him. — “He can hide from others, but not his devotees.”

🎙 Maharaj at 26:15 (auto-transcript): “Christian hide himself, but he cannot hide from his devotees. He can hide from others, but not his devotees. The devotees will catch him. Whatever treat Christian may, devotees know his seat. catching mother been the pudding coaching lock him in the head and he keep the key…”

In the competition of love the devotee always wins. Prahlada fought the Lord for days at Naimisaranya without defeat; when he recognised his Lord he fell flat, and the Lord dropped his weapons, embraced him and said, I tried but did not succeed.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:38 (auto-transcript): “a day they fought at namisharaya they fought for days no defeat Then Nasinghadee shot arrow on Prahlad, Prahlad stopped fighting, he sat down, who shot me this arrow? Not ordinary person. I will find out who is this person. Prahlad went into meditation. He was tracing it,…”

Pingala will enjoy only with the Lord because he never disappoints in any circumstance and so is the true source of happiness.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:14 (auto-transcript): “i shall enjoy my life with only the lord because he is the real source of love and happiness because the lord will never disappoint us in all circumstances he will not disappoint therefore he is a source of our happiness if we associate with with a limited person if you…”

Associate with a limited person and he is soon exhausted; when he leaves his body, who will supply you then? The Lord does not finish.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:45 (auto-transcript): “if we associate with with a limited person if you associate with a limited person he will be exhausted very soon when he leaves a body who will supply it again who will supply it, it's finished the Lord will not finish he is inexhaustible so if you depend on the Lord as he…”

Krishna promises that by depending on him we cross every obstacle, because our obstacles become his concern. Like an insurance company saying 'give us your risk', let us give Krishna our risk. — “so let's give krishna a risk krishna will take care eternally”

This is intelligence and fortune: depend only on Krishna, accept what comes by itself and remain always under his protection; then life becomes successful.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:27 (auto-transcript): “this is fortune that one should depend only on krishna i saved everything that comes of each one accord and remain always on his protection and happiness our life will become successful You don't have to worry for anything. All our worries are taken care of by Krishna.”

We do not have to worry for anything; Krishna takes care of our worries. — “All our worries are taken care of by Krishna.”

🎙 Maharaj at 33:03 (auto-transcript): “You don't have to worry for anything. All our worries are taken care of by Krishna. Hare Krishna. How can we be able to help you?”

Three questions from the assembly.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:37 (auto-transcript): “How can we be able to help you? Offensive chanting is when we are chanting and we don't hear what we are chanting. that is offensive if we call someone's name what do you expect after the name what do you expect”

A devotee asks about offensive chanting and how to go beyond it.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:53 (auto-transcript): “Offensive chanting is when we are chanting and we don't hear what we are chanting. that is offensive if we call someone's name what do you expect after the name what do you expect yes you expect to see the person you are calling because the person you call is a person yes the…”

When we call someone's name we expect to see the person. Saying Hare Krishna, we should expect to see Radha and Krishna; offensive chanting is saying the names without seeing. — “Offensive chanting means we don't see.”

🎙 Maharaj at 34:07 (auto-transcript): “that is offensive if we call someone's name what do you expect after the name what do you expect yes you expect to see the person you are calling because the person you call is a person yes the phone I see his name yes the phone so we call the person we're expecting to see…”

We should chant more than 16 rounds. yes on this is more is more gentle if we chant more the holy name will rise above the fences destroy the fences and reveal the facility of god so we should keep chanting more more and more…”

Did Krishna's parents ask him to pray as a child?

One night they told the story of King Dasaratha, Rama's marriage to Sita, the fourteen-year exile meant to keep him from ever ruling, and Ravana's kidnapping of Sita, with Krishna asking questions throughout.

children.topic: Q3 · How do devotees feel controlling Krishna?
children.note:
Here, controlling someone makes us proud. How do devotees feel when their love controls the Supreme Lord?

🎙 Maharaj at 47:08 (auto-transcript): “So Krishna is controlled by the love of his devotees. And in this material world, when we control someone, we feel very packed up, you are controlling someone. So how do people feel about it, that they are controlling the Supreme Lord? Yes. So how does that thought process go…”

Pure means without contamination, so pure devotees do not feel 'I control Krishna, I am superior'.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:56 (auto-transcript): “So the pure devotees, what do you say pure? It means there is no contamination there. so they don't feel that i'm controlling christian i'm superior they don't feel that they don't feel that they are controlling christian so when christian was washing a jewish chariot for 18…”

Krishna washed Arjuna's horses for eighteen days and never told anyone, and Arjuna did not boast of resting his feet on Krishna's shoulder. Among friends such talk does not exist.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:31 (auto-transcript): “so when christian was washing a jewish chariot for 18 days you didn't tell anybody he didn't mention to anybody he didn't tell anybody because i'm driving my shoulder the people who saw that didn't tell anybody about it so it's a natural thing like a friendly as friends you…”

Krishna's position does not diminish; he is simply the supreme friend. Superiority and inferiority complexes do not exist in the spiritual world. — “There's nothing like superiority and inferiority complex.”

🎙 Maharaj at 50:32 (auto-transcript): “So there's no contamination. There's nothing like superiority and inferiority complex. It doesn't exist in the spiritual world. Pure. Hare Krishna Hare Krishna Smad Bhagavatam Ki Jai”

maps.title: SB Canto 11 · Class 14 · Pingala Day 05 · Detachment Has Arisen

nodeData.topic: Class 14 · Pingala Day 05 · Detachment Has Arisen
nodeData.note: SB 11.8.37–39 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Pingala feels happy as detachment arises in her heart and concludes that the Lord must be pleased with her. Maharaj teaches that happiness belongs to Krishna, not to facilities — even Indra is anxious — and that detachment grows by attachment to Krishna and his devotees, with stories of Dhruva, Narada and the Avanti brahmana. In the questions he speaks about caring for family without attachment and turning only to Krishna in suffering. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Pingala marvels that detachment has arisen in a heart so stubbornly set on enjoyment, that it makes her happy, and that she must somehow have pleased Lord Vishnu.

If the Lord is not pleased with someone, no one can make that person happy. We may have mystic power, position and every facility and still be miserable. — “Because happiness is Krishna's property. It is with Krishna.”

🎙 Maharaj at 16:13 (auto-transcript): “If the Lord is not pleased with someone, nobody can be happy. Only if the Lord is pleased with someone that will be happy. Because happiness is Krishna's property. It is with Krishna. The happiness we are looking for is with Krishna. If he is not pleased with someone, he…”

Indra leads the demigods and enjoys heavenly gardens where even tiredness from enjoyment is washed away in a pool. Yet he is miserable, always anxious that someone's austerity will take his position.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:23 (auto-transcript): “How happy is Lord Indra? How happy is Lord Indra? is the heavenly planet is the leader of all the demon gods all the demigods are he's surrounded he has big position he has all facilities he has a canada garden canada god so so nice that if you are in his in his abode in…”

Indra tried everything to stop Prithu Maharaja's sacrifices. Lord Vishnu came personally but spoke only to Prithu, not to the one who did wrong: you have done ninety-nine, that is enough. Whatever we get in this world fascinates us for a few days, then we want the next thing.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:10 (auto-transcript): “interested at doing austerity is not happy pretty Maharaj he did everything to stop his younger everything but Vishnu has to come personally and tell to tomorrow's place in the more you continue the more devious plan into a go to device so the best thing just stop where you…”

Satisfaction does not come from matter. When we satisfy Krishna by our service we are happy, with or without facilities; without it no one in this world can be happy — the secret people do not know.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:16 (auto-transcript): “none of this matter to all satisfying Krishna yes he wouldn't satisfy Krishna with our services then we'll be happy either with material facilities or not but with that place in Krishna nobody can be happy in this world that is the secret that people don't know in Babakita…”
Maharaj quotes the Gita: only one who has given up desires for sense gratification, proprietorship and false ego attains real peace.

children.topic: Even at the hour of death
children.note: Krishna calls this the way of spiritual and godly life; one so situated is not bewildered and can enter the kingdom of God even at death.

The happiest people in this world are godly people; a materialist cannot be happy. — “one can have money but they cannot buy happiness”

🎙 Maharaj at 25:28 (auto-transcript): “of github 271. people who are very very happy in this world are godly people a materialistic person cannot be happy and wise people wise people say one can have money but they cannot buy happiness with it chita mahaprabhu were traveling with his some of his devotees from from”

Leaving Navadvipa for Jagannatha Puri, Caitanya Mahaprabhu asked his companions whether they had brought money or provisions. They had not, since he had not permitted it, and he was very pleased: they had acted as true renunciates.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:12 (auto-transcript): “with it chita mahaprabhu were traveling with his some of his devotees from from nowadays we're going to jackanapuri to train backward jackanapuri so while they left the navadub we're going to jackanapuri the first place they spend the night jitani mahavro asked”

children.topic: If the Lord permits, nothing blocks
children.note:
If the Lord wants us to eat, we eat even with nothing; if not, we cannot eat even with everything — angry after a quarrel, or sick with fever, the finest food makes us want to throw up.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:26 (auto-transcript): “what you will not eat sometimes it is seen that by nature will have a quarrel and I don't anger so I'm not going to eat food is there because I'm angry I'm not going to eat take your food I'm not eating so what will you do you don't eat you fast seafood what is your food…”

Hiranyakasipu had every power and could have crushed a small boy with two fingers, yet everything he tried failed. He, who should have been happy, lived in anxiety; Prahlada was peaceful. Likewise Indra's clouds of destruction failed against one village. This happens every day, yet we do not see it.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:00 (auto-transcript): “everything positive because impossible yes here I can see food try try so many ways what is power to hamper lad did he succeed didn't succeed he has everything to do what he can do but that was just a small boy under him you can just extinguishing what his two fingers can be…”

Pingala calls herself most stubborn: intense desire to please the senses, though no one past, present or future has ever satisfied them. Then, for the first time, detachment arose.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:48 (auto-transcript): “thank you it's just very small glass yeah i am most stubborn stubborn you have strong desire to gratify the sense very very intense to gratify the senses to please the senses even though we”

children.topic: It came from a pure devotee
children.note:
Her detachment came from the association of a pure devotee; our fortune always comes that way. — “our fortune is from a pure devotee”

🎙 Maharaj at 33:08 (auto-transcript): “came from a pure devotee yes our fortune is from a pure devotee and how did you know that and it's making me very happy you see pngala did not say she was happy while she was gratifying the senses didn't say that i'm very happy enjoying haha see my life is just so i'm…”

Pingala never said she was happy while enjoying her senses. She says happiness came when detachment arose: giving up attachment to temporary things brings freedom, and with freedom comes happiness.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:23 (auto-transcript): “and it's making me very happy you see pngala did not say she was happy while she was gratifying the senses didn't say that i'm very happy enjoying haha see my life is just so i'm completely contented and fully happy satisfied she didn't say that once we're gratifying the…”

If the Lord is not pleased, nothing works for anybody. Maharaj cites a saying of the Lord: without my permission the Kazi could never set foot here — so why are you afraid?

🎙 Maharaj at 34:19 (auto-transcript): “yes the lord is not pleased nothing will happen nothing can work for anybody children have a way to serve us if i did not give permission to kazi he cannot come here to disturb only if i give him permission then he can come and meet you without my permission he would never…”

'I must have done something that pleased him' — service to a pure devotee. Mukti here does not mean getting four arms like Vishnu; it means returning to our original position as Krishna's servant, giving him pleasure with our senses.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:33 (auto-transcript): “true we must have done something that please the lord a service to pure duty my heart even barren movie mootis yes express route for mukti for liberation multi-hypnata reform diversity so you cannot diversity that is mootie not mootie does not have i have ten heads they have…”

If we do not make others happy we cannot be happy; those who give anxiety become miserable themselves. The deluded think they are disturbing someone else, but they disturb only themselves. — “if you don't make someone happy you cannot be happy”

🎙 Maharaj at 36:46 (auto-transcript): “please a lot if you don't make someone happy you cannot be happy people who are giving others anxiety over a man miserable that is a formula because what we give out you get by the results so people who are deluded may think that let me disturb this person you don't disturb…”

Maharaj tells how Suniti counselled her son Dhruva after his stepmother insulted him.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:13 (auto-transcript): “disturb the person you are disturbing yourself Suniti Suniti told her son do a marriage when do a mother was insulted by his stepmother it's routine when driver was trying to climb on the lap of his ton of power would turn up powder means whose feet is is backward turn apart…”

When little Dhruva tried to climb onto King Uttanapada's lap, his stepmother said he must die and be born from her womb to sit there. He looked to his father, who turned his face away, and went to his mother burning with anger.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:32 (auto-transcript): “it's routine when driver was trying to climb on the lap of his ton of power would turn up powder means whose feet is is backward turn apart if it is backward and not forward turn up other this is is backward not forward so cannot think properly yes so he couldn't stop his…”

Seeing him plan revenge, Suniti told him not to wish anyone ill, because what we wish for others returns to us. Dhruva gave up the idea of fighting his stepmother.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:15 (auto-transcript): “to revenge so shooting look at her soul and share the wisdom my dear son do not wish anyone bad because whatever you wish for them was come back to you yes don't wish anyone bad we may think foolishly that I'm doing something for you tomorrow the result will be back we will…”

children.topic: A five-year-old walks to the forest
children.note:
He still wanted something better than his father's throne; Suniti said the sages find the Lord in the forest. A five-year-old walked all the way — Maharaj asks us to see the sacrifice he made to succeed.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:36 (auto-transcript): “better than my father's home so how do I do it then Suniti said I heard from the sages if you're looking for Krishna you go to the forest that is really good oh so for him the forest means now that's why he left camp and work all the way small boy five years can't pour to…”
The verse traces a sequence: detachment lets one give up the bondage of social ties, and great suffering, through hopelessness, gradually makes one indifferent to the world.

Philosophy alone changes nothing. People changed around Srila Prabhupada because of his character, compassion and love — he did something practical.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:26 (auto-transcript): “this is the sequence just philosophy will not do anything philosophy alone will not do anything so the property not changes because of the philosophy he was giving he changed because of the character the compassion the love he has he did something practical a person who has…”

We cannot just declare 'now I am detached'. We practise detachment by becoming attached to Krishna and his devotees; then we gain the strength to be free of society's bondage.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:17 (auto-transcript): “this is a sequence yes not just be detached probably be detached yes yes now i'm detached it cannot work like that we have to practice detachment by being attached to christian devotees or Christian Christian devotee Krishna we give a material attachment we protect detachment…”

children.topic: When there is no hope, let go
children.note:
With no money, profession or relative to obtain an expensive car, a fortunate person simply gives up the desire — unless he wants to become a thief.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:20 (auto-transcript): “detached and indifferent to the material world yes even if we have I have no means I have no means to purchase a very expensive car I have no money I don't have any any professionally hope that okay by my profession I'm going to do this work and we'll do that and that get…”

Searching for the Lord's favourite devotees, Narada watched a king lavishly honour the sadhus at Prayag. The king said he expected no blessing — like someone with no job asking for a loan — and sent Narada to another king who built many temples.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:37 (auto-transcript): “what is the hope what the money is started his journey of looking for a favorite devotees of Krishna he started from prior and we started his journey so when he got to the prayer when I'm only going to prayer to search for favorite devotees of the Lord as he was there is a…”

The Avanti brahmana lost everything; with nothing left to hope for he became indifferent and fortunate. A merchant who never used his wealth for good, he lost it, as nature takes money from those who do not use it as intended.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:51 (auto-transcript): “detached from becoming different or this material from suffering that would happen to the Avanti brahmana Avanti brahmana he he lost everything so there is no hope for anything for him so you were not expecting anything from this material she became indifferent he is so a…”
Pingala sees her suffering as mercy and a sign of the Lord's favour, gives up her sinful desires and takes shelter of him.

To be able to take shelter of the Supreme Person, with complete detachment from matter and attachment to him, is real fortune.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:55 (auto-transcript): “i now take shelter of him the supreme personality this is a fortune one is able to take shelter of the supreme person complete detachment material and becoming attached to it harrya krishnan”

Three questions on family, children and suffering.
