children.topic: The baby locked in the car
children.note:
Maharaj saw a devotee lock his baby in a car to attend a class. That is child abuse — and the illusion is the father's, not the child's. — “it is you who is in maya”

🎙 Maharaj at 55:21 (auto-transcript): “show one devotee he was he went to a temple to hear lecture and he carried his baby with him when he got there he locked the baby in a car and went to seat in the class that is child abuse that is child abuse this maya so i told him that you are in maya not the child it is…”

children.topic: Care for the soul, not the body
children.note:
Our duty is to care for wife and children, but not with attachment to the body. One exemplary devotee prayed: my wife and children are yours, I am simply a caretaker.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:14 (auto-transcript): “but do what our duty is to take care we're always repeating it is in the purpose to be a devotee go and take care of him so child stop the dating worship or take care of his child you have to take care it is our duty to do this to take care yes you should take care of the wife”

Parents who are devotees ask what to do when their children worship demigods at home.

🎙 Maharaj at 58:57 (auto-transcript): “they worship other regards we are devotees but our children are not devotees so they don't follow us to worship krishna they worship demigod in our house what should we do we should tell them to have their house and they can do the worship there. We will take care of them, we…”

It is our fault to have brought children who are not devotees, so we take full responsibility — schooling, support — until they are mature and have their own house for their worship. Don't force them into Krishna consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 59:21 (auto-transcript): “krishna they worship demigod in our house what should we do we should tell them to have their house and they can do the worship there. We will take care of them, we should take care of them because it is our fault to bring children that are no devotees. It's our fault. So we…”

children.topic: Q3 · Does health or wealth help devotion?
children.note:
Krishna consciousness is independent of poverty or wealth, sickness or health.

🎙 Maharaj at 61:02 (auto-transcript): “they're in good position naturally okay so therefore that it depends on the nature of the person depends on the color of the person like this many were saying that Christian consciousness is not just about poverty or wealth it is independent of this the same would hurt so…”

Some become devotees in sickness, some in health. Whatever the condition, a devotee is comfortable and service continues. An impious person who suffers says there is no God; a pious one cries to Krishna for help.

🎙 Maharaj at 61:14 (auto-transcript): “that it depends on the nature of the person depends on the color of the person like this many were saying that Christian consciousness is not just about poverty or wealth it is independent of this the same would hurt so about this answer sorry tackle proper to say I should…”

A senior Vaishnava's test: when you have a problem, do you run to Siva or to Krishna? Having no protector or shelter except Krishna is one of the six qualities of surrender.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:01 (auto-transcript): “he's only god gobina maharaj said how do you know a devotee when you have problem who do you run to that is when you know a devotee i have a problem what do you run to go to shiva or you go to krishna so if he if one is a duty you you cry to Chris don't go to nobody you cry…”

children.topic: The leper who preferred his sickness
children.note:
Maharaj tells of a pure devotee covered with sores who put fallen maggots back on his body. Healed by the Lord, he was sad: with a repulsive body no one disturbed his service, while a handsome body draws everyone's attention.

🎙 Maharaj at 64:44 (auto-transcript): “have many many many do what issue so I take us one when he was coming to see to them after where he didn't pass to a public road because it's a big man they would identify him when he told I to the jailkeeper to leave him to go and he will listen that business so he didn't…”

Rupa Gosvami writes that Krishna will go anywhere to deliver his devotee, yet in pain we ask why he does not come. Pray instead: you know what I'm passing through; if this is good for me leave it, if not take it — you know best.

🎙 Maharaj at 69:12 (auto-transcript): “oh krishna why do you give me this terrible body i'm suffering i have taken i have given my life to krishna now instead of becoming happy and satisfied i'm getting so many problems so is it better to be a devotee not to be a devotee not those thoughts come to the mind when we…”

nodeData.topic: Class 13 · Pingala Day 04 · Demigods are Not Our Shelter
nodeData.note: SB 11.8.36 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Pingala sees that no man, and not even a demigod, can give real happiness, because all are temporary and swept away by time. Maharaj describes material life as a house on fire, with anxiety at every stage from birth to old age, and concludes with Pingala that we should turn only to Krishna. In the questions he tells how a temple president kept him in the movement, why devotees should appreciate other paths, and why Krishna lets spiritual life feel hard. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Pingala reflects that men, and even the demigods, are temporary beings dragged away by time, so how much happiness could any of them really give?

children.topic: We help each other waste time
children.note:
Thinking it over, Pingala sees that so-called material relationships are all cheating — there is nothing inside them. — “We just help each other to waste our time.”

🎙 Maharaj at 21:09 (auto-transcript): “Yes, our so-called relationship in the material here is all cheating, all is cheating. There's nothing inside. We just help each other to waste our time. It's what we're doing. We simply help each other. Let's come together and waste our time. Because if people have the same…”

People with the same problem feel relief in coming together. Unable to control our senses, we find others who cannot either, and call wasting time together a good routine.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:40 (auto-transcript): “Because if people have the same problem, come together to share their difficulties, there's happiness in it. There's pleasure in it. If you don't have any person who had the same problem like you, it's difficult to handle it. So people who have the same problem, come together…”

We approach even the demigods for facilities to enjoy, and they may give them — but how much can anyone in this world really provide for anyone else?

🎙 Maharaj at 22:42 (auto-transcript): “So Pingela is saying that, yes, the men will provide the same Gautama movement. They will provide the same Gautama movement, both for each other, including the demigods. Including even the demigods, we approach them for so many facilities for the same Gautama movement. They…”

A doctor treats a patient with good medicine, good intention and experience, yet the soul leaves the body and he is helpless. Does he return the fee out of sympathy? No — we are all playing each other's game.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:29 (auto-transcript): “A doctor may take care of a patient very nicely with perfect medicine, with a good intention, with all the experience. Their body will go. The soul will leave their body. And their body becomes useless. What would the doctor do? He's helpless. But he has collected his money.…”

Pingala says the demigods, though higher than us, are not our well-wishers; they too use us for their own satisfaction.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:33 (auto-transcript): “So, Pingala said, even the demigods who are higher than us, they are not our well-wishers. Because even the demigods themselves, they are using us for their own sanctification. They are using it for sanctification. They are all temporary creations that imperceptible time…”

All are temporary creations that time finishes imperceptibly. No one sees himself growing old, though nature sends signal after signal.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:05 (auto-transcript): “They are all temporary creations that imperceptible time would finish everything, imperceptibly. No one sees that he's growing old, nobody sees it. Even though material energy, material nature sends so many signals, we don't see it. We still feel that yes, everything is…”

A patient lies in hospital with tubes all over the body, and when asked how he is, he answers 'fine'. Maharaj asks — fine like this? — “Nobody is fine in this material. Nobody is fine.”

🎙 Maharaj at 25:36 (auto-transcript): “A person is lying in the hospital with a lot of drifts all over the body and things. They say, how are you? What is the answer? Fine. Fine. Fine like this? Fine like this, fine inside here? Nobody is fine in this material. Nobody is fine. I remember my assumption was that he…”

Maharaj shares a chastisement he says he will never forget, received soon after joining.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:03 (auto-transcript): “I remember my assumption was that he chastised me, severely. I never forget it. I'll be repeating it. I never forget it. I came to Christian Constantine with a religious Bible. My expectation is that everything will be nice. Every devotee, 100%, no devotee in misbehaving.…”

He came from a religious life expecting every devotee to be flawless; instead he met misbehaviour and a lack of simple etiquette, and it was torture for him.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:14 (auto-transcript): “I came to Christian Constantine with a religious Bible. My expectation is that everything will be nice. Every devotee, 100%, no devotee in misbehaving. This was my expectation when I came to J.M.M.H. I'm not expecting to see a devotee breaking principle, not keeping, stealing…”

children.topic: No peaceful room in a burning house
children.note:
He was told: you are a fool, looking for a peaceful room in a house that is on fire — wherever you sleep, the fire will reach you. Every planet in the material world has the same miseries.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:35 (auto-transcript): “the mentality everything to be peaceful everything to be nice so only good they have said you are a fool you live in a house which is burning the house on fire and you want to find the world peaceful man sleep there that is foolishness the fire is in the building so any room…”

Birth, old age, disease and their faults are found everywhere, from Brahma's planet to the lowest. One who tries to squeeze happiness out of this world never succeeds; it is not designed for that.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:24 (auto-transcript): “I find peace yes this is free from all but two but two jarad beady dosa doka there is no way you don't find this this dualities everywhere you go to this dualities are there a Brahma book on a long car any any right from the Brahma's planet today down the lowest they are all…”

children.topic: The wise smile and get out
children.note:
As the Gita teaches, the temporary cannot be made permanent nor the eternal soul temporary. The one who knows does not lament; he does what is necessary and gets out. — “One who knows will simply smile at the situation as it is going.”

🎙 Maharaj at 29:55 (auto-transcript): “One who knows cannot lament. One who knows will simply smile at the situation as it is going. One just take it like that and do what is necessary and get out. That is our duty. to do what is necessary and get out. Not to stay here until... Yes, as Labakti no Takura said, the…”

Maharaj takes up a song of Bhaktivinoda Thakura: material nature's noose is on my neck — where can I go? He follows it through the stages of life.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:19 (auto-transcript): “Yes, as Labakti no Takura said, the newest material nature is on my neck. Where to go? Labakti no Takura. As I appeared in this material world as a baby, I was helplessly on the lap of my parents and they pampered me, turned me here and there, they even designate me to a…”

As a baby we lie helpless in our parents' lap; they shape us and assign us a tribe and a culture, and we are told we cannot act like any other tribe.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:34 (auto-transcript): “As I appeared in this material world as a baby, I was helplessly on the lap of my parents and they pampered me, turned me here and there, they even designate me to a particular culture, you are this tribe. That's really imposed on me. With all that I came with, addition, I'm…”

He recalls how the Kazi told a Muslim-born devotee he would be killed for taking up a 'lower' religion. Quoting another sannyasi: if violence leads to God, there must be violence in God's kingdom — why go somewhere more violent than here?

🎙 Maharaj at 31:24 (auto-transcript): “The Kazi told us, you are Muslim, you can never do any other other form of civilization than being a Muslim. Our Quran is against that. Contrary to this, you are bound to be killed. You are Muslim. Why do you accept a low-class religion When you already have an exalted…”

Growing up, education is worshipped. Children now carry extra lessons and intense competition from an early age, and are anxious from childhood.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:27 (auto-transcript): “And when I grew up, education became my deity to worship. That is the preoccupation. And especially these days, you have to go to school, you have to do a lesson, right? At our time, we don't have a lesson. When we finish school, we finish. When we finish, we finish. Then we…”

After the competition for marks and jobs, some students take their own lives over a lower result. Maharaj asks: is that necessary? Those who survive face the same struggle and tension at work.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:47 (auto-transcript): “After the heavy competition, another one college in India, it is known for suicide in Bombay. After heavy competition in education, the last competition is, I'm going to get a job. The student will jump from the building and commit suicide. Why? Or somebody committed suicide.…”

Then marriage, children and management add more anxiety. At the end only fear of death remains, and the old begin to envy the young.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:10 (auto-transcript): “Then, after that, if we manage to survive with this competition, marriage, oh, another branch of anxiety, right? So much anxiety, so many complications, and then, oh, children will come. oh, management, oh, everything, everything. There's no single face of a material life…”

The struggle to exist requires activity, and that activity creates anxiety for other living beings. How can we give others anxiety and expect peace?

🎙 Maharaj at 35:55 (auto-transcript): “our existence. Where is the peace we are looking for? Where is it? In the middle of all these things, we are also casting a lot of anxiety upon other living entities. Because it's Because it's a struggle to exist. Struggle means what? Struggle requires activities. It's a…”

Around 25 December billions of animals, and many plants, are killed for one day's satisfaction of the tongue.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:25 (auto-transcript): “Wait for December 25th, you see how many souls are going to be perished? Animals, billions. It's only the same as Madame Swami used to give statistics, give the figure. The billions of living entities are killed. Varieties are being eaten, not only chicken or goat or sheep,…”

Nobody teaches this now. Schools like the gurukula began with religious people; now scientists run them. A university in Brazil debated whether religion is even relevant, and a school in Uganda invited Maharaj and then told him not to speak about religion.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:12 (auto-transcript): “but nobody to teach this education nobody to teach it in the beginning in the beginning of human civilization the schools are missionaries not scientists gurkul gurkul is not scientist gurkul is a missionary is it is religious or religious people that started school gurkul…”

How much happiness can they give? Nothing. From now on, wherever we stand, want nothing except serving the Lord — only Krishna gives what we are looking for.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:26 (auto-transcript): “So Pingala said, Therefore now, how much actual pleasure or happiness could any of them ever give to their wives? How much? It is nothing. nothing. What is the conclusion? Pingala concluded. Therefore, my recommendation is that from now onward, from now onward, at this stage…”

Spiritual life is even harder to take up than material life, but its difficulty is final: it purifies us and ends material existence, while material problems come one after another without end. — “that difficulty is final that is final”

🎙 Maharaj at 41:28 (auto-transcript): “Yes, yes, you can say, but is it also easy to take spiritual life? Is it also even more difficult than material? Yes. it is more even even more difficult to take and is very difficult to take the special life but that difficulty is final that is final after crossing the…”

Several questions and comments from the assembly.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:04 (auto-transcript): “Sometimes you... Yes. What is that message to join one, just join or about to join, somehow whether this message will be soon or later? Yes. How could some people just leave the Bupata now to do this? That was my situation. It was my situation. so after after i stayed in the…”

children.topic: Q1 · Why do new devotees leave?
children.note:
A devotee asks about people who join and soon leave Srila Prabhupada's movement. Maharaj says that was his own situation.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:10 (auto-transcript): “What is that message to join one, just join or about to join, somehow whether this message will be soon or later? Yes. How could some people just leave the Bupata now to do this? That was my situation. It was my situation. so after after i stayed in the temple for two weeks…”

After two weeks in the temple he told the president he was leaving and listed everyone's faults. The president said: these people are twenty percent above the mundane; you can't tolerate twenty, but you're comfortable with zero? Maharaj stayed and still honours him.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:37 (auto-transcript): “so after after i stayed in the temple for two weeks so i went to the temple president i told him i want to go back to my house he said why so see this is what you see this one i i i knew all the nonsense things i said see this one see this one i gave all the analysis complete…”

In his list he never mentioned that same president, who rose early, chanted, knew and followed scripture. There are always a few doing the right thing; look at them. — “So let us look at those who are doing the right thing.”

🎙 Maharaj at 46:16 (auto-transcript): “So in the middle of this, you see there are some people who are trying. So it's better for us to follow those who are trying and not look at those who are not trying. I didn't see that. So he helped me to see it. Let us say anything about him, but he is different. He gets up…”

Why be disturbed that someone worships your Krishna by kneeling, facing a direction or standing? Your Krishna is so great that everyone takes a different aspect of him. With that vision we would not have trouble with other traditions.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:12 (auto-transcript): “So Bhakti Mata Kora, he has a different vision, powerful one. So Bhakti Mata Kora said,”

Krishna allows different systems because people are in different modes. Remove kindergarten and primary school and no one reaches university; we came up through stages and others will too.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:56 (auto-transcript): “It begins from there. It's just like if you remove a kindergarten, primary school, secondary college, you remove or leave only university. Who will go to university? From where? From where will you be trained to go to university? Where? There is a need for kindergarten…”

children.topic: Many lifetimes behind the holy name
children.note: Devahuti's famous verse: one whose tongue chants the holy name has already done all austerities and pilgrimages in past lives. Piety alone is not enough — great fortune brings us to a devotee who pushes us into Krishna consciousness.

children.topic: Q2 · Should we preach across traditions?
children.note:
Preaching is the essence, yet some people from other traditions are disturbed when we try to help them. Should we leave them alone?

🎙 Maharaj at 55:04 (auto-transcript): “You are trying to help someone from other traditions and bring them to Krishna consciousness. All of them come successfully, but others are disturbed. At the same time, Shrapa Wuppat said that preaching is the essence. But I think others are getting disturbed silently, doing…”

We cannot force anyone; our duty is to present. Using Jesus' parable, Maharaj says seed falling on rock, water or sand does not grow; only good soil bears fruit. We have been saved to save others. — “Our duty is to show the seed.”

🎙 Maharaj at 55:40 (auto-transcript): “Yes, we cannot force somebody to take the Christian conscience. We can only present what we have to do. That is our duty. And Jesus used the word, to show the seed. Our duty is to show the seed. Some seeds are going to be on the good soil. Some will fall on the rock. The seed…”

Present Krishna consciousness to anyone; people's reactions show whom to continue with, and those whose karma permits will let the seed grow.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:07 (auto-transcript): “We can present our Christian consciousness to anybody. Their reactions will let us know whom we should continue with and whom we should give up. When they think for the time, their karma will permit them to accept. So those whose karma is right, will continue to find the seed…”

children.topic: Q3 · Why is spiritual life so hard?
children.note:
Some struggling devotees grow frustrated and start to blame the Lord: if Krishna wants us, why make it so difficult?

🎙 Maharaj at 57:52 (auto-transcript): “How in our position we are so tired of these problems to come to state, to come to society. You mentioned that in this unconsciousness also we are not free from having their own community. It says that to be our loss after that we get a permanent time. It's so happened that…”

It is not easy to come where we are. Thousands sit on Himalayan ice seeking God-realisation and never come here; that Krishna brought us is supreme mercy.

🎙 Maharaj at 59:54 (auto-transcript): “to bring us here, is it not a message? Just to bring us here. See, it's not easy to come here. It's not easy to come where we are. It's not easy. Not easy, we don't look at it commonly. It's not easy to come here. See, there are thousands of people sitting on top of ice in…”

Maharaj's father, a strict kshatriya, was criticised for his discipline; later, seeing how the 'free' children turned out, Maharaj came to appreciate him. We complain about Krishna the same way.

🎙 Maharaj at 61:27 (auto-transcript): “I remember how my father is very hard, very hard, he's a satriya, the remnant of satriyas, the actual satriyas, the remnant. None of us misbehaved. All my sisters, they went to the husband's house in Beijing because of the strictness of my father. Oh, you cannot miss me. So…”

Krishna makes it hard so that we find we cannot do it alone and cry out — Krishna, please help me. That helpless dependence is the complete surrender Pingala spoke of.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:04 (auto-transcript): “yes it is hard for us to pay the price because we are not understanding this that is why it is like that Christian made it so hard so that you will find that I cannot do this on my own and cry that is the price because I want us to pay until you do that it will still be like…”

children.topic: Q4 · Your lecture feels aimed at us
children.note:
A devotee says that when they hear Maharaj, the problems he describes seem to concern them.

🎙 Maharaj at 65:08 (auto-transcript): “Materiality is definitely very difficult, as you say, and spiritual life is also very difficult. When we hear your lecture, we feel that the problem that you are dealing concerns us. You feel that work has been done for you? Yes. Yes. That is how we should take it. A…”

That is the right way to take it. An unfortunate devotee says 'tell them, it's for them'; a sincere devotee thinks Krishna is sending this message to me.

🎙 Maharaj at 65:47 (auto-transcript): “A fortunate devotee will say, oh, this thing is for me. A good devotee. Unfortunately, the devotees said, yes, I know them. Tell them. I know you are talking. Tell them. I've been talking about it. Nobody is hearing me. Please. Tell them. It is for them. I know them. I know…”

maps.title: SB Canto 11 · Class 12 · Pingala Day 03 · The Price of Surrender

nodeData.topic: Class 12 · Pingala Day 03 · The Price of Surrender
nodeData.note: SB 11.8.34–35 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Pingala admits her foolishness in neglecting the Lord, and Maharaj shows why no living being can have a life apart from him. The price of having Krishna is complete surrender, which Maharaj illustrates with the Pandavas, a servant who asked the king for friendship, and Krishna's blessings in Mathura. In the questions he urges devotees to measure their practice and consciously work on themselves. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Pingala confesses that she alone in her city was so foolish as to neglect the Lord who gives everything, even one's original form, and look elsewhere for pleasure.

children.topic: No life apart from the Lord
children.note:
Maharaj says the foolishness is to want a life separate from the Lord, because such a life is simply not possible. — “It is foolishness for anyone who desires to have a separate life from the Lord.”

🎙 Maharaj at 19:27 (auto-transcript): “It is foolishness for anyone who desires to have a separate life from the Lord. It is foolishness because it is not possible for anyone to live separately from the Lord. prophet gave example a cut off hand has no value trying to live separate from the lord that would means…”

Srila Prabhupada's example: a hand cut off from the body has no value. We are important and useful only while connected with the Lord.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:55 (auto-transcript): “prophet gave example a cut off hand has no value trying to live separate from the lord that would means going to be a separated hand the hand is important only when it's connected with the whole body we are important and useful only when we remain with the lord we cannot live…”

As water is the natural home of a fish, the natural situation of every living being is to live with the Lord.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:25 (auto-transcript): “life from the supreme lord it is not possible just like a fish cannot live outside water the natural habitats for fishes to remain in the water the natural situation for all living entities to live is to live with the lord the lord has created all of us for his enjoyment it…”

Someone who builds a factory knows what he wants to produce and why; everything produced is for him. The Lord expanded us for his enjoyment, and the goods cannot be independent of the master.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:56 (auto-transcript): “He has a purpose, expanding all of us. Like someone is tabulating a company, he has a purpose. He knows what he wants to produce and why he wants to produce the goods. He knows. Then he will produce that and everything that he produces is for him, not for somebody else. The…”

Pingala came to this realisation by the mercy of the devotee's presence: Dattatreya was nearby, and that made her fortunate.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:45 (auto-transcript): “So Pingala has come to this realization by the mercy of Dr. Treya. You see, Dr. Treyadesi's presence in his vicinity made him fortunate that he has come to realize her foolishness. So, Pringala is teaching us so many things, he is teaching us so many things, he is teaching us…”

The powerful lesson of these verses: once we find our mistake, we do not defend, compromise or justify it. We do what Pingala does. She represents all of us who have chased sense gratification since we came into this world. — “it is not to compromise it is not to find a way to defend ourselves”

🎙 Maharaj at 22:38 (auto-transcript): “when one has discovered his or her mistakes the next thing to do is not to justify our mistakes our deviation it is not to compromise it is not to find a way to defend ourselves it is simply to do what Pingala is doing here. She is teaching. In other words, Pingala represents…”

Krishna is the supreme friend who shares his opulences in full. Maharaj asks where in this world we can find anyone who does that.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:51 (auto-transcript): “the other day Spengala shared with us that Lord Krishna being the supreme friend shares with what his six prophecies in full what are the reservations Where do we have a person who can do this? Where? In the highest person in this material world, Lord Brahma. Let us try to…”

When the earth prayed for relief, Brahma and the demigods went to Lord Vishnu — but not to the Vishnu in Brahma's own abode. Maharaj asks: magnanimity or selfishness? Brahma did not want his own place left empty, so he went to another place. If even the highest person is like this, what of us?

🎙 Maharaj at 24:08 (auto-transcript): “Where do we have a person who can do this? Where? In the highest person in this material world, Lord Brahma. Let us try to understand. The highest person in this world, Lord Brahma, is such a local. Lord Vishnu lives there. Lord Vishnu, he lives there in Brahma's abode. But…”

Here we give the beggar what is useless to us — the scrap, the cloth we don't like. No one buys a new car and hands it to a beggar.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:16 (auto-transcript): “Here in the material world, we give a gift to those people, especially the useless people. things which are useless for us. I've seen someone buy a car and give to a beggar from the shop. Buy a car from the shop and give to a beggar. You'll keep a scrap that is not useful for…”

We can all testify that no one finds lasting enjoyment here. Expanding our ignorance never makes us knowledgeable; the process is to reduce it. — “We have to reduce ignorance.”

🎙 Maharaj at 27:21 (auto-transcript): “with the world no one no one is serving and we would never have it because we we we can we cannot expand our ignorance and become knowledgeable who can who can reduce ignorance become knowledgeable but not expanding ignorance and become knowledgeable do not work like that it…”

children.topic: Turning away is a great offence
children.note:
Pingala sees that for so long she neglected the Lord whose greatest interest is to restore our original form. Maharaj calls turning away from Krishna a dangerous and devastating offence we have all committed. — “It's a great offence to turn away from Krishna.”

🎙 Maharaj at 28:01 (auto-transcript): “So Pingala is teaching, now I have come to this realization that for so long I have neglected the supreme procedure of Waterhead. Highest the interest to give us our own original form. We have neglected that because it is a great offense. We have done that. It's a great…”
Pingala resolves to pay the price of complete surrender to the Lord, the dearmost well-wisher in every heart, and so to enjoy with him as Lakshmi does.

This is intelligence: after realising the truth, give everything — body, life, senses — and hold nothing back. That is the price.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:20 (auto-transcript): “will now pay the price of completion. I will give my life now to the Lord. This is intelligence. Now I will give my life to the Lord. After realizing this, I will not hold back anything i will not do anything else let me completely give myself i'll give my body i'll give my…”

Maharaj cites Rupa Gosvami: one who gives words, intelligence, mind and activities to the Lord is liberated even while still in the material world.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:02 (auto-transcript): “He said, One who has given his words, intelligence, mind, our activities, everything to the Lord, is a liberated soul even though it's still in the material it's a given motor so pingala said i will give everything to the supreme lord i will surrender completely this is what”

children.topic: Like an object in the master's hand
children.note:
Complete surrender is a heavy word: no independence. Whatever the master wants, I cannot say no or argue — like a thing that does not say 'don't put me on the left, put me on the right'.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:35 (auto-transcript): “what the master desired I cannot say no and I cannot argue I don't have otherwise what the master said that is what I will do whatever he likes to me like myself you want to keep it here you don't say no no don't keep me there this is surrender. If I pick, I'm not saying, no,…”

There is cause and effect. Pingala says that by surrendering completely she will capture the Lord and enjoy with him exactly as Lakshmi Devi does.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:24 (auto-transcript): “She said complete surrender. And she also gave us the effect of surrender. There is a cause and effect of everything. Here she explains the cause of surrender. What is the cause of surrender? She said, the cause of my surrendering completely to the Lord is that I will capture…”

The Pandavas were praised for having the 'mystic power' to make Krishna their servant. The power was complete surrender: Krishna put them through hardship all their lives and they never asked why.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:56 (auto-transcript): “complete surrender. Hanuman said, O Pandavas, you have the mystic in the mystic spells to make Lord Krishna the Supreme Personality of Godhead your servant. You have the mystic power to do that. Only you have the mystic power to do that. Why? Because of the early word of…”

For eighteen days Arjuna rested his feet on Krishna's shoulder to guide the chariot, and Krishna did not complain. Every day Krishna also washed and fed Arjuna's horses.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:13 (auto-transcript): “was kicking off Krishna for 18 days from his shoulder, with his feet, the touch he devotes with the feet is an offense, Arjuna was not touching Krishna with the feet, Arjuna was placing his feet on Krishna's shoulder for 18 days, Krishna didn't complain, and Arjuna didn't…”

The world saw a ghastly war with millions dying. Underneath it a quiet, intimate exchange of love between Krishna and Arjuna went on that nobody saw. — “We didn't see the lovely dealing, intimate lovely dealing between Krishna and Arjuna.”

🎙 Maharaj at 34:58 (auto-transcript): “We didn't see the lovely dealing, intimate lovely dealing between Krishna and Arjuna. We didn't see that. It's already fighting. Millions of people dying, horses, childhood elephants, all are dead. That is what we saw, horror. But under that, see what Krishna does, under…”

Yudhisthira could ask Krishna not to leave for Dvaraka, and the Supreme Lord would agree — a few more days — not grudgingly but with joy, because their love controlled him.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:33 (auto-transcript): “Yudhisattva Maharaj has the power to tell you Krishna, Krishna wants to go to Burka. Krishna, please don't go today. Krishna said, why? Why? I'm the Supreme Lord. But Krishna said, yes. Yes, my Lord. Yes. How many days more? Say for a few days, yes, yes, yes. Happily without…”

Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati Thakura: Krishna is not obliged to one who is 90 or 99 percent surrendered — only to one who is 100 percent. That was the Pandavas' life.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:22 (auto-transcript): “Shriva Bhaktisiddhanta Saravati Takura. Lord, Krishna is not obliged to anyone who is 90% surrounded, 99% surrounded. Krishna is not obliged. Krishna is obliged to only the person who is 100% surrounded. That is the life of the Pandavas. So, Pingala is sharing her…”

We do sense gratification hoping to enjoy; Pingala says the way to enjoy is complete surrender to Krishna. Surrender has six fundamentals — two for the beginner, four for the intermediate, all six for the topmost devotee.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:30 (auto-transcript): “The way to enjoy is to surrender completely to Krishna. And in that complete surrender, which has six qualities, surrender has six fundamentals, not just surrender. There's six qualities. The qualities that make something what it is. It is the quality. I mean, surrender soul…”

The first two: what we should do — chant, attend programs, hear scripture, serve — and what we should not do — sinful life. Maharaj says we are still struggling with just these two.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:20 (auto-transcript): “six is for Tam Bacta, complete surrender. Yama and Niyama. Keep away from false pillars of sinful activities and chances. This is Yama and Niyama in the Yama. The things we should do and the things we shouldn't do. Turn six around, attend programs, hear the scriptures, do…”

If we give up sinful habits with regret, it is not surrender yet. Surrender is giving them up joyfully and being grateful for the chance to chant, hear and serve, because these are the soul's own activities. — “Surrender means that we are not regretting giving of sinful activities.”

🎙 Maharaj at 40:06 (auto-transcript): “We are struggling with these two, yama and yama. The things you should do and the things you don't do. We are not practicing giving of sinful life happily. It means we are still struggling with this. We are not happily giving of sinful activities. So it is not surrender yet.…”

Pingala does not seek the Lord by claiming equal rights; she purchases him by giving her life. Maharaj contrasts this with the modern 'equal rights' mood, which he rejects as not the way.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:40 (auto-transcript): “I will purchase the Lord by surrendering, not by equal rights. What a man can do, a woman can do, that is demonic. perfect philosophy is working I will completely surrender to the Lord in this way I will purchase him and enjoy with him the same way that's really this is the…”

Only Krishna, the real friend of conditioned souls, can award the highest perfection; others give something small and temporary.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:31 (auto-transcript): “friend of all conditioned souls is the supreme and only he can award the highest perfection in life. Only Krishna. No one else can do this. Otherwise, they would take something small from Krishna and deceive us with it, with the temple, which is temporary. Krishna doesn't…”
In the Gita Krishna promises those who worship him with exclusive devotion to supply what they lack and preserve what they have — he stays with them so it never runs out.

What the demigods give ends with the body; the only thing that travels with us is the sinful reaction from enjoying it. Krishna gives eternal benefit without such reactions.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:01 (auto-transcript): “will make sure it is inexhaustible. Demi-God doesn't promise that. Not Demi-God that ever says that. Demi-God can't give. Go. But Krishna says, no, I will not give you, I will go away. I will give you, I will stay with you, so that you know I will get finished. So whatever…”

children.topic: The servant who asked for the king
children.note:
A king asked his servants for lists of what they wanted. All brought long lists except one, who asked only that the king be his friend. The others' gifts were used up in days; to visit his friend the king had to build a road and a palace like his own. Who gained more?

🎙 Maharaj at 46:20 (auto-transcript): “there is one intelligent servant which will learn very intelligent he had been working with the king for many years so only the king he told the servant i'm preparing i'm preparing for So I want all of you to bring the list of the things you need. So I want to remodelerate…”

Before reaching Kamsa, Krishna killed the insulting washerman and blessed the florist who gave him a garland and the tailor who dressed him, giving them his own opulence and sending them back to Godhead. Make Krishna our friend and nothing is missing.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:50 (auto-transcript): “When Krishna came to Mathura, the first day Krishna came to Mathura, he did. Before he even got to the cancer, Krishna did so many powerful persons. Krishna met with... I want to start with the inauspicious one. Let me go to the inauspicious one. He did three things. The…”

One devotee asks for encouragement before the Ratha-yatra.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:06 (auto-transcript): “pingala the process allegation comments or questions yes like he told the maraj that you should not give up what you desire most”

children.topic: Q1 · How do we resist immediate gratification?
children.note:
A devotee notes that we are still tempted to trade what we want most for what feels good now, and asks for advice for practitioners still struggling with the mind.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:46 (auto-transcript): “like he told the maraj that you should not give up what you desire most for something that feels good now. So it is very much in line with what we've been discussing. And Sra. Prabhupada mentioned that surrender is a process of surrender. And like we, we are in Salakas, on…”

To sacrifice the highest for the immediate is childish; anything good that is immediate ends. The intelligent look for what is everlasting.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:44 (auto-transcript): “Yes, thank you. Thank you for the contribution. It is charity for any one of us. It is charity of us to sacrifice the highest thing for immediate. That is childish. Immediate means what? Anything good is immediate doesn't last. It doesn't last. It will end. So an intelligent…”

Pure devotion cannot be measured, but our practice must be. We are struggling with two of six qualities; we should know the goal and the steps toward it. — “But we have to measure our practice to know where we are”

🎙 Maharaj at 56:01 (auto-transcript): “Please, let us try to measure our Krishna consciousness. Pure devotional service, perfect Krishna consciousness is not measurable. But we have to measure our practice to know where we are, which is very very important. We should measure where we are. If you don't do this, it…”

Like little Krishna who would not stop running from Yasoda until she dropped the stick, we cannot stop: Maya is moving, and this is a movement — if we stop, we become a casualty.

🎙 Maharaj at 57:19 (auto-transcript): “move because the person is chasing you have not stopped running you stop running you are casualty but I saw that we're telling crystal stop running Christian said, no, I cannot stop. You drop the cane first, then I can stop. If you don't stop, you say, who drop the cane? I…”

Krishna in the Gita describes the process of falling down; Rupa Gosvami gives the process of rising: a little faith brings us to the sadhu, the sadhu brings bhajana-kriya, and bhajana-kriya naturally reduces anarthas — if we work on ourselves.

🎙 Maharaj at 58:23 (auto-transcript): “Rupa Goswami gave us this process of climbing up. In Bhagavad Gita, Krishna gave us a process of falling down. Rupa Goswami gave us a process of falling up, to go up. Both of them are in our scripture. Rupa Goswami said, Adho Tata Sadhu Sangha. Adho Sadhu Sangha. Is that the…”

Many keep Krishna consciousness secondary: we come for the prasadam and skip the arati, and after fifty years still read Guru-astaka from the board. Without conscious effort the chanting has little effect; chant with the tongue and hear with the ear.

🎙 Maharaj at 61:13 (auto-transcript): “I give an example, many of us see Christian consciousness as secondary thing, secondary concern. Our first priority is not Christian consciousness. Our first priority is material life. We give importance to our material life than to spiritual life. So we minimize the saddoest…”

maps.title: SB Canto 11 · Class 11 · Truth of the Material Body

nodeData.topic: Class 11 · Truth of the Material Body
nodeData.note: SB 11.8.33 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Pingala looks honestly at the body she had served and sees bones, waste and a thin covering of skin. Maharaj links this to the Bhagavatam's warning about identifying with the body, explains that holy places are meant for hearing from sadhus rather than only bathing, and walks through the nine gates to show that a civilisation focused on the body is wasting human life. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The verse is Pingala's realisation about what her own body really is and why it was foolish to look for love and pleasure in it. It was read with a French translation and then in English.

Maharaj stresses that this is not a lecture given to Pingala — it is what she herself came to see when her hopes were frustrated.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:11 (auto-transcript): “This is Pingala's realization. There is another place in Fagodan. This material body is made of three elements, as Pengana mentioned here. I don't know if I'm going to mention that the material is composed of three elements.”
Maharaj brings in another place in the Bhagavatam where the body is described as made of three elements, and one who takes it as the self is compared to a cow or an ass.

He asks everyone in the room to imagine removing just a little of the skin that covers us — what would we see? Nothing anyone would want to embrace.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:21 (auto-transcript): “If all of us here, all of us Si tout le monde est ici Il prend le bled lead just just remove this just remove this cover a little litter what will you see like it But how thick is it? How thick is this covered? How thick is it?”

How thick is the covering? Very thin. It is only a coating over blood, bones and stool, and still the whole world is attracted to it. — “Very thin. This is the coating of material waste.”

🎙 Maharaj at 20:56 (auto-transcript): “But how thick is it? How thick is this covered? How thick is it? Very thin. This is the coating of material waste. But tell him he just coated this blood, these bones and blood and stool. but it just coated it and we are all attracted to it.”

The wonder is not the body but our attraction to it; wise people find this situation lamentable.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:16 (auto-transcript): “But tell him he just coated this blood, these bones and blood and stool. but it just coated it and we are all attracted to it. Our situation is lamentable by those who know the truth. One who identifies himself as an innate body composed of mucus, pile, and air, who assumes…”

Explaining the verse, Maharaj notes how people treat family and possessions as permanently theirs and spend their energy acquiring and protecting them.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:06 (auto-transcript): “There is a lot of people asking him for the family. He is supposed to be permanent. However, he is going to be posthote at the same time using his own functions. And in the same time... He is going to be able to buy things in a certain way, to buy things in a different way.…”

The verse also criticises those who see a holy place as merely its water. Srila Prabhupada spoke of people going to holy places only to bathe, not for spiritual realisation.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:30 (auto-transcript): “So the prophet was talking about people going to holy places, only for beating, not to Access to spiritual realization. These days,”

Maharaj observes that these days many go to holy places not even to bathe — as tourists — and never hear from sadhus at all.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:13 (auto-transcript): “These days, people are going to holy places, not even for beating. not even for beating not hearing from sadhus the reason why the scripture recommends that we should visit holy places”

Holy places matter because sadhus live there or visit regularly. Going there, we may be fortunate to meet them and hear Krishna-katha — that is the reason scripture recommends pilgrimage.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:47 (auto-transcript): “the reason why the scripture recommends that we should visit holy places It is not just to visit places, because these holy places, the saddos live there, or they visit the place regularly. So when we go to these places, we will be fortunate to meet them. and here krishna…”

Inexperienced devotees arranged Srila Prabhupada's camp at the far edge of a Kumbha Mela. He was angry: he had come to preach, and they had put him where no one could reach him. To the idea of bathing he replied that his devotees were already pure.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:36 (auto-transcript): “on the place one of the kumbhamellas so the papa visited the devotees were not experienced So they arranged the proper camp to the end, at the end of the hole. When Prophet came, and he saw his place, next to the end of the whole thing, Prophet was angry.”

The real bath and the real meal is hearing about Krishna, not the water alone. The soul is nourished through the ears, so pure devotees always want to hear and speak about Krishna. — “So the pure devotees want to hear about Krishna, speak about Krishna.”

🎙 Maharaj at 27:04 (auto-transcript): “Real beating, real eating is Krishna Gata, not water, not just water. So here, a soul will be nourished if we hear that is beating on the soul. That's the eating for the soul, Krishna Kata, it is taken through the ears.”

Pingala laments that she never gave her life to hearing about Krishna; she was busy caring for a body she imagined to be strong. — “So Pingala said, I did not give my life to hearing about Krishna.”

🎙 Maharaj at 28:00 (auto-transcript): “So Pingala said, I did not give my life to hearing about Krishna. Instead, I was really busy taking care of this body which you would feel is very strong. This material body were nine gates, the two eyes.”

Maharaj goes through the nine openings of the body one by one, questioning the audience about what comes out of each.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:20 (auto-transcript): “This material body were nine gates, the two eyes. What comes from the two eyes? Tears. What kind of tears? What kind of tears is that? Anxiety, distress.”

What comes from the eyes? Tears — but not yet tears of love of God; they are tears of anxiety and distress.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:45 (auto-transcript): “What comes from the two eyes? Tears. What kind of tears? What kind of tears is that? Anxiety, distress. It's not a pure love of God yet. It's anxiety. It's anxiety. Two nostrils. What come up from the nostrils? Doctor, what's wrong with you?”

He asks, half joking, whether what comes from the nose is prasadam. From the nostrils and the ears comes only contamination.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:19 (auto-transcript): “Two nostrils. What come up from the nostrils? Doctor, what's wrong with you? Is that Prasada? Can anyone take my hand? It's a contamination. Is it not? Our ears. What's coming from there? The same contamination. What is the mouth?”

If we do not brush the mouth for a single day, how does it look? There is nothing wonderful in this body. — “All nonsense, all contamination,”

🎙 Maharaj at 30:01 (auto-transcript): “What is the mouth? If we don't brush this mouth for a day, how will it look like? How will it look like? All nonsense, all contamination, nothing wonderful about all this body. Nothing wonderful, useless. useless. So no intelligent persons who give our attention to this body…”

No intelligent person gives the body more attention than necessary, yet modern civilisation is focused only on it. Maharaj calls this foolishness and says the verse confirms it.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:32 (auto-transcript): “useless. So no intelligent persons who give our attention to this body more than necessary. Our matriarch civilization is focused only on the body. This is foolishness, and this verse is confirming that this is useless. The Prophet said true intelligence is shown by one's…”

Citing Srila Prabhupada, Maharaj says real intelligence shows in freedom from taking the body as the self, because the body will soon be finished.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:14 (auto-transcript): “The Prophet said true intelligence is shown by one's freedom from the false identification The identification of the self, with this body. The identification of this body, the solution, the body will finish very soon. The Christian told us about the guitar. That quiz is…”

Krishna teaches in the Gita that what is temporary cannot last and the self cannot be killed, so the intelligent do not lament over what does not deserve it.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:47 (auto-transcript): “The Christian told us about the guitar. That quiz is temporary, cannot last. That quiz is a tenor cannot be killed. For one who is intelligent, should not lament on necessary for something that does not want lamentation. Lamentations should be what Pingala is teaching us, we…”

What we should lament is what Pingala lamented: that we are wasting life for nothing. Maharaj's remedy is to hear scripture as explained by the acaryas — only then do we really have life.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:21 (auto-transcript): “Lamentations should be what Pingala is teaching us, we are wasting our life for nothing, therefore, let us listen to our scriptures, being explained by Acharya, Acharya. It's only then, we'll have life. Hare Krishna. Hare Krishna. Comment.”

Scripture must be heard through the acarya's explanation; that hearing is what gives life to the soul.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:48 (auto-transcript): “Acharya. It's only then, we'll have life. Hare Krishna. Hare Krishna. Comment. Comment? Question? The sad point is, I think the soul is pure.”

Maharaj invites comments and questions; one devotee offers a reflection.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:01 (auto-transcript): “Comment. Comment? Question? The sad point is, I think the soul is pure. The jiva is pure. And it is just a thinking around the body.”

children.topic: Q1 · Is the soul already pure?
children.note:
A devotee comments that the jiva is pure and the problem is only a way of thinking centred on the body; if one changes it to 'I am not the body, I am Krishna's servant', everything changes.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:18 (auto-transcript): “The sad point is, I think the soul is pure. The jiva is pure. And it is just a thinking around the body. And if you just change that thinking, I'm not the body, I'm the servant of Krishna, everything changes. Yes. Perfect.”

Maharaj accepts the comment as perfect and closes the class.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:00 (auto-transcript): “Yes. Perfect. Hare Krishna Selava Upadiki Selava Upadiki”

maps.title: SB Canto 11 · Class 10 · Material Body — Suffering for the Soul

nodeData.topic: Class 10 · Material Body — Suffering for the Soul
nodeData.note: SB 11.8.32 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Pingala admits she has only tortured her own soul by selling herself to men who were themselves pitiable. Maharaj explains that every material body is a prison uniform, that our 'independence' is illusion, and that a long life without Krishna is only long suffering; he separates doing wrong under pressure of circumstances from Pingala's own taste for it, and concludes that every attempt to enjoy the body tortures the soul. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Pingala laments that she has uselessly tormented herself, selling her body to lusty, greedy men who were themselves to be pitied. The verse is chanted at length and read in French and English.

children.topic: The body is a prison dress
children.note:
Maharaj takes up her words 'tortured my own soul': being encased in a body is itself a punishment. — “Our body is a prison suit.”

🎙 Maharaj at 22:21 (auto-transcript): “continued to share they said I have uselessly tortured my own soul a living entity being encased in this body is a punishment. Our body is a prison suit. Aida is Brahma's body, Demi God's body,”

Brahma's body, a demigod's, an animal's or a human's — they are only different prison uniforms. Staying in the material world is torture for the soul.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:19 (auto-transcript): “animal body we human body they are different prison dress we are all prisoners and my body is a dress in the prison house of material so to stay in Staying in this material body is torture for the soul, but stay in this material world is torture. The soul is not free.”

As in a prison house, no one here is free. — “Even what we call independence is all illusion.”

🎙 Maharaj at 24:05 (auto-transcript): “Just like in the prison house, no one is free. You are not free. Even what we call independence is all illusion. Independent of what? Independent of hunger in this body? Anyone can say today I'm not going to eat. I'm independent of my stomach today or not.”

Independent of what? Can anyone say, today I am independent of my stomach and will not eat?

🎙 Maharaj at 24:26 (auto-transcript): “Independent of hunger in this body? Anyone can say today I'm not going to eat. I'm independent of my stomach today or not. Even when the Lord makes an arrangement for us, I know of one temple. A normal day is five preparations.”

Maharaj knows a temple where a normal day has five preparations and Ekadasi has fifty-one — which defeats the purpose of the fast.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:52 (auto-transcript): “Even when the Lord makes an arrangement for us, I know of one temple. A normal day is five preparations. Eccadassi day is 51. That's a violation of the Eccadassi principle. means what 51 means don't fast forget forget about the kathasi so what is independence independence of…”

No one can declare, I will not sleep today, or I will not eat today. Our so-called freedom is bound on every side.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:36 (auto-transcript): “independence independence of what no one will say I'm not going to sleep today anyone can say that i'm not going to eat today independent of what solution so the living entities have been suffering in this material with all the activities we've considered enjoyment this The…”

The living entity has suffered in every activity it called enjoyment. The one thing required is devotional service to Krishna. — “anything else is a torture for the soul”

🎙 Maharaj at 26:13 (auto-transcript): “with all the activities we've considered enjoyment this The thing that is required, devotional is saving to Krishna, that's the only thing devotional is saving to Krishna, anything else is a torture for the soul, long life, What is this word?”

Without Krishna consciousness a long life only means a long suffering — Maharaj asks the audience for the word, and settles on 'long suffering'.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:52 (auto-transcript): “What is this word? Long suffering, thank you. A tree is a son who won't play for thousands of years. How happy is the tree? A tree is free from the blasting wind, It's a raging heat, the tree is free, it has long life. What is the duration of life without the Christian…”

A tree may live for thousands of years — but how happy is it, standing through wind and heat? Duration of life without Krishna consciousness is only torture.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:06 (auto-transcript): “A tree is a son who won't play for thousands of years. How happy is the tree? A tree is free from the blasting wind, It's a raging heat, the tree is free, it has long life. What is the duration of life without the Christian consciousness? It is only torture. The soul is being…”

What is so special in material life? Without the Lord's mercy and devotional service nothing has any value.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:04 (auto-transcript): “What is our material life? What is it? What is so special in our material life? life if i don't have your mercy what else what time devotional service nothing is of any value so if you have christian consciousness everything is wonderful If we have no Christian consciousness,…”

With Krishna consciousness everything becomes wonderful; without it we are only disturbing ourselves. — “We are simply disturbing ourselves unnecessarily.”

🎙 Maharaj at 28:45 (auto-transcript): “so if you have christian consciousness everything is wonderful If we have no Christian consciousness, nothing is up to anybody. We are simply disturbing ourselves unnecessarily. So Pingala is expressing her realisation. There are two things here. She said, does practicing the…”

Maharaj sees two things in her words. First, someone may take up a wrong profession under pressure of circumstances.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:07 (auto-transcript): “So Pingala is expressing her realisation. There are two things here. She said, does practicing the most abominable profession of a prostitute? That is the one thing. Someone can do it after some circumstances.”

He tells of a woman whose second marriage failed, with no education and two children to feed, who took to stealing to maintain them.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:01 (auto-transcript): “Like one lady. She got her second husband, he didn't work out, she has no education, so what to do? She has to take care of the trust as a result of independence, she got the two children,”

Arrested and sentenced, she asked to see the judge: if you jail me, who will feed the children? It was not deliberate; circumstances pushed me. The judge released her.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:30 (auto-transcript): “So she requested to see the judge She narrated her story. You are sending me to jail. I was stealing to take care of the children. Now when you send me to jail, what would happen to those children? It was not a deliberate stealing. The circumstances have pushed me to do this.…”

Pingala admits the second side: she worked for money, but she was also enjoying it — she had developed a taste for it.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:35 (auto-transcript): “That is one side. Pingala said, I took this profession. One, to make money. The second is that I am enjoying this profession. You know because of circumstances, I have the taste to enjoy with miserable men, the frustrated men who are themselves full of miseries, full of…”

The men were frustrated and full of anxiety, using her to cover it; she too was frustrated and used them to enjoy. In the process she was only torturing herself — and this is what we all do in material life.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:06 (auto-transcript): “frustrated men who are themselves full of miseries, full of anxieties, they are frustrated, want to cover their frustrations by using me. I am also a frustrated person. I want to enjoy. So I want to use them to enjoy myself. In this process, I am simply torture myself. This…”

children.topic: Enjoying the body tortures the soul
children.note:
The realisation to take from Pingala: trying to gratify this body in any capacity or by any means is nothing but torture for the soul.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:44 (auto-transcript): “You should get this realization from Pingala. That trying to enjoy this material body in any capacity, in any means, trying to gratify this body. it is nothing but a torture for the soul so we'll see in this material sometimes most of the times you will see the people who…”

Those with much in this world are often unhappy. Happiness does not come from material sense gratification but from the freedom of the soul.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:21 (auto-transcript): “sometimes most of the times you will see the people who have so much So the happiness is not from a material sense of education, it is from the freedom of the soul Which will come through devotional service to Christians. So, let us take Christian consciousness.”

That freedom comes through devotional service to Krishna, so let us take up Krishna consciousness.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:52 (auto-transcript): “Which will come through devotional service to Christians. So, let us take Christian consciousness. Hare Krishna. So, we want to make a message. Hare Krishna.”

nodeData.topic: Class 09 · Prayers of Pingala
nodeData.note: SB 11.8.31 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Pingala laments that she ignored Krishna, the dearest one within her heart, to serve men who could only give her fear and sorrow. Maharaj explains where her sudden fortune came from — a sadhu resting one night near her house — and contrasts Krishna, the only friend who follows us everywhere, with worldly relationships built on give-and-take. In the questions he teaches how to tell Krishna's voice from the mind's and how to meet difficulties by asking what Krishna wants us to learn. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Pingala's lament: she gave up serving the Lord in her own heart, the true giver of love and prosperity, for men who could never satisfy her. Read in Sanskrit, French and English.

children.topic: How did she become so fortunate?
children.note:
That morning a teacher asked Maharaj: how could someone absorbed in a sinful life suddenly receive such a deep realisation?

🎙 Maharaj at 21:59 (auto-transcript): “This morning, the teacher asked me. We are treating text 30. This is text 31. So he was surprised. so he asked me in my marriage how did he become so fortunate to get the realization it's a great fortune how did the person who have not dictated to sinful life suddenly become”

Srila Visvanatha Cakravarti Thakura explains that the avadhuta Dattatreya, on his travels, spent one night in her compound, unknown to her. That brief nearness of a sadhu transformed her consciousness. — “they rested near her house just one night”

🎙 Maharaj at 23:00 (auto-transcript): “Shilabishwa Na Chakravati Sakura said that her fortune came from that Dada Treyya, Dada Treyya passed night in her compound, not in the house, not even known to her this is fortune that she's so fortunate the sadhu on his journey”

No one and nothing is as close to anyone as Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:30 (auto-transcript): “Lord Krishna is the most closest person to anyone. No one is as close to anyone or anything than Krishna.”

She uses the word rati, pure love. Her lament is that the love meant for the one closest to her was never offered to him; she neglected him.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:15 (auto-transcript): “He used the word rati, pure love, the pure love we have for Krishna, now it is not offered to krishna this is her lamentation i did not love the person who is the most closest person to me”

Instead she served 'akamadam' — people who can never satisfy us with anything.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:02 (auto-transcript): “And I was looking for, she used the word Akamadam. Akamadam means people who cannot satisfy us with anything. So he serves his love in his version of Karmadam, which means a person who is not satisfied with us. Krishna is the only true friend of all living entities. Every…”

Krishna is the only real friend and well-wisher of all living beings; every material relationship will fail.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:27 (auto-transcript): “Krishna is the only true friend of all living entities. Every relationship we have in this material will fail. Even if we try to maintain relationship, death will separate it. Death cannot separate us from Krishna. We have eternal relationship with Krishna.”

Even relationships we try hard to keep are ended by death. Our relationship with Krishna is eternal and death cannot touch it. — “Death cannot separate us from Krishna.”

🎙 Maharaj at 26:38 (auto-transcript): “Every relationship we have in this material will fail. Even if we try to maintain relationship, death will separate it. Death cannot separate us from Krishna. We have eternal relationship with Krishna. He is our only well-wisher. He cares for us.”

children.topic: Who will follow you to jail?
children.note:
Wife, husband, children, brothers, sisters — who follows you to jail? Nobody. Krishna follows us everywhere, even to hellish planets, in conditioned life and in liberation.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:24 (auto-transcript): “In this world, in this material world, we have friends who can follow us to certain places. place who will follow you to jail who anyone your wife madame husband children the enfants brother sisters who will follow you to jail who nobody the only person who can do that is krishna”

What do we call friends in this world? Maharaj says every relationship depends on something; the moment you stop satisfying me, I am finished with you. — “Every relationship is based on cheating.”

🎙 Maharaj at 29:33 (auto-transcript): “when we say friends in this world, what do you say friends Who is a friend? Cheating. Every relationship is based on cheating. No true relationship in the material world.”

We come together to exploit each other; where are the sweet dealings from the heart?

🎙 Maharaj at 30:49 (auto-transcript): “No dealings, no dealing from their heart. Where are the dealings that we have with each other from the heart? Where is it? All cheating. No sweet dealings. We don't appreciate it, we let only if there is something I will get from you, the moment I stop scratching your back,”

The moment I stop scratching your itch — your desire — it is over. And the itch is on the body, not the soul, so our dealings stay external.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:16 (auto-transcript): “We don't appreciate it, we let only if there is something I will get from you, the moment I stop scratching your back, When you have eating, there is eating. Eating means desire. The moment I don't scratch that eating you have, finish.”

Krishna is in the heart and speaking to everyone at every moment; we do not hear. — “The noise of sense gratification is very high in our consciousness.”

🎙 Maharaj at 32:34 (auto-transcript): “although krishna is in our heart and every time krishna is speaking to everyone every time there is no time krishna is not speaking We don't hear. Why? The noise of sense gratification is very high in our consciousness. if there is a horn speaker and a loud speaker and it is…”

When a loudspeaker blasts the area, you cannot hear anything beneath it. Material energy is not louder than Krishna — we are simply too externally attached to listen.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:14 (auto-transcript): “if there is a horn speaker and a loud speaker and it is blasting the whole area will you hear something under it no no you cannot hear anything because that sound covers the other sound It is known that material energy is louder than Krishna. It is not. It is just that we are…”

How sweet are our relationships? The room answers: bitter, full of distress.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:21 (auto-transcript): “How sweet is our relationship? How sweet is it? How sweet is it in our relationship? Not sweet. Bitter. Right? Bitter. Distress. Right?”

Frustration is so great that people prefer animals: a dog will not argue with you, so they keep dogs and drive family away.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:10 (auto-transcript): “So, so distressful that some people choose to settle with animals than human beings. they were saying country everybody have dog everybody it everybody has dogs in their house they can drive away their daughter their their their husband their wife they can drive they keep…”

Did we ever see the Gosvamis fighting? Even facing challenges there was no argument, only enjoyment, because of their spiritual perfection.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:16 (auto-transcript): “people are going for animal instead of human beings but did we see the go swamis fighting they argue never even when even when they have a challenge there is there is no argument between no argument only enjoyment they have because of their spiritual perfection so Pingala…”

Pingala recommends turning our attention to Krishna, our real friend, rather than to people who bring anxiety, fear, lamentation and illusion.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:43 (auto-transcript): “never satisfy us but give only anxiety, fear, lamentation, and illusion this body cannot be enjoyed enjoyment is on the soul platform not the body it is illusion for anyone to think that”

The body cannot be enjoyed; enjoyment is on the platform of the soul. Thinking otherwise is illusion.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:09 (auto-transcript): “be enjoyed enjoyment is on the soul platform not the body it is illusion for anyone to think that we can enjoy this material body so everyone in this material world thinks my happiness my enjoyment is in your body come and give it to me”

Each says, my happiness is in your body, give it to me — and the other says the same. Each expects what the other does not have, so the end is fighting. — “So you are empty, I'm empty.”

🎙 Maharaj at 39:20 (auto-transcript): “So you are empty, I'm empty. And empty people come together. What will we do? I'm expecting you, I'm expecting What am I expecting you, you don't have it? What do you expect that I don't have it? Is it not illusion? It's illusion We come together on this basis of illusion The…”

So let us come together to celebrate Krishna consciousness, not sense gratification, from which nothing comes.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:58 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, let us come together to celebrate Krishna consciousness and not sing the gratification and nothing will come out of it. Hello Krishna! Comment? Questions?”

Comments and questions from the devotees.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:20 (auto-transcript): “Comment? Questions? Karma! It is karma. caramela you can get it now oh million lifetimes”

children.topic: Q1 · Why is it so difficult?
children.note:
The question is not audible. Maharaj's answer: it is karma — our sinful activities, from now or millions of lifetimes, make things difficult.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:51 (auto-transcript): “Karma! It is karma. caramela you can get it now oh million lifetimes this is calm our sinful activities are making things so difficult for us All right. Anything else? Yes sir.”

children.topic: Q2 · Does a sadhu's presence change us?
children.note:
A devotee recalls a Mahabharata episode in which a place's influence changed someone's consciousness, and asks how the presence of devotees affects people.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:29 (auto-transcript): “Yes sir. The king? Him, him. Then his brother told him that we were standing, just sitting there, we just caught the event from this side. So when he came from the other side of the river, then his consciousness changed his life. So then we came to know that that place, there…”

In an epidemic the weak catch the disease first. Likewise those whose karma is light are affected by the presence of a sadhu; those whose karma is heavy do not appreciate it.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:44 (auto-transcript): “When there is a pandemic disease, those who have weak immune system, they will be the first people to contact this disease so my system is very strong they will be affected similarly those of us whose karma is light will be affected by the presence of a sadhu”

The maha-prasada prayer says those with meagre piety have no attraction for prasadam, Krishna or his name — because their karma is heavy.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:36 (auto-transcript): “Why is it? Salpa Punyam, what term? Raja, means what? Alpa Punya. Those whose fortune is very meager, Alpa Punya, they have no attraction for Prasad, for Krishna, Krishna's name. no attraction because our our karma is too heavy no attraction for those who karma purnia is very…”

For an hour many sat without hearing — even the hosts who invited him were busy preparing prasadam. Why call someone to speak if you are not there? How long will we go on like this?

🎙 Maharaj at 46:32 (auto-transcript): “we are discussing right for one hour we are discussing do you know that so many people are sitting and not hearing anything including those who asked us to come here they don't hear anything because they're not sitting here they're busy raising precedent for you”

children.topic: Q3 · Krishna's voice or the mind's?
children.note:
With the noise of sense gratification so loud, how do we tell whether Krishna is speaking or the mind is dictating?

🎙 Maharaj at 50:13 (auto-transcript): “now how to make the difference is krishna speaking or the mind is dictating how to make the difference Whenever we want to do something, any time you want to do something, not sometimes, always the two voices will come.”

Whenever we want to do something, two voices come. Krishna's is the one that says don't, it won't benefit you; the mind says, just today. Good advice is usually the difficult one.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:03 (auto-transcript): “which one is christian christian voice is the one that tells you don't do this that is christian the mind said do it only today just today we have been doing it since are you sure that what you want to do now will benefit you even if you want to just do it for today don't do…”

Hear more about Krishna and the noise of sense gratification goes down by itself; those who take it seriously hear his voice louder.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:02 (auto-transcript): “process it should turn down the volume or single education you should hear more about Krishna if you hear more about Krishna the sanctification noise will go down automatically because now we start to remember about Krishna instead of remembering the mature sanctification so…”

Anything that happens is allowed by Krishna, who watches how we deal with it. An intelligent devotee blames no one, accuses no one and does not complicate the issue.

🎙 Maharaj at 54:32 (auto-transcript): “The time we have anxiety, that is the time Christian wants to show us where we are in our christian consciousness but we always forget that christian allows it to happen and he's watching how we are going to deal with it anything that happened to anybody”

Ask Krishna why this happened and what we need to learn, then wait; he will show it. If we hear little about Krishna we consult the mind instead, and it beats us. — “what do you want me to learn in this situation”

🎙 Maharaj at 55:50 (auto-transcript): “we simply consult Krishna what do you want me to learn in this situation if you ask If I ask Krishna this question, and wait for Krishna, he will give us the answer. Why did this happen? And what will need to learn from it? Krishna will show it to us. We are not asking…”

Go to a sadhu and follow what he says. He speaks for our benefit and will not cheat us, because he cares for us. — “they are speaking for our benefit they will not cheat us”

🎙 Maharaj at 57:20 (auto-transcript): “krishna so we should go to sadhu and ask him what to do and whatever he tells you to follow it will be successful. Yesterday we were discussing the realization from Narada Muni and Udra. Who takes the advice of a sadhu will always be successful? they are speaking for our…”
