maps.title: SB Canto 11 · Class 08 · Real Fortune is in Misfortune

nodeData.topic: Class 08 · Real Fortune is in Misfortune
nodeData.note: SB 11.8.30 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Pingala's realisation came on the night nobody came to her — her misfortune was her real fortune. Maharaj uses her story to expose the selfish 'what's in it for me' outlook, to insist on basic human qualities before philosophy, and to redefine fortune as becoming a devotee, ending with the offence of not rejoicing to see devotees and his guru's lesson to turn every negative into a positive. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The story of Pingala begins: the verse in which she sees how foolish she has been, unable to control her mind and seeking pleasure from insignificant men.

After a 'Sri Pingala ki jaya', Maharaj states the theme and makes the room agree to it: what we call misfortune is a blessing. — “It is a fact that our so-called misfortune is a blessing.”

🎙 Maharaj at 16:51 (auto-transcript): “Sri Pingalaki, it is true, it is true that our so-called misfortune is actually a blessing. It is true. It is a fact that our so-called misfortune is a blessing. You agree? True? It is true. It's a fact.”

Her profession is to stand in public places by hotels, eyeing every man — this one has money, this one, this one — every single day.

🎙 Maharaj at 17:59 (auto-transcript): “Pingala, the prostitute, that is her qualification. That is her profession. She stands by public places, like hotels, where so many people will come in and she'll be looking. Any person, oh, this one is a good one. Oh, this one is a good one. Oh, yeah, this one. This one has…”

When one is that busy choosing 'this one, this one', how much is Krishna seen? Zero. That is material existence. — “When will we see Krishna? Zero. Zero.”

🎙 Maharaj at 18:47 (auto-transcript): “So when one is very busy, this one, this one, this one, this one. When will we see Krishna? Zero. Zero. She has been living her life like that, every day. This is material existence. Material existence, material world is so terrible, such a terrible place, that whenever we…”

Material life is so terrible that we look at everyone and everything only for what it gives us; if I see nothing in you for me, you do not exist for me.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:13 (auto-transcript): “This is material existence. Material existence, material world is so terrible, such a terrible place, that whenever we look at something or somebody, we don't think about that person's welfare. We think about, it's for me. if I don't see anything in you for me you don't…”

We shop and choose this way, and never ask how we can help someone. Self-interest is the motive behind everything a conditioned soul does.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:31 (auto-transcript): “will see this is for me we never see that this ah how can I help this person that doesn't exist for a conditional soul don't exist so our motivation for everything is selfishness selfishness if there is no self-interest for anything we are not there. And that thing doesn't…”

Even devotees pass each other without a word unless they need something. In the village where Maharaj was born it is an offence to walk past someone without greeting him.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:12 (auto-transcript): “we see what I'm going to get from it. Even Hare Krishna devotees. I don't greet you if I don't have to ask for something. I don't greet you. I see I just won't pass. Hare Krishna devotees. See the devotees just passed as if it is I can't anymore. The village I came from is an…”

Without a foundation of human qualities, Krishna consciousness becomes a big challenge. Greeting someone and caring how they are needs no Gita, Bible or Quran — it is simply human.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:24 (auto-transcript): “be a problem it would be a big challenge if we don't have the good foundation for krishna consciousness first we should have human quality before we can practice krishna consciousness whatever man call it you cannot be a devotee you cannot it is human to see someone and be…”

Without human qualities we can speak big philosophy and still be mechanical. Devotional service must be loaded with affection.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:15 (auto-transcript): “things without human quality to begin Krishna consciousness. We are simply hovering. We are just mechanical. A devotional service is not mechanical. We say devotional service. It has affection our two it is to be loaded with affection that becomes devotional service not…”

Could Maharaj speak here if nobody were sitting? No — his importance exists because of the audience. Seeing that is simple, but rare. — “for me to speak means what I need all of you”

🎙 Maharaj at 24:05 (auto-transcript): “human qualities let me prove what I'm saying can I sit here speak if all of you are not sitting here can I speak here even all of you are not sitting here can I speak here no so for me to speak means what I need all of you so you're not important in my life hey you're not…”

Without becoming human we are only pretending and hiding. This is a movement that must move forward; we have to learn how to exist.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:46 (auto-transcript): “become human otherwise we are just simply pretending and hiding here this is not the place for hiding this is a movement that we have to move forward it's a movement it's not a place for hideouts this is a place to exist we must learn how to exist. You must learn how to…”

It is hard to understand that misfortune is a blessing because we do not know what fortune means.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:20 (auto-transcript): “so-called misfortune is a blessing. It's a blessing. It is difficult to understand because we don't know what is fortune. We don't know the meaning of fortune. If someone is considered fortunate means what has money right well educated from aristocratic family is so it's so…”

Money, education, aristocratic birth and fame are called fortune, but with all of them one is miserable, sleepless and troubled by people.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:39 (auto-transcript): “fortunate means what has money right well educated from aristocratic family is so it's so popular so famous see if you have all these qualities in this material world you'll be a miserable person in this material world you have all these qualities you just mentioned you'll be…”

Real fortune is to become a devotee of Krishna — nothing more than that.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:26 (auto-transcript): “fortune is one has become a devotee of krishna that is fortune a devotee of krishna that is fortunate nothing more than that so pingala is a prostitute who hangs around public places to look for which rich man is going to sleep with me today which risk money every day that is…”

We call misfortune fortune: we have traded the permanent for the temporary, take suffering as enjoyment, and shelter in maya instead of the holy name.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:24 (auto-transcript): “Miss fortune is what we consider fortune. We have saved temporal things for permanent things. We have saved suffering as an enjoyment. Instead of us to take shelter of Nithinam, we are taking shelter of Maya. Misfortune. So it was not a fortune that the Pingala was getting…”

Her fortunate day was not one of earning and enjoying, but the day she entered the Bhagavatam — the night nobody came to her.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:53 (auto-transcript): “So it was not a fortune that the Pingala was getting men to sleep with and making money and gratify their sins. That was not a fortune. Her fortunate day was the day that she entered into Bhagavatam. She entered into Bhagavatam, that was her fortunate day. The day she entered…”

She waited the whole night; every man passed by and went to other women.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:34 (auto-transcript): “She was waiting, this man, this man, but nobody looked at her that day. She stood the whole night, nobody, all the men, she was, oh, this one's going to come. They don't come, they'll pass. The whole night she was waiting, ah, nobody. Nobody's coming today. What is, what is…”

Maharaj acts out her frustration: all the make-up, jewels, coloured hair and false smiles — and zero. She went to bed alone and said, no more.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:12 (auto-transcript): “All the cosmetics I put today, All these jewels, all these paintings, I have them. I fried the hair in ten colors. With all the artificial smiles I put on myself, nobody accepted today. There was zero. So that day she went to sleep without anyone. So while she was there in…”

Lying there, she contemplated, and the realisation came. It never came on the busy nights because she was thinking of other things. — “From her misfortune, she got this realization.”

🎙 Maharaj at 29:49 (auto-transcript): “As she was contemplating, the realization came. This is her realization. From her misfortune, she got this realization. this realization did not come the days was having men to steward she didn't get it why there were no contemplation she was contemplating on some other…”

Her realisation: I am a fool, looking to temporary men who must all die. Maharaj asks the room whether there is any man here who will not die.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:27 (auto-transcript): “i'm a fool what is my foolishness i was looking at this temporal these men who should die Do you see any man here, he's not going to die? Do you see any man here, he's not going to die? The community of David said, I will not marry any person with beard. I will never have any…”

He tells of a determined girl who vowed to marry no one with a beard — only Vishnu — and would continue austerities for lifetimes until she got him. That is a devotee's determination.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:48 (auto-transcript): “The community of David said, I will not marry any person with beard. I will never have any man with beard as a husband. I will never. I want to marry someone who has no beard. He's very smooth like a bottle. Very smooth and glossy. That is the only person I will have as a…”

children.topic: Sense control is the human purpose
children.note:
The human form is given to control the senses, not to gratify them. Failure is not only failure but punishable, and degrades us from the human platform. — “Sense control is very important for every soul.”

🎙 Maharaj at 32:28 (auto-transcript): “Sense control is very important for every soul. Any person who calls himself as a human being, human form of life has given to us to control the senses, not to gratify it. It's for controlling the senses. Failure to practice controlling the senses is a failure. And it is…”

He asks people their height and gets 1.6, 1.7… 'All of you are liars.' We measure the body and forget ourselves; scripture has already given our real, tiny size as the soul.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:02 (auto-transcript): “What is your height? 1.7. 1.4. 1.7. 1.6. 5.2. 1.62. 1.71. All of you are liars. You told me life what is the height what is the size is significant my crosswalk I didn't”

Knowing how insignificant we are, we look for the truly significant person, Krishna. Pingala regrets forgetting the one closest to her, the Supersoul, at no distance at all.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:20 (auto-transcript): “a significant person krishna yes you look for krishna see what happened to pingala instead of looking for krishna she regretted seriously this is a realization she regretted see i wasted the closest person to me i forgot him who's the closest person to us the super soul…”

children.topic: Not happy to see a devotee
children.note:
When relationships are strained we cannot even greet or smile. Maharaj warns that not feeling happy on seeing a devotee is a heavy offence — out of billions, this tiny soul is trying to chant.

🎙 Maharaj at 37:08 (auto-transcript): “this strain in the relationship then it is difficult when it is normal or positive relationship we can greet each other or there is strain then it becomes difficult to even smile what about greeting that's illusion that is illusion that i don't have good relationship”

We discuss how useless others are and so have no quality of appreciation, because we see only the bad. Let us all learn to see the good.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:16 (auto-transcript): “that's why we don't have a quality of appreciation don't appreciate because you don't see the good we only see the bad you should learn to see the good Let's all learn to see the good. My special master is training, training all of us that make every negative thing positive.…”

His spiritual master trains everyone to make every negative positive — a simple sentence, a lifetime's assignment — then to make every positive more positive. No stagnation.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:31 (auto-transcript): “Let's all learn to see the good. My special master is training, training all of us that make every negative thing positive. It's a heavy assignment. It's a simple statement. It's a heavy assignment, right? It takes years to do that. Not just one second sentence. one second…”

His guru, always smiling, was deported from Mauritius twice; on the third visit he told the devotees straight away that he had forgiven them all. Pure devotees put their lives before us so we can learn. — “I have forgiven all of you.”

🎙 Maharaj at 40:38 (auto-transcript): “that. That is how he lived his life. He's always smiling. When he came to Mauritius, he was deported. Second time he was deported. When he came the third time and he saw all the devotees, I have forgiven all of you. I have forgiven all of you. Straight away. Yes. That did. So…”

Three questions from the devotees.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:57 (auto-transcript): “Dr. Lamuni explains on the movement of living entities, living entity prays, so Jantur Vacha. So, I was thinking, have we, Jantur means, is it saying that we also have prays like that? In the womb, when the living entity is praying, different prayers are giving. So, is that…”

children.topic: Q1 · Did we all pray in the womb?
children.note:
The Bhagavatam gives the prayers of the living entity in the womb — have all of us prayed like that? Maharaj: everyone here has been in a womb.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:57 (auto-transcript): “Dr. Lamuni explains on the movement of living entities, living entity prays, so Jantur Vacha. So, I was thinking, have we, Jantur means, is it saying that we also have prays like that? In the womb, when the living entity is praying, different prayers are giving. So, is that…”

A baby cries and the mother offers milk, but that is not why; it is partly remembering the frightening experience, which is forgotten as the body grows and accepts the world's norms.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:10 (auto-transcript): “When the baby is crying, nobody knows what is crying. The mother will press the breast into his mouth. That is not what he's crying for. What is crying? Remembering? Yes. Part of the experience is remembering that. It's frightening. He cries. When the body becomes condensed…”

To sit here today we must have cried seriously to Krishna before he gave us the chance.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:50 (auto-transcript): “For us to come and sit here today, we have cried to Krishna, seriously. We have cried before he gave the chance for us to come to meet him. I was praying to Krishna this morning. It was something I was saying. I don't know how you brought me here. I don't know. I don't know…”

He shares his own prayer: I don't know how you brought me here; after all the nonsense I have done you keep me, so you have a plan — please make it happen. Only your shelter is meaningful.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:02 (auto-transcript): “I was praying to Krishna this morning. It was something I was saying. I don't know how you brought me here. I don't know. I don't know how you brought me here. Considering all the nonsense things you have done, you are saying keeping me, it means you have a plan. Please make…”

Does misfortune become a blessing, or is the blessing itself our misfortune?

🎙 Maharaj at 44:46 (auto-transcript): “Misfortune becomes another thing or we need to misfortune with a blessing? Our misfortune is that the blessing which is given, we are not exercising it. That's why he used the word misfortune, in Chitam Mahaprabhu, he used the word misfortune because what is given to them, we…”

In one sense our misfortune is that the blessing given to us is not being used. For Pingala, the material misfortune of an empty night brought her to Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:57 (auto-transcript): “Our misfortune is that the blessing which is given, we are not exercising it. That's why he used the word misfortune, in Chitam Mahaprabhu, he used the word misfortune because what is given to them, we are not using it, the misfortune in that sense. The misfortune was a…”

children.topic: A rich child on the street
children.note:
We came to Krishna consciousness somehow, unplanned — that is fortune. Not using it is like a child of a wealthy family living on the street. Take full advantage.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:15 (auto-transcript): “because of fortune there is a fortune that we all have to come to christian consciousness somehow or that somehow or that we came here do you know how you came to christian you become attracted somewhere somebody just met and talk we just started account right Was it planned?…”

children.topic: Q3 · Are devotees also sense victims?
children.note:
Devotees too sometimes run after status and wealth — are we sometimes in illusion? Maharaj: not sometimes — always.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:36 (auto-transcript): “These are also victims of their senses. They are all devotees, but in their life, they are sometimes going to gratify their senses in a way that status, wealth, etc., etc.”

His own remedy is to pray every moment for mercy: whatever happens, Krishna, do not let me lose this chance. — “Krishna please, whatever is my situation, don't let me lose this chance”

🎙 Maharaj at 48:53 (auto-transcript): “I'm constantly praying for mercy, I'm praying for help, I'm praying constantly, I'm praying every day, every moment, I'm praying, Krishna please, whatever is my situation, don't let me lose this chance, whatever happens, don't let me lose this chance, let me remain, whatever…”

maps.title: SB Canto 11 · Class 07 · Firmly Fixed at Krishna's Feet

nodeData.topic: Class 07 · Firmly Fixed at Krishna's Feet
nodeData.note: SB 11.23.57 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. The Avanti brahmana's resolve — to cross the ocean of ignorance by being firmly fixed in service to Mukunda, as the previous acaryas were — becomes Maharaj's call to follow proven realisation rather than experiment, with no spare time, no reservation and no fear of the future. Through Srila Prabhupada's purport on tridandi sannyasa he shows that real renunciation is full dependence on Krishna, not a dress, and closes with memories of his own spiritual master's conviction. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The Avanti brahmana resolves to cross the ocean of ignorance by fixing himself in service to Krishna's lotus feet, the path approved by the acaryas before him. The audience repeats the translation line by line.

Maharaj separates the two parts: being firmly fixed in service is the process; crossing the ocean is the result.

🎙 Maharaj at 13:59 (auto-transcript): “does it make sense there's a process here what is a process by being fixed firmly fixed in the service of the lotus feet of christian the result is that one can cross the”

children.topic: Why this path — and who succeeded?
children.note:
Though we have come to Krishna consciousness, Maharaj asks us to question ourselves honestly.

🎙 Maharaj at 15:21 (auto-transcript): “Although we have come to Christian consciousness, but we should ask ourselves questions. There are so many religious organizations in this world, many. Why have I chosen Krishna consciousness? Why this one? There are many other ones. I can choose anyone, but why have I chosen…”

children.topic: Why have I chosen this one?
children.note:
There are many religious organisations in the world. Why Krishna consciousness and not another? We should have our own answer.

🎙 Maharaj at 15:28 (auto-transcript): “There are so many religious organizations in this world, many. Why have I chosen Krishna consciousness? Why this one? There are many other ones. I can choose anyone, but why have I chosen this one? This Christian consciousness. Second question. That is, if you have reason, if…”

Next: can we see someone in this movement who followed the process and reached success? If yes, how did he get there and what did he do?

🎙 Maharaj at 16:06 (auto-transcript): “Next question will be, do I have, do we have anyone in this movement who have attained success? Is there anyone we can see that followed this process and have become successful? This is a good question. Can we see someone in this movement that can say that yes, this person is…”

As in worldly fields, following someone already successful saves us their mistakes. The acaryas give their realisation and the difficulties they passed through, not experiments. — “They don't share experiment.”

🎙 Maharaj at 17:03 (auto-transcript): “So in our system, we always emphasize following the Achariyas. You should follow Achariyas. Even in the material world, if one wanted to be successful, if you follow the person who is successful in that field, what is the benefit of that? We will not make the mistake they…”

Where do we find what the acaryas went through? In the scripture — it is their realisation.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:11 (auto-transcript): “This is not the question the Seji Ashuta Goswami, one of the questions, is it not? What do you are certain to be the ultimate guru for everyone? They don't ask him, teach us what you have learned from all your gurus. They didn't say that. They didn't ask him that. They told…”

The sages did not ask Suta Gosvami to teach everything he had learned; they said life is short, give us the essence. The Bhagavatam is that essence of his experience.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:29 (auto-transcript): “They told him, see, you are very, very fortunate. You are so submissive, you are so gentle, you are so humble. With all these qualities, you got so many blessings from your guru. So you are successful. Your guru, so you are successful. We don't have that qualification because…”

Maharaj has heard from Prabhupada's disciples that his purports are his realisation, checked in detail so that they would truly benefit the world.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:02 (auto-transcript): “Bagwata. This scripture is their realization. They put everything here. Everything is loaded here. I have heard many times from the proper disciples that proper said his purpose is what? His ecstasy. That is his realization. And he went through everything in detail before you…”

After study comes execution according to their recommendation. The experiments are already done; our duty is to follow with faith, not to repeat the trials and errors.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:41 (auto-transcript): “people can benefit from it so we'll get that when we get all this together like we study the scripture after study what next this is a question we have to execute it according to their recommendation sugar they push on may use the word niche the town second time it is already…”

Once convinced, the next step is to absorb ourselves fully. The acaryas never asked what would happen to them if it did not work.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:54 (auto-transcript): “So when one knows this, I'm not convinced about what I'm going to do, and I've seen everything which is necessary to be done, the next thing is that we should have absorbed ourselves fully into it. There's no question of, what would happened to me after? Suppose I did not. If…”

children.topic: What would I do all day?
children.note:
Maharaj recalls someone who, as a schoolboy meeting devotees, wondered what he would do all day if he joined. In Krishna consciousness the day is full.

🎙 Maharaj at 23:58 (auto-transcript): “easy one day what he told me when he was in school and devotees were coming to push to him so he was thinking yeah this is very good i will join them but if i join this movement what would i do what would i do now you know what you'll do right you know what you will do what…”

Problems come in spare time. Krishna asks for total surrender with no reservation, so the 24 hours should be booked. — “we should never have spare time 24 hours booked”

🎙 Maharaj at 24:25 (auto-transcript): “they're going to walk through the whole day you know spare time if you have spare time that is maya if you have spare time here christian consciousness it is maya that is where our problem will come true in the spare time we should never have spare time 24 hours booked no…”

This verse is chanted for a sannyasi at initiation, yet it is in the Bhagavatam for all of us, householders included.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:35 (auto-transcript): “to the lord parmatma the supreme personality of godhead this is a sanyans look when one takes and it's sanyans this mantra give it to you but why is he giving to us it is in the baguette it does specifically mention all the sciences should read this so if your household if…”

Today a sannyasi travelling from Bangalore to Delhi can phone temples on the route for prasadam. In earlier days there were no such temples or phones; one lived at the mercy of providence.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:39 (auto-transcript): “this time is easier if you are traveling from bangalore to delhi there are so many temples on the way, in between. Right? You can call. Prabhu, we are coming, we reach by the social time, by social train, bring us on Prasad. So you get Prasad in the middle of the way before…”

If something comes, Haribol; if nothing comes, Haribol — one answer for everything. — “If you don't get it, Haribol.”

🎙 Maharaj at 27:24 (auto-transcript): “If you get something, it's Haribol. If you don't get it, Haribol. Thank you. Thank you. Our answer is one, Haribol. Therefore, a saniyasi should be free from fear. This is the first qualification. A devotee should be free from the fear of the future, if we want to be…”

children.topic: Free from fear of the future
children.note:
The first qualification is freedom from fear. If we fear for the future we hold back; that reservation is the stumbling block on the path of bhakti.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:42 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, a saniyasi should be free from fear. This is the first qualification. A devotee should be free from the fear of the future, if we want to be successful. if the fear is there what will happen to me in the future we are not going to give our best that is sure if you…”
Srila Prabhupada's purport, quoted from Caitanya-caritamrta, says accepting sannyasa means devoting life completely to Mukunda. Maharaj stresses: completely, not partly — full dependence.

A sannyasi travels alone, without support, free like the air — nothing in the mind but himself and Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:45 (auto-transcript): “to the service of mukunda krishna it's a full dependence you're traveling you're traveling without a support you're alone in the jungle anywhere you're traveling alone fully yeah yeah just like air that is the the position the air you're traveling free traveling like it means…”

Devotees should move through Krishna consciousness like a bull running free — majestic, unconcerned, the mind free of dualities, not restless over whether to do this or that.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:04 (auto-transcript): “of the dress sannyasis brahmacharis or in general bona fides devotees should exist in our christian consciousness exactly like the bull you see bull running have you seen the bull running they move majestically free they are free in a movement they don't care that's a devotee…”

If Krishna is our protector, is there anyone who can pass through him to reach us? Then why fear, why insecurity, why hold back? — “So why fear?”

🎙 Maharaj at 33:06 (auto-transcript): “What does that mean? Not that somebody is superior to Krishna that is going to pass through Krishna to get to me. Who is that person? Who is that person? The Krishna is here as our protector and someone is going to pass through Krishna to get us. Is there any person like…”

Distraction means what we are doing does not attract the mind, so it searches for something it thinks is better. The cause is that our resolve is not strong.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:57 (auto-transcript): “Distraction means what? What we are doing is not attracting the mind. Therefore, the mind is searching for something else. If the mind is attracted, the mind will be where it's attracted to. So destruction means that the mind is not attracted here. It's attracted to something…”

Bhakti is very pure; mix anything into it and it reacts as fear, anxiety, insecurity, frustration and burnout. Not seeing this, we blame other people — but nobody does anything to us; we do it to ourselves.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:41 (auto-transcript): “Narada Muni told me yesterday, first Kantor. This process is very, very pure, very, very pure. If you make anything, it will react in many forms. is it not happening if you miss anything to bhakti it will react different ways how does it react fear anxiety insecurity…”

It is not simply a change of dress. Maharaj's spiritual master told sannyasis that people should feel their presence devotionally — wherever they go, they should affect people spiritually, not just come for prasadam.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:43 (auto-transcript): “only do ourselves it is not simply a matter of changing dress my special master he told some of his say god brothers and saniasis you are a saniasi wherever you go people who feel your presence devotionally don't go to a place you want to eat prasadam just walk out so saniasi…”

A man calling himself a doctor without qualification is cheating. A sannyasi who cannot stir the hearts of his audience should remove the dress so people know where he stands.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:31 (auto-transcript): “you should be potent if one says he's a doctor but does not have the qualification he cannot perform as a doctor that is cheating cheating only so it's a necessary cannot penetrate the heart of the audience he cannot stimulate their christian consciousness by his presence…”

Being fixed means not restless: fully convinced of Krishna's position, of the power of devotional service, and of our eternal relationship with him. Then we put in our best.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:53 (auto-transcript): “being a fixed devotee of Krishna fixed devotee not restless fully convinced of the position of Krishna fully convinced about the potency the power of devotional service to Krishna fully convinced about our relationship with Krishna which is eternal we are convinced about this…”

From the purport's contrast of Vaishnava and Mayavadi sannyasa, Maharaj asks what impersonalist sannyasis are studying for — years of effort to conclude 'I am God', which anyone could say today.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:14 (auto-transcript): “What do they do with the Asanias? The Maivadies, what are they doing with the Asanias? Studying with them. And what is the conclusion? So, is that necessary to seek Asanias to become God? Is that the qualification? Should I waste my time so much for a long time just to…”

Brahma came first and is our authority. He did not ask Krishna for knowledge, karma, yoga or more universes; he begged to be grass in Vraja, touched by the dust of the gopis' feet. The intelligent follow him.

🎙 Maharaj at 42:24 (auto-transcript): “Sankaracharya and Lord Brahma, who came first? Brahma came first. What did he beg Krishna for? What did Lord Brahma beg Krishna? Coming first means that he is our superior, his authority, his mahaja. Right? That's what he means. He is our mahaja. So he came first and he gave…”

Before taking sannyasa from Kesava Bharati, Mahaprabhu first gave him a mantra. Later he asked, which is higher, jnana or bhakti? Hearing 'bhakti', Mahaprabhu said he had saved his life.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:16 (auto-transcript): “we did so many things which are hidden which are hidden so one one may ask why did he accept sannyas from there were no gurus those bachelor sannyas do this the time we took sannyas there were no question at that time who was the sannyasi okay now my question was there were…”

We remain individuals eternally. To give up sense experience only to become nothing is foolish. In a marriage, or when two countries unite, individuals join in interest without disappearing.

🎙 Maharaj at 49:38 (auto-transcript): “We understand that we are devotees of Krishna. We are devotees. The individuality is there eternally. And even if you look at it very carefully, you can see how foolish this philosophy is. What is that foolishness? Before one becomes a liberated soul, you have senses to…”

Krishna created varnasrama, by qualification; the caste system by birth is its adulterated, dangerous form, which our acaryas worked to replace with daivi varnasrama.

🎙 Maharaj at 55:07 (auto-transcript): “it is by qualification not by birth in another word, Krishna did not create caste system, he created Barana Ashram which is different from caste system caste system is adulterated Barana Ashram demonic Barana Ashram When things become adulterated, it will change the quality.…”

A true sannyasi is broad-minded, not selfish. Maharaj ends with memories of the life of his own spiritual master.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:03 (auto-transcript): “A true sannyasi is not selfish, broad, broad-minded.”

Marrying one wife is narrow; a sannyasi 'marries' the whole world. He gives up personal gratification to be available to everyone — and such sacrifice purifies and makes one very dear to Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:50 (auto-transcript): “Marry one wife is selfish. If you marry the whole world, that is broad-mindedness. If we want to attract the Christian's attention, we should do some sacrifice.”

children.topic: No spare time in his day
children.note:
His guru had no spare time and was conscious of Krishna and Srila Prabhupada 24 hours. Each night he asked Prabhupada whether anything was left undone, and wrote the answer as the first task for the next day.

🎙 Maharaj at 60:49 (auto-transcript): “yes yes we are trying to live the life he lived we are trying the life he lived what is that he is 24 hours conscious of christian his spiritual master he has no spare time in his life the whole day he has everything to occupy the whole day and he will go through all of them…”

He cared for devotees and spoke for child and women protection and self-sufficient communities long before others understood. In meetings he would say 'Prabhupada is not happy with this', and walk out rather than stay silent.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:45 (auto-transcript): “personified. He cared for devotees. A few days ago, he took the microphone. I don't like Baptista Maharaj. I don't like what he did. He was talking about child protection. He was talking for years. We did not understand him. He talked about women protection, women who didn't…”

He took heavy risks preaching in Africa, the former Yugoslavia and the Soviet Union, to show the world his faith in his guru and Krishna. — “the level of my faith in this movement”

🎙 Maharaj at 66:37 (auto-transcript): “We are talking about confidence. He has great confidence. Great determination in his Guru and Krishna. a confidence so he said i took risk in this movement it is true he took risks in africa in the what was yugoslovia the soviet union he took heavy risk yes heavy risk he took…”

He wrote his books in the car and in quiet places, always telling others where he would be. His enthusiasm grew daily, his books are his life, and Maharaj's own attraction to the deities comes from watching him.

🎙 Maharaj at 67:51 (auto-transcript): “we saw how he lived when he's writing beggars and special worries most of them he wrote on the way in the car writing in the car he would go to a quiet place where he would sit alone at that time we had a temple nearly on the airport road so on the way it was not occupied by…”

maps.title: SB Canto 11 · Class 06 · Why We Should Take Krishna Consciousness Seriously

nodeData.topic: Class 06 · Why We Should Take Krishna Consciousness Seriously
nodeData.note: SB 11.20.17 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. The human body is a rare boat for crossing material existence, with the guru as captain and Krishna's mercy as the wind; whoever wastes it harms his own soul. Maharaj presses one word — serious: Srila Prabhupada's advice for not falling down, a day measured honestly against sadhana, and in Kali-yuga every life gets harder, so the chance must be used now. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.topic: 11.20.17 — The human body is a boat
children.note: The verse, read in Sanskrit, Hindi and English, compares the human body to a well-built boat for crossing the ocean of birth and death, with the spiritual master steering and the Lord's instructions as favourable winds.

Maharaj begins from the point that human life is very hard to obtain, so every intelligent person should take it very seriously.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:42 (auto-transcript): “Sukhadev Goswami said Manushya Janma Su Durlava Human form of life is very rare It is obtained after passing through 8,400,000 species It is not easily obtained, very very difficult to obtain human form of life, therefore every”

The human form comes only after passing through millions of species; it is not easily given.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:00 (auto-transcript): “It is obtained after passing through 8,400,000 species It is not easily obtained, very very difficult to obtain human form of life, therefore every intelligent person should take human form of life very seriously.”

Animals have no scripture, no religion and no regulative principles. Rules for spiritual life are given only to human beings — that is what makes this form important. — “The regulative principle is only for human beings.”

🎙 Maharaj at 26:52 (auto-transcript): “of all species of life, for example, the animals, they don't have scripture, animal doesn't have scripture, animal doesn't have religion, there is no regulative principle for animals, The regulative principle is only for human beings. Therefore, the human form of life is very…”

Krishna gave the scriptures for those who have a human form, because only they can use them to go back to Godhead.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:01 (auto-transcript): “So in these ways it is mentioned that Krishna gave this scripture for those who have human form of light. He gave the spiritual master, who is the captain, to lead the human society to Godhead. So this human form of life is given to Rosh to approach the spiritual master.”

Krishna also gave the spiritual master to lead human society; human life is meant for approaching him and learning how to return home.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:23 (auto-transcript): “He gave the spiritual master, who is the captain, to lead the human society to Godhead. So this human form of life is given to Rosh to approach the spiritual master. Who will teach us how to go back and back to Berlin? So it is said here, those who do not follow this, they…”

Those who do not use human life this way are called killers of themselves. Maharaj notes the twist: usually a killer kills someone else, but here scripture says we can kill ourselves by wasting this chance.

🎙 Maharaj at 29:02 (auto-transcript): “So it is said here, those who do not follow this, they are considered to be killers of themselves. Usually a killer kills somebody. somebody but here the scripture is saying that we are not only killers of somebody we are also killers of ourselves if we don't take advantage…”

Not taking advantage of the human form for spiritual life is itself a kind of killing — of the soul's opportunity. — “we are not only killers of somebody”

🎙 Maharaj at 29:23 (auto-transcript): “somebody but here the scripture is saying that we are not only killers of somebody we are also killers of ourselves if we don't take advantage of human form of life to affect our life we are to kill us of the soul. 9 billions of people in this world. 9 billions in this world.”

children.topic: Why so few take it up
children.note:
Among billions of people the devotees are very few, because most are not interested in self-realisation.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:02 (auto-transcript): “9 billions of people in this world. 9 billions in this world. The devotees are very very few. Because many people are not interested in self-realization. Only very few people are interested in self-realization, because the mode of ignorance is very, very prominent.”

Ignorance is very prominent today, and people dominated by it will not take Krishna consciousness seriously or use the gift Krishna has given.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:29 (auto-transcript): “Only very few people are interested in self-realization, because the mode of ignorance is very, very prominent. Therefore, people who are dominated by ignorance will not take this Krishna consciousness seriously. We will not use or take advantage in a missy Krishna has given…”

Other species live for their senses; the human form is not meant for the same use but for Krishna consciousness. — “Human form of life is for Krishna consciousness.”

🎙 Maharaj at 31:10 (auto-transcript): “It is not ordinary to have a human body. It is not for any other purposes. Human form of life is for Krishna consciousness. Other forms of life are used for all kinds of things, for gratifying their senses, but the human form of life is not for same application. One is…”

Not taking to Krishna consciousness is failure; taking to it is success — but taking to it also requires seriousness, or we still will not make it.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:46 (auto-transcript): “One is considered to be a failure if we don't take to Krishna consciousness. is considered to be successful if you take to Krishna consciousness. Taking to Krishna consciousness also requires being serious. If we are not serious in our Krishna consciousness, We also will not…”

A devotee wrote to Srila Prabhupada: many are falling away and leaving the movement — what should I do so I do not fall?

🎙 Maharaj at 32:36 (auto-transcript): “One devotee wrote later to Srila Prabhupada. And he asked Prabhupada, I am seeing that many devotees are falling down and living in movement. What should I do so that I don't fall down, I don't need to go down? What should I do? So my Papa replied, he should change minimum 60…”

Prabhupada replied: chant at least sixteen rounds and seriously try to avoid offences.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:11 (auto-transcript): “So my Papa replied, he should change minimum 60 rounds and seriously try to avoid offences. Keep the fourth abitant festival strictly So study the scriptures scindonizingly Have faith in the spiritual master and Krishna”

Follow the four regulative principles strictly, study the scriptures sincerely, and have faith in the spiritual master and Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:24 (auto-transcript): “Keep the fourth abitant festival strictly So study the scriptures scindonizingly Have faith in the spiritual master and Krishna And don't take this movement, don't take this Krishna consciousness cheaply Take it very seriously”

Do not take this movement cheaply. Taken seriously, we stay protected and sheltered by Krishna, and success is guaranteed. — “Take it very seriously”

🎙 Maharaj at 33:56 (auto-transcript): “And don't take this movement, don't take this Krishna consciousness cheaply Take it very seriously If you take Krishna consciousness very seriously We will not follow him. We will remain fully protected. We will remain fully share-tied by Krishna. And our success is guaranteed.”

Maharaj observes that 'serious' is a word everyone uses every day — I am serious about this, you are not serious. But how serious are devotees in Krishna consciousness?

🎙 Maharaj at 34:43 (auto-transcript): “The word serious is very common. People use the word, it's very common, serious is a common word that people say every day, every day hear the word serious. People say I'm very serious about what I'm discussing about. Someone will say, you are not serious You are not serious…”

A serious devotee follows the instructions properly and takes sadhana and service seriously; for him success is guaranteed, for the casual it is not.

🎙 Maharaj at 35:46 (auto-transcript): “A person who is very serious in Christian consciousness will follow the instructions proper to give seriously. We will take our sadhana very seriously, we will take our devotional activities very seriously. And the success is guaranteed. For one who is not serious, success is…”

Goodness is going down every day while passion and ignorance grow. Krishna consciousness is hard now and will be harder in the next birth, so postponing only adds difficulty.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:47 (auto-transcript): “And Kalyuga is progressing, dangerously, every day. Things are going down, especially goodness is going down every day. Ignorance and passion is progressing, goodness is going down every day. If we don't take our Krishna consciousness seriously, we will not beg it. We will…”

Krishna comes because his pure devotees call him. We already have him as the deity, the Bhagavatam and other scriptures, Tulasi, the Ganga and devotees — all his mercy, to be used fully.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:02 (auto-transcript): “And Krishna appears not because we call for Him, it's because His pure devotees call for Him. So we have Krishna in the form of a deity. We have the scriptures, Srimad Bhagavatam, another literature, we have Tursi Devi, we have Ganda, we have devotees of Krishna, all these…”

Three questions after the class, translated for the audience.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:18 (auto-transcript): “If you have any questions, we will provide you with 100% of your time.”

children.topic: Q1 · How do we use our day?
children.note:
The question is not audible; Maharaj answers on seriousness by counting the hours of a day.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:35 (auto-transcript): “We are talking about seriousness. Krishna gave us 24 hours. How many hours do we use for Krishna? how many hours for japa japa how long does he take 16 rounds two hours so we have remaining 22”

Krishna gives us 24 hours. Sixteen rounds take about two; what happens to the other twenty-two? Mostly they go to the cell phone.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:13 (auto-transcript): “how many hours for japa japa how long does he take 16 rounds two hours so we have remaining 22 hours what do we do remaining they would do it in 22 hours wasted it's wasted for cell phone we spend all our time with cell phone how many times do we”

He asks who reads the Bhagavatam daily — about ten percent of the room. Nobody wants ten percent in an exam, yet our spiritual life is like that. — “But our spiritual life is like that, 10%.”

🎙 Maharaj at 42:41 (auto-transcript): “Ten percent. Which do they want to get ten percent in the examination? Who want ten percent in the exam? Ten percent. Out of hundred, you get ten percent. Who want that? But our spiritual life is like that, 10%. So we are not taking our Krishna consciousness seriously.”

His rule: sixteen rounds finished and two hours of Bhagavatam study — then you are qualified to use the cell phone; otherwise no phone.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:36 (auto-transcript): “Means no cell phone. No? No? Cell phone. Until you have finished 16 rounds and study Pagwata for 2 hours, then cell phone. Qualification for us when you use cell phone means 16 rounds complete, 2 hours per time complete, then you are qualified to use cell phone.”

Without serious sadhana the senses torment us. A mantra frees the mind from material dualities; if we are not chanting, nothing else will clear a mind clouded by material association.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:58 (auto-transcript): “Mantra, the meaning is the prayer that can free the mind from dualities of material existence. so harakrishna maha mantra is to free the mind so if we are not engaged in chanting what will free the mind nothing will feed the mind our mind will be clouded with all the dirty…”

Do we fall asleep while eating prasadam? No, because we are serious about eating. If we were as serious about japa we would not sleep in it, and would want more after sixteen rounds.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:44 (auto-transcript): “When we take prasada, do we sleep? Do we sleep when we take prasada? No. Why? Because we are serious about eating. we are not serious about japa then we sleep therefore let us be serious so we don't sleep on japa”

children.topic: Q2 · Steady in joy and distress?
children.note:
Krishna says in the Gita that he is dear to one who stays equal in happiness and distress — how can we remain in that state?

🎙 Maharaj at 48:23 (auto-transcript): “The question is, Lord Krishna says in Bhagavad Gita that I am dear to that person who always remains stable, equilibrium. doesn't matter there is happiness or distress so how we can remain always in that state it is by practice by practice if we practice the disciplines in…”

It comes by practice. A student who follows the teacher's training becomes expert in time; following the regulative principles likewise brings freedom.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:43 (auto-transcript): “practice by practice if we practice the disciplines in our process will become strong”

Practice should be done under someone expert. The verse already says it: the spiritual master is the captain who knows how to take the boat across.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:15 (auto-transcript): “It should be practiced under a guide, but who is an expert in that field will guide us how to practice our Krishna conscious activities. In this verse, it is mentioned the spiritual master is the captain, so he is an expert because he knows how to take the boat across the…”

A young man, one year in Krishna consciousness, feels he must return to material life for duties at home. How can material and spiritual life be balanced?

🎙 Maharaj at 52:45 (auto-transcript): “He has come to Krishna consciousness one year before. It's been one year. Now he wants to again live that material life because he has some responsibility at his home. So the question is that how you can balance both life, material and spiritual as well. You don't have to…”

Many devotees are in business. Arjuna was a soldier who wanted to quit, and Krishna said no — fight, but add Krishna to what you do.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:50 (auto-transcript): “And Arjuna was not a Brahmana, he was a soldier. Was he wanted to give up fighting? Krishna said no. Do the fighting. Do our service. You should work. At the same time, add Krishna into what we do.”

Rise early, go to work, come back and read some scripture, then sleep — that is doing both. Do not give up this rare opportunity; the next life will be harder.

🎙 Maharaj at 55:08 (auto-transcript): “You stand six-year-old in the morning, then you go to work, you come back in the evening, you read some scripture, then you go to bed, that's all, you are doing the two things together. You don't have to give it up.”

His mother practises and does not stop him, so Maharaj asks plainly what the real problem is. — “The problem is you.”

🎙 Maharaj at 56:16 (auto-transcript): “So what is the problem? If your mother is not disturbing you, what is the problem? If your mother is not disturbing you, she is practicing. And you, you don't want to practice. What is the problem? The problem is you. Narada Muni told Daksa's children, if you are intelligent,…”

As Narada told Daksa's sons to follow their elder brothers who had reached perfection, follow your mother. Many have parents opposed to devotion; his is practising — follow her and both will be happy.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:42 (auto-transcript): “Narada Muni told Daksa's children, if you are intelligent, follow your Sino brothers. Your Sinu brothers took to Krishna consciousness. They have gone back to God. If you are intelligent, follow your Sinu brothers. You also attain success. If you are intelligent, follow your…”

maps.title: SB Canto 11 · Class 05 · A Disciple Achieves Love of Godhead

nodeData.topic: Class 05 · A Disciple Achieves Love of Godhead
nodeData.note: SB 11.3.29–30 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Love of Godhead is not attained by our own strength but given by pure devotees, so the disciple cultivates genuine friendship with those surrendered to Krishna and serves all beings, especially the Lord's pure devotees — the express route to Krishna. Maharaj shows how devotees gathering to chant and hear together purify one another, why kirtan and sadhana depend on association, and in questions speaks on offences in service, closed doors to service, varnasrama in the Bhagavatam, and always learning from others. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The verse teaches that one seeking his real self-interest befriends those who have made Krishna the Lord of their life, serves all beings, and above all serves the pure devotees.

children.topic: Shelter of those at his feet
children.note:
Maharaj sings a prayer of taking shelter of those who have reached Krishna's lotus feet. They are very dear to Krishna and have him; by their shelter it is 100% possible to get Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 19:07 (auto-transcript): “Today I take shelter of those Who are fully situated and allotted feet I build a shelter for those who attain Goloka Vrindavan. Why? Those who attain the lotus field of Krishna They are very, very dear to Krishna, they have Krishna and by taking their shelter, it is 100%…”

When Rupa and Sanatana came, Mahaprabhu took them to Advaita Acarya: they have given up everything — only a waterpot and their cloth — so give them pure love, do not cheat them. Without a devotee's mercy, one cannot get it. — “don't cheat them don't cheat them give them pure love of godhead”

🎙 Maharaj at 20:07 (auto-transcript): “When Sri Laroopa Goswami and Santana Goswami came to meet Lord Chitanya Mahaprabhu Sri Chitanya Mahaprabhu took them to Lord Advaita Acharya I'm told Admitacharya, these two brothers they are extremely renowned, they have abandoned everything, the only thing they have is just…”

The powerful advice of this verse is to establish friendship with the maha-bhagavatas, pure devotees of Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:21 (auto-transcript): “So we have been advised here to obtain our ultimate self-interest, who should cultivate We have a friendship with those who have accepted Krishna and their Lord. It was a very friendship.”

To be a friend means holding each other's self-interest in our heart, having things in common, being ready to serve.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:07 (auto-transcript): “To be a friend means we have each other's self-interest. That is the meaning of friendship, we have interest of each other in our heart, and we have things in common, we are ready to serve, friendship is better. So, the powerful advice here is that we should establish…”

Our self-interest is pure love of God, and it is given by pure devotees. Befriend them; when they see our sweet, transparent dealings they are very kind. — “it is not attained by our strength”

🎙 Maharaj at 23:15 (auto-transcript): “the self-interest is pure love of God pure devotional service is given it is not attained by our strength it is given by pure devotees so if you make friendship with them When they see our sweet dealings, they see the transparency. Prabhupada said they are very kind, these…”

We are asked to serve all: pure devotees, practising devotees like us, and innocent non-devotees — each in the appropriate way.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:09 (auto-transcript): “and he continued one should further develop an attitude of service towards all living beings one should especially try to help those in a human form of life among them especially those who accept the principles of religious behavior the devotees here we are looking at the…”

Service to sincere non-devotees means preaching Krishna consciousness to them.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:16 (auto-transcript): “We have been asked to render service to all. Rendering service to those who are sincere by preaching Krishna consciousness to them. serving those who are also devotees, practicing devotees like us, is by supporting each other in our Christian process. By our friendly…”

Serve devotees like us by supporting each other's practice: friendly dealings, practical help, a transparent life and truthful speech encourage others.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:35 (auto-transcript): “serving those who are also devotees, practicing devotees like us, is by supporting each other in our Christian process. By our friendly dealings, by physically doing something, some service by living a life which is very transparent that will encourage others in their…”

Srila Bhaktisiddhanta Sarasvati Thakura writes that the highest duty of devotees is friendship with those fully surrendered to Krishna. Maharaj says he is holding up a mirror to us.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:55 (auto-transcript): “So Bhakti Siddhanda says what the Thakur is speaking in the Poport. The highest duty for devotees of the Supreme Lord is to establish friendship with those those who have completely surrendered to Krishna and who have those achieved sarana gati sarana gati They say to…”

What do we see in the mirror? Without friendly dealings with each other there is no success — only disaster.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:56 (auto-transcript): “What do we see? If we don't have friendly dealing with each other, we will not have charity. No success. Only disaster. Friendship is very important. It will also not be artificial, genuine friendship, avoiding pretension, this does not depend”

Friendship must be genuine, without pretension, serving devotees without envy. It does not depend on others but on each of us; we are responsible for our own progress.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:37 (auto-transcript): “It will also not be artificial, genuine friendship, avoiding pretension, this does not depend on others it depends on us individually so we are responsible for our progress in christian consciousness”

Look around — what do we see? Suffering. What are we doing to help people in difficulty? That is friendship. One must become a human being first, then devotional service can begin. — “if we are not worried about this means we are not human beings yet”

🎙 Maharaj at 29:54 (auto-transcript): “The solidest vertical matter said, look around. What do we see? Suffering. so what are we doing to assist people in our difficulties this is friendship this is serious what are we doing to assist devotees people in general what our difficulties if we are not worried about…”

Since the Lord is more pleased by service to his pure devotees, service to a mahatma is the express route — mahat-sevam dvaram ahur vimukteh.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:22 (auto-transcript): “it is this december 11th kanto yes krishna is speaking to order If the service to my devotees is superior to my service, why devotees are so insulted? In the third canto Bhagavatam, Lord Kapiwede was speaking to his mother, my devotees, they don't want anything from me, even…”

As Lord Kapila tells his mother, his devotees want nothing — offer them anything and they refuse; they want only service. Krishna cannot reciprocate, so he is in their debt.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:50 (auto-transcript): “In the third canto Bhagavatam, Lord Kapiwede was speaking to his mother, my devotees, they don't want anything from me, even if I force them, take, take something, no I don't want it. So what do you want? Service. Krishna is glorifying his devotees. My devotees want nothing…”

children.topic: Why he is pleased with us
children.note:
When Krishna sees someone serving his devotee — doing what he himself cannot repay — he becomes very happy with that person. The mahatmas' hearts are full of prema; serving them is the expressway.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:10 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, to liquidate that debt, So when Krishna sees that someone is rendering service to his devotee, something he cannot do, Krishna becomes very happy with that devotee. So when Krishna sees that I don't want to do that bhakti seva that I don't want to do anything else,…”
The verse describes devotees gathering to chant the Lord's glories, developing loving friendship, feeling mutual happiness and helping each other give up sense gratification.

Recalling the Gita's verse on devotees enlightening one another, Maharaj notes parampara is a chain, but parasparam means together — discussing Krishna and chanting his glory among devotees. The association of the spiritual world begins here.

What is the quality of our association? Maharaj acts out the mind that won't look at a devotee's face because he got a gulab jamun and I did not. Such subtle feelings harm our progress; check your life against this verse.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:12 (auto-transcript): “What is the quality of our association? Sweet. It's sweet. I want to see you. I don't want to see your face. Gulab Jam, yes. I'll see your face today.”

Happiness and satisfaction come by making friends, chanting, hearing and serving Krishna together — togetherness. It is a science; you have to apply it.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:36 (auto-transcript): “To send the child, it's a science. You have to apply it. This is how we develop what? Happiness and satisfaction. Making friendship with each other. Chant together. Hear about Krishna together. serve krishna together we'll go together together togetherness togetherness”

Sridhara Svami says advanced devotees should not envy or quarrel, but give up such feelings and gather to chant for mutual purification. Maharaj says this brings great healing.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:45 (auto-transcript): “according to sridhar swami those who are advanced in christian consciousness should not Envy one another, or quarrel among themselves. Giving them all such mundane feelings, they should gather together and chant the glory to the Supreme Lord for mutual purification. And we…”

Visvanatha Cakravarti Thakura notes that glorification is especially potent in the association of pure devotees; in sankirtan devotees taste the highest bliss.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:03 (auto-transcript): “See the Vishnu Chakravarti Chakura has pointed out that Glorification of the Supreme Lord is especially potent when performed in association of pure devotee. When devotees engage in sankirtan, chanting the glories to the Lord together, they experience the highest…”

Recalling the morning's kirtan, Maharaj asks: can one person play mridanga and karatalas, lead the chant, do arati and dance? A tumultuous kirtan that shakes the universe is possible only together.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:37 (auto-transcript): “is it true this morning did they experience it can any one of us do that alone in a mahab We can do this alone, what we can do in the morning. Alone. You play Mradanga, you do Karatlas, you do the chanting, you do the arati together and you dance. You can do it alone. You can…”

So we should appreciate each other: because of you I can dance in ecstasy — I need you. If we are not friends, we cannot do kirtan together. Our strength, protection, realisation and encouragement come from association.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:45 (auto-transcript): “So, what does that mean? we should appreciate each other because of you I can have a blissful jumper that means you are very important in my life let us appreciate each other because of self support I can have a tumultuous Kirtan and dance in ecstasy, I need you. Thank you.…”

Devotees encourage one another to give up sense gratification: seeing another give it up, one resolves to do the same.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:38 (auto-transcript): “Does they encourage one another to give up material science gratification which is based on illicit sexual connections with women only what he would say to another oh you have given off sanctification starting today i shall also give it off Is he not? When he said what he is,…”

If your friend has chanted 32 rounds before 7:30, how will you feel? Tomorrow I want to do that too — please wake me up. It is natural.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:16 (auto-transcript): “Is he not? When he said what he is, he's chanting 32 round. The best of any, to chant before 7.30. How will he feel in association with that person? Tomorrow I want to work on what you want. Bravo, please, work in tomorrow also. make you wake me up it is natural because if…”

If everyone is up chanting and you alone are sleeping, your mind will beat you severely. Coming to prasadam without mangala-arati or rounds, you feel: what am I doing here? Those who feel nothing should not stay.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:52 (auto-transcript): “make you wake me up it is natural because if someone if you are together and others they are they are up chanting you alone is sleeping in the room how would you feel how will you feel You sleep peacefully, your mind will beat you severely.”

A man came to a temple insisting on surrendering at once — he had given away his house and said goodbye to his family. Advised to start gradually, he stayed anyway; after two nights of being woken at the early hour he disappeared, and reportedly had to buy his house back.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:31 (auto-transcript): “Some years ago, a man came to the temple, and he said, Prabhu, I want to surrender, and said, no, she will go and be coming and start from spending weekend water. Don't just come like this. I want to surrender now. You can't tell me that. I want to surrender now. I'm tired. I…”

Questions from devotees at the end of the class.

🎙 Maharaj at 55:14 (auto-transcript): “Any comments or questions? Hare Krishna. Do you have any questions? Do you have any questions? Yes, sir. if you are cultivating field You are not a devotee. You are not a devotee. You are cultivating a field. Or you are walking in the street. Or you are cooking in the…”

children.topic: Q1 · Offences in life and service
children.note:
Farming, walking, cooking, even breathing kills countless living beings — jiva-aparadha. Even yogis living on air kill; that is why non-devotees remain eternally bound. It is very dangerous to live here without being a devotee.

🎙 Maharaj at 55:21 (auto-transcript): “if you are cultivating field You are not a devotee. You are not a devotee. You are cultivating a field. Or you are walking in the street. Or you are cooking in the kitchen. Or you are breathing. What is that? We are doing jiva parada. Killing so many living beings.”

There are also offences in service: not letting others serve, thinking nothing works without me, cooking while thinking I am the world's best cook.

🎙 Maharaj at 58:48 (auto-transcript): “Parada, Seva Parada. The offences we make in the process of our devotional activities, devotional service. Sometimes we are doing service, sometimes we are doing say but I don't want you to serve I don't want you to sir sir but I'm not giving chance for order to do things I…”

Prabhupada said sankirtan books maintain his life; a proud distributor concludes that he keeps Prabhupada alive and everyone else is useless. That pride is the offence.

🎙 Maharaj at 60:18 (auto-transcript): “Prabhupada said, Sankirtan booked this mission in maintaining my life. Therefore, I am maintaining Prabhupada's life. Prabhupada is existing because of me. What does that mean? No Prabhupada. And all of you are not doing Sankirtan? You are useless, so let me know what I am.”

children.topic: Q2 · Every door to service closed
children.note:
What should a devotee do in a place where every attempt to serve is refused?

🎙 Maharaj at 61:20 (auto-transcript): “You mentioned that if we are not friends, in the Bodhisattva service, we will not be able to serve together. Yes. So there are times that one finds himself in a different environment, For example, we are very friendly, so we can come here and decide to want to be in any…”

Maharaj knows of a famous temple where even harinama needs management's permission. Then go and start a centre somewhere. If you cannot, pray to Krishna to arrange service — he will, if we are serious.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:44 (auto-transcript): “Yes, I have experience. So I don't think that it's new. I have experience. I don't know anything new. I know a very famous temple here in India. For you to do Harinam, you have to take permission from the management. Harinam. You take permission before you do Harinam. Not…”

He once asked a temple why it would not let devotees distribute books to thousands of visitors. Such unfriendly dealings exist in our system — envious people are found in every movement — but if we are ready to serve, Krishna will open a way.

🎙 Maharaj at 66:57 (auto-transcript): “So these unfriendly dealings are in our system. Baba Ji has mentioned that there are so many envious people in this movement He says they will behave like this But that shouldn't be a discouragement for us If we are ready for service pray to krishna he will have raised for…”

If the Bhagavatam throws out cheating religion, why does it describe varnasrama and the mystic perfections in such detail?

🎙 Maharaj at 67:50 (auto-transcript): “go ahead i've heard since a long time and this question was there in my mind but i've ever asked we heard that human bhagavatam is framed it only gives pure love and uh our face of them is thrown out meaning cheating religion has been thrown out so but in many In many…”

Maharaj points to Vrindavan's brahmana Madhumangala and the vaisya Nanda Maharaja: wherever there is organisation there is varnasrama — spiritual life is perfectly organised. For conditioned souls it is for purification, and one does varnasrama duties well while practising.

🎙 Maharaj at 72:06 (auto-transcript): “there are two types in Vrindavan we don't have a Madhu Mangal and what is his statue what is that what is his statue Shatriya, Nandamaharai, Vaishwarya Where are they?”

The mystic powers are not separate; they are with the soul, its natural ornaments, covered over in our conditioned state.

🎙 Maharaj at 74:00 (auto-transcript): “The soul, all these mystic powers, they are in the soul. They are together with the soul. They are together, not separate. Because you are covered over, So it's strange for us. All these mystic powers, they are part of the soul. They are literally ornament of the soul. So…”

With peers we just chat, thinking everyone already knows Krishna-katha. Maharaj says share anyway — together we will learn many more things.

🎙 Maharaj at 75:45 (auto-transcript): “I just want to ask about the importance of this decision and whom to take a decision. My main question is that when we associate with equality, that then it becomes difficult to discuss about Krishnakadatta, because most of the time when we meet, we just talk how are you, and…”

Asked why he attends others' classes, Maharaj says he must learn something new in any class, whoever speaks. Thinking 'I already know what you will say' is very dangerous: Krishna is unlimited and has unlimited ways to help us. — “very dangerous mentality Krishna is not limited”

🎙 Maharaj at 77:34 (auto-transcript): “Why do you should go to classes? And another devotee also asked me recently. Someone is speaking. A Jino devotee was speaking. So I went there. So at the end, one devotee asked me. why he has to come so I told the devotees for me any class I attend I must learn something new”

nodeData.topic: Class 04 · A Disciple Should Make Further Advancement
nodeData.note: SB 11.3.25–28 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. The 'secluded place' a disciple needs is a consciousness fixed in Krishna — with it one is peaceful anywhere, as Srila Prabhupada stayed calm when a temple was in crisis. Maharaj teaches that simplicity and renunciation are matters of consciousness, not tattered cloth, that preaching is today's austerity, and that firm faith makes success certain for one who sticks to the process; questions follow on family life, false ego, temptation and weak phases. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The verse asks the disciple to see himself as spirit soul and the Lord as controller, to live in a sacred, secluded place, give up false attachment to home and be satisfied with whatever comes.

Maharaj asks where such a place is. There is none in this world; one fully absorbed in Krishna consciousness can stay anywhere, and if the heart is disturbed, even the heavenly planets will not help.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:57 (auto-transcript): “So where is the place, where do you think it is? is fully aware of christian consciousness we can stay anywhere if the heart is disturbed”

children.topic: Peaceful in the middle of fire
children.note:
Disturbing situations are always here; our duty is to make ourselves steady by fixing ourselves in Krishna consciousness without duplicity — then we stay peaceful even in the middle of fire.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:11 (auto-transcript): “One who knows that in this material world There is always a disturbing situation But it is our duty to make ourselves comfortable By fixing oneself in Christian conference, without duplicity, we will be peaceful, even in the middle of fire. So the Papa was going to give our…”

children.topic: Prabhupada and the temple in crisis
children.note:
Before a class, a disciple brought Srila Prabhupada an urgent letter about serious trouble in his temple — 'the temple is on fire, it needs attention now'.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:51 (auto-transcript): “So the Papa was going to give our later class. And the disciple brought a very disturbing letter to him. The devotee were having problems in his temple. So he came to Prabhupada's fascination. He gave a letter to Prabhupada. He dropped it on the table.”

Prabhupada put the letter on the table, said nothing, gave the class normally, then returned to his room and calmly called a devotee to deal with it. No anxiety.

🎙 Maharaj at 25:31 (auto-transcript): “He dropped it on the table. He didn't say anything about it. The devotee was wrong. I take place on fire. I need attention now. I hope I draw the letter. He didn't say anything about it. What about this problem? What was the problem?”

No place in this world is free of anxiety; we have to create that place within. Then we can live in Vaikuntha or in hell, peacefully. — “you can stay anywhere peacefully.”

🎙 Maharaj at 27:05 (auto-transcript): “No anxiety. So there is no way in this world we are going to stay there. and when we are free, it is we who have to create that free anxiety-free place. When that is done, you can stay in Vaikuntha, you can stay in Hell, you can stay in Hell,”

Do not think a Hare Krishna temple guarantees 100% peace — that is a mistake.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:55 (auto-transcript): “So what is you think, going to Hare Krishna temple, I will be 100% peaceful, make a mistake. Who is going to be envious of you as a devotee?”

nodeData.topic: Class 03 · Training of a Disciple by a Bona Fide Guru
nodeData.note: SB 11.3.21–24 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Taking shelter of a bona fide spiritual master is compulsory for anyone who wants real happiness; the guru speaks from scripture and realisation, and the disciple, after testing, accepts him in full surrender and serves him without duplicity. Maharaj explains why Krishna reveals himself through his pure devotees, how a disciple deals with all beings, and the qualities — cleanliness, forgiveness, simplicity, non-violence, tolerance — needed to serve the guru; questions follow on hearing from non-devotees and on telling the truth. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Prabuddha tells King Nimi that one who seriously wants real happiness must take shelter of a spiritual master who knows the scriptures, can convince others and has taken shelter of the Lord.

For those with no attraction to Krishna because of addiction to sense gratification, the recommendation is to take shelter of a bona fide guru. Maharaj stresses it is not 'if I like'. Just as light is necessary for one in darkness, the guru is necessary for one in illusion.

🎙 Maharaj at 20:02 (auto-transcript): “due to addiction the sanctification so the recommendation is that we should take shelter of a bonafide spiritual master this compulsory in the Punisher the word a big a big it is not an option if I like I can or if I don't like it can”

The guru speaks from scripture, not his own brain; and not just philosophy but realisation, with full conviction and faith in Krishna. That conviction is what affects the audience. — “he is speaking from the scripture, not from his brain”

🎙 Maharaj at 23:05 (auto-transcript): “compulsory for a person in illusion so it is compulsory the qualification is that he is speaking from the scripture, not from his brain, from the scripture, and he is not just speaking the philosophy, he is speaking the realization, he is fully”
The disciple accepts the bona fide guru as his life and soul and worshipable deity, and learns from him to serve the Lord so faithfully that Krishna gives himself.

As the Gita says, one approaches the guru in full surrender and serves him as a menial servant without false prestige — that is why there is guru-puja. — “not half not 99.9 hundred percent full surrender”

Without confidence nothing works. If doubts sit in the mind — will he take me back to Godhead, is he the right person? — the transmission stops flowing. Subtle as it is, the disconnection has a serious effect.

children.note:
One who recites scripture without practising it is like a karma-kandi; his words have no effect, because people perceive what is in our heart.

🎙 Maharaj at 82:39 (auto-transcript): “Just an understanding on this. Speak from scripture, the truth. But you know, practice it. But it is a truth given in the scripture. You can preach about it. But our practice may be different from that. So then how should we see it? One who can recite the scriptures, he's…”
