maps.title: SB Canto 11 · Class 02 · Krishna Is Conquered Only by Love

nodeData.topic: Class 02 · Krishna Is Conquered Only by Love
nodeData.note: SB 11.6.18 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Krishna lives with sixteen thousand queens of unearthly beauty, yet nothing material or even spiritual enjoyment can disturb his mind — he is conquered only by the pure, selfless love of his devotees. Maharaj contrasts that love with lust, tells how the gopis' love held Krishna back from Mathura and how they gave the dust of their feet to cure his headache, and asks us to follow, not imitate, the gopis. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: The demigods praise Krishna: though surrounded by sixteen thousand beautiful queens sending him loving glances, his mind and senses remain undisturbed.

Maharaj builds a ladder: the most beautiful person here times a hundred is heavenly beauty; that times a hundred is Brahmaloka; that times a thousand is Vaikuntha; beyond any figure is Goloka. The queens' beauty is from there and cannot be compared with anything in this world.

🎙 Maharaj at 28:26 (auto-transcript): “When you take the most beautiful person in this world, multiply that by a hundred. That is heaven. That is beauty in heaven. Take the beauty of heaven, multiplied into 100, that is Brahma, the highest material”

Like the gopis, the queens serve Krishna with pure affection — something not found in the material world.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:35 (auto-transcript): “The gopis, they serve Krishna with affection. That is what they use to serve Krishna, affection. The gopis is like that they serve Krishna. They are like that they serve, like affection. That is not in the material world. We don't serve someone with affection. We serve with…”

Here we serve others out of greed and self-interest. What the world calls love is lust — pure love contaminated, its very opposite.

🎙 Maharaj at 30:54 (auto-transcript): “We don't serve someone with affection. We serve with greed. Some interests. So it is not affection. Contaminated. And what people think affection in the world? What do you think is an affection? That is lost. Lost is a contaminated love of Godhead. Opposite of love.”

Lust says: I want to use you to fill my empty life; my enjoyment is in your body and you should give it to me. Maharaj says there is no love in it at all — only selfishness.

🎙 Maharaj at 31:50 (auto-transcript): “I want to use you to fill my empty space, my empty life. That is lost. Selfishness. There is no love at all. There is nothing like love. Selfishness. I want to enjoy. My enjoyment is in your body and you should give it to me.”

Because it is selfish desire, it does not end well: it ends in frustration, anxiety and pain. Pure love of God is different. — “That is the result of lust.”

🎙 Maharaj at 32:44 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, because it is lusty, selfish desire, it does not end well, it ends in disaster, frustration, anxiety, pain. That is the result of lust. So that is not the situation with pure love for God. Lord Krishna's queens and Lord Krishna's girlfriends, the gopis,”

children.topic: Controlled by his own spiritual energy
children.note:
The demigods say Krishna is not controlled by material or spiritual enjoyment — yet he is controlled by his internal potency. Maharaj calls this the 'interesting philosophy' of the verse.

🎙 Maharaj at 33:40 (auto-transcript): “But the demigods are saying, Lord Krishna, you are not controlled by material energy. You are not controlled by spiritual energy. That is philosophy. I told you this verse is very interesting. That is philosophy. Krishna is controlled by his energy, his spiritual energy.…”

Principally Srimati Radharani controls him. The gopis' love even made Krishna forget his duty to go and kill Kamsa.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:10 (auto-transcript): “That is philosophy. Krishna is controlled by his energy, his spiritual energy. Principally, Srimati Radharani, he controls Krishna. And Sanatana Goswami said, the love of the gopis in Brindavan, Another one, made Krishna forget his duty. Krishna forgot what he is supposed to…”

Being controlled by pure love is natural, because pure love is the supreme potency and Radharani is Krishna's own energy — his own enjoyment. — “That is the nature of love.”

🎙 Maharaj at 35:09 (auto-transcript): “So, Krishna is controlled by his spiritual potency. That is not a fault. It is natural. Because the nature of pure love that has supreme potency. So Krishna is affected by that, because it is his enjoyment, that is his enjoyment, and it is himself, in that form of Srimati…”

Because Krishna had forgotten to go to Mathura, Akrura came to bring him.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:24 (auto-transcript): “He forgot to go to Mathura to kill Kamsa. So, Akura came. Akura did two things. He has to justice Krishna. You see? Is this interesting? Akura is justiceing Krishna. Your parents, you are devoted, they are suffering in the hands of Kamsa every day.”

Akrura reproaches Krishna: your parents and devotees suffer every day as Kamsa threatens them with a sword, and you sit here with your girlfriends doing nothing.

🎙 Maharaj at 36:44 (auto-transcript): “He has to justice Krishna. You see? Is this interesting? Akura is justiceing Krishna. Your parents, you are devoted, they are suffering in the hands of Kamsa every day. Every day. Kamsa. He comes to them. With sword in his hand. I will kill you. I'll kill you. He's treating…”

As soon as Krishna and Balarama mounted the chariot, the gopis came: we cannot bear you hiding behind a tree for a moment — your going is death. Krishna stepped down and followed them into the forest, and by the power of their love not even Balarama saw him go.

🎙 Maharaj at 38:14 (auto-transcript): “As soon as Krishna and Balaram got to the chariot, the gopis came there. You are leaving us for maturation. How can we exist without you? For a moment, when we are playing, and you went behind a tree, we cannot tolerate that. And you are going to go for a long time. That is…”

Akrura found only Balarama on the chariot and begged him to find his brother. Balarama traced Krishna's footprints to the gopis in the forest and brought him back.

🎙 Maharaj at 39:54 (auto-transcript): “Krishna is not there. Only Balaram is sitting there. He came to him. Where is your brother? I don't know. Please, I beg you. Please. Only you can find him. Go and find him. Balaram got down from the chariot. only look on the ground then he saw krishna's footprints that is how…”

Not wanting Krishna to vanish again, Akrura drove off at once, skilfully steering around the gopis who fell on the ground.

🎙 Maharaj at 40:57 (auto-transcript): “This time, as soon as he sat on the chariot, Akrura doesn't want him to disappear again. Immediately he started to drive the chariot. The gopi were falling on the ground. Akrura was very expert. He was driving. He didn't want to hit. He was driving, maneuvering. He was…”

Krishna is controlled by the love of his devotees, and by nothing in this world.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:42 (auto-transcript): “So, Krishna is controlled by his love for Fiddlesticks. that Krishna is controlled by the love of his devotees. Yudhishthira Maharaj, he told Krishna, please don't go to Dwaraka now, please, at least, just for a short time, just a short time, please, I beg you. Please please,…”

Yudhisthira Maharaja begged Krishna not to leave for Dvaraka, just for a few days more — and Krishna stayed. Sukadeva Gosvami's word for it is that Yudhisthira detained him.

🎙 Maharaj at 41:52 (auto-transcript): “Yudhishthira Maharaj, he told Krishna, please don't go to Dwaraka now, please, at least, just for a short time, just a short time, please, I beg you. Please please, please. Please! Please! Don't go to Dwaraka. Please, please stay at least a little time. Even though Krishna…”

children.topic: Queens as a reminder of Vraja
children.note:
Some Dvaraka queens have very high prema. Maharaj relates Krishna saying the queens' beauty and their number gave him some compensation for missing the gopis of Vrindavan — not that material beauty attracted him.

🎙 Maharaj at 43:04 (auto-transcript): “So, there are some queens of Dwarka who has prem. Her prem is very high. that Lord Krishna also feels compelled. Krishna himself, he said, I was able to tolerate the pain of separation from gopis. When I see the beauty of Chandravali,”

Though resting with such beautiful queens, at exactly three o'clock Krishna leaves the bed. When they complain, he says: look at the time, I have to do japa. Beauty cannot control him. — “Krishna is controlled by pure love.”

🎙 Maharaj at 47:34 (auto-transcript): “But, Krishna is not controlled, Krishna is sleeping with this kind of beauty, so sweet, but exactly 3 o'clock, Krishna leaves the bed, Krishna leaves the bed, the queens complain, Where are you going? We just lie down now. Krishna said, look at time. Three o'clock. I have to…”

One question from the audience, answered at length with a story.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:39 (auto-transcript): “Comment your questions. In the beginning of our class, your holiness talked about lust. That was selfishness.”

children.topic: Q1 · Lust disguised in devotional service?
children.note:
You said lust is selfishness — how can we recognise it when it hides inside our devotional service?

🎙 Maharaj at 49:09 (auto-transcript): “In the beginning of our class, your holiness talked about lust. That was selfishness. How can we identify our lust when it's disguised in our devotional service?”

Maharaj says it is not difficult: anything we do while expecting a result, or thinking I am the best, or putting ourselves in the middle of it, is lust.

🎙 Maharaj at 50:16 (auto-transcript): “Not difficult, not difficult, anything we are doing, and we are expecting some result, that is lost, anything we are doing, and we are thinking, I'm the best, lost. Anything we do, that we come inside it, that is lost.”

If we feel any inconvenience in what we do for Krishna, that too is lust. Tell the gopis Krishna is in the fire, and they will enter it — love can do anything.

🎙 Maharaj at 51:38 (auto-transcript): “Anything we do, that we have any inconvenience, we feel any inconvenience in anything that that we do, that is lost. The gopis, if you tell the gopi, Krishna is in this fire,”

Krishna wanted to show the world the excellence of the gopis' love, so he fell ill.

🎙 Maharaj at 52:41 (auto-transcript): “Krishna wanted to teach the world about the super-excellent nature of Godis. One day, the orchestra was in feverish condition. So, once Krishna had a fever, Narada Muni saw him. Narada Muni saw him. He said, what is happening? He said, what is happening? I am very sick. I am…”

Narada Muni found Krishna with a high fever and asked what medicine could help. Krishna said: only the dust from the feet of my devotees.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:12 (auto-transcript): “So, once Krishna had a fever, Narada Muni saw him. Narada Muni saw him. He said, what is happening? He said, what is happening? I am very sick. I am very sick. High fever. I have a very high fever. 100 degrees. 100 degrees. 150. Naramuni said, what to do? Naramuni said, what…”

Narada, himself a great devotee, went everywhere asking other devotees, and all refused out of fear of offence. He never thought of giving his own dust. Tired, he returned, and Krishna sent him to the gopis.

🎙 Maharaj at 56:00 (auto-transcript): “Why did he not remember that he is a devotee? And why did he not remember that he is a devotee? He is not a demon, he is a devotee. He is not a demon, he is a devotee. Why did he not give? And why did he not give? Not that he didn't give, he didn't remember at all. He is…”

The gopis immediately said: take, take! Narada warned them of hell for such an offence; they answered that they do not care — let Krishna be cured. Nothing else has any meaning for them. — “Let Krishna be cured of his headache.”

🎙 Maharaj at 58:56 (auto-transcript): “And Muni said, you know what I do? He wants to give doors from my feet on Krishna's head. You know what I do? You know how long you will stay in hell? Is it not an offense? False ego. You want to give my feet to Krishna? False ego? You want to do that? The gopi said what?”

Narada, the teacher of bhakti, said he now understood it: no ego, no selfishness — ready to be condemned, killed or sent to hell. Anything less than this, Maharaj says, is lust.

🎙 Maharaj at 60:41 (auto-transcript): “Many say yes, I cannot understand. I'm teaching Bhakti. Now I understood what is Bhakti. The ego is a Bhakti. No selfishness. They can go to hell. They can be killed. They can be crucified. They can be blasphemed. Condemned. That's all.”

It is a very high standard. How can we develop such love?

🎙 Maharaj at 61:49 (auto-transcript): “It's a very high standard. How can we develop love? How can we develop pure love of the gopis for Krishna? We have to follow the example of the Gopis. We should not think we are Gopis.”

We follow the example of the gopis, but we should not imagine we are gopis. — “We should not think we are Gopis.”

🎙 Maharaj at 62:18 (auto-transcript): “We have to follow the example of the Gopis. We should not think we are Gopis. But we can follow the Gopis. Let me sacrifice my prestige. Let me sacrifice my religion, let me sacrifice my position, everything, even death, for”

The gopis' standard is to sacrifice prestige, religion, position — even life — for Krishna. We reach towards it by practising and praying constantly for the gopis' love.

🎙 Maharaj at 62:42 (auto-transcript): “Let me sacrifice my prestige. Let me sacrifice my religion, let me sacrifice my position, everything, even death, for Krishna. That is the standard of Gopi. Who can follow that? Practicing and praying constantly”

We sing every morning for this, yet act the opposite — very dangerous ignorance. If we sing consciously, convinced this is what we want, begging the gopis to make us their servant, we will get there.

🎙 Maharaj at 63:43 (auto-transcript): “You sing this every morning, or you do the opposite. Very unfortunate. This is what you sing, but you act opposite, ignorance, very dangerous.”

maps.title: SB Canto 11 · Class 01 · Paramatma and Guru Work Together

nodeData.topic: Class 01 · Paramatma and Guru Work Together
nodeData.note: SB 11.29.6 · a class by HH Bhakti Dhira Damodara Swami. Pure devotees feel they are eternal debtors to Krishna, because he guides us from within as the Supersoul and from without as the bona fide acarya — and the more we serve, the more the debt grows. Maharaj explains why the Supersoul comes outside as the guru, gives a daily practice of listening within, and shares personal experiences of being guided; in the questions he contrasts the voice of the Supersoul with the voice of the mind. Notes are our own summary of the class; tap a bubble's link to hear that moment on YouTube.

children.note: Uddhava's prayer: the wise can never fully express what they owe the Lord, who comes to the embodied soul both as the acarya outside and the Supersoul within.

Maharaj recalls Srila Prabhupada's word for the devotees of Caitanya Mahaprabhu: they are debtors who cannot pay, because they have nothing to pay with. Pure devotees carry this sense deep in their consciousness. — “This is how pure devotees see themselves.”

🎙 Maharaj at 06:34 (auto-transcript): “Piyan means we are debtors who cannot pay our debt. We are debtors who cannot pay our debt. That is our position. And pure devotees, they have this very deep in their mind, in their consciousness, that we are peers, Chetam Mahabharata is peers, or guru is peers. We are not…”

Multiply Brahma's lifespan of billions of years over and over — still the debt would not be paid. Maharaj asks why the debt is so great.

🎙 Maharaj at 07:20 (auto-transcript): “And therefore, it is mentioned that even if we have the duration of Brahma's life multiplied all over, multiply all over the brahma lives for four billion three hundred and twenty million years that is brahma's four billion three hundred twenty million years that is brahma's…”

Following Visvanatha Cakravarti Thakura, Maharaj explains that Krishna appears externally as the diksha and siksha guru and internally as the Paramatma, working two ways to bring us to him.

🎙 Maharaj at 07:54 (auto-transcript): “debt. Why? Why our debt is so powerful that we cannot pay? Bishwana Chakravati Takora explained the reason. He said, Krishna, you appeared externally as the mantra guru and”

Here 'siksha guru' does not mean anyone who teaches in the temple; it means pure devotees, initiating and instructing, who are expansions of the Supersoul's mercy and share one goal: to deliver us to Krishna by training.

🎙 Maharaj at 09:04 (auto-transcript): “both of both of them the deksha and the six group they are pure duties not just what you have in mauritsas everybody is a siksha guru that is that is different here we are talking about pure devotees not just any any there are many varieties of siksha gurus many varieties but…”
As Krishna says in the Gita, he gives the intelligence by which devotees come to him. From inside he inspires us and reveals the goal — becoming his associate in pure love.

The more we serve and think of Krishna, the more bliss we receive — and so the more we owe. Prema never stops increasing, so we remain eternal debtors. — “The debt is always increasing.”

🎙 Maharaj at 11:06 (auto-transcript): “attend krishna when we attend pure local godhead the more we serve krishna the more bliss we get, means what? Means what? We are eternally indebted to Krishna. How? Because the prayer that Krishna gives to us is increasing. So our debt is increasing. How do we do it today?…”

We should be convinced of our nature: we belong eternally to the guru and to Krishna, his children, and our position is to realise that relationship through service. — “we are eternally guru's property”

🎙 Maharaj at 13:19 (auto-transcript): “Therefore, we are eternally a guru's property we are eternally guru's property we should be convinced of our nature that we are eternally guru's property we are eternally christian's property and christian claim all of us we are eternally christian's children eternally…”

The Supersoul is Krishna's own expansion, accompanying every living being, so in one sense it is Krishna doing everything.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:22 (auto-transcript): “the super soul is expansion of Krishna so in one sense it is Krishna doing everything the supreme position of God has expanded himself as Paramatma so he can accompany all of us but he's there in the heart of everyone but not everyone of us can recognize him or realize him…”

The Supersoul speaks in every heart every day, but our senses are dulled by sense gratification and we do not hear. Seeing our helpless state, he comes outside as the bona fide acarya whom we can see face to face and identify with.

🎙 Maharaj at 14:50 (auto-transcript): “even though he speaks every day we don't hear him because we are so engrossed in sense gratification and therefore our senses have become so dull that we cannot hear what is when the super soul speaks lord christian saw our helpless situation so he has planned the super soul…”

Maharaj asks us to imagine our beloved guru calling us to his room and giving wonderful confidential instructions — but we cannot see him. We would enjoy it, yet feel uneasy and beg: can I see you?

🎙 Maharaj at 15:49 (auto-transcript): “or with her normally normally how will you feel how will you feel if um yeah on spiritual master yeah guru you love very much both of you they have good relationship he asking you hey prabhu mataji please come to come to my my room now you have gone there which you normally…”

He recalls a pastime where Krishna disappeared yet kept speaking to his beloved, who said: I know you are here, but show me your transcendental form. We too want to see.

🎙 Maharaj at 18:26 (auto-transcript): “like that i will request guru there show yourself to me i remember this this material when krishna disappeared krishna was dancing with the gopis and disappeared and he took his material away with other groupies. At a point also, Krishna disappeared from Symmetra. And they…”

A teacher who takes the student's hand to teach writing is sweeter than one who only talks. The acarya shows by his daily life how to practise devotional service.

🎙 Maharaj at 21:00 (auto-transcript): “if a teacher is taking the hand of the student and teaching him how to write very sweet we feel very happy his presence is there has effect on us then if you're just talking and not doing anything practical so the the physical manifestation of the super soul is a specialness…”

Following the acarya purifies us until we can also hear the Supersoul in the heart. The one outside prepares us to connect with the one inside, and finally with Sri Krishna.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:08 (auto-transcript): “follow the instruction of the Acharya we will be able to get purified to the point we also be hearing the instruction of the super soul in the heart so the one outside is to prepare us to lead us to guide us to help us connect what they want inside and ultimately the supreme…”

Maharaj gives a practical exercise for realising this relationship.

🎙 Maharaj at 22:47 (auto-transcript): “exercise if you want to realize that we can do some practical exercise that every day Every day in our life. Every day. We should have a spare time. Spare time. 20 minutes, 30 minutes. When we're not chanting, we're not reading, we're not doing anything, we simply try to…”

Set aside 20 or 30 minutes daily — not chanting, reading, talking or sleeping — in a quiet place, simply attentive to the inner voice of the Supersoul. — “We simply listen to the inner voice.”

🎙 Maharaj at 22:56 (auto-transcript): “Every day in our life. Every day. We should have a spare time. Spare time. 20 minutes, 30 minutes. When we're not chanting, we're not reading, we're not doing anything, we simply try to listen to the inner voice. We listen to the inner voice. We simply listen to the inner…”

Great personalities, material and spiritual, made such listening part of their day. If we do it, Maharaj says, our practice will advance very fast, since the Supersoul accompanies us precisely to instruct us for our benefit.

🎙 Maharaj at 24:00 (auto-transcript): “If we practice this regularly, all the great personalities in the world, both materially or spiritually speaking, all of them, they practice this. a time when they start to listen to the super soul to hear what the super soul is teaching what the message coming from the super…”

The Supersoul speaks directly within, and also arranges for others — even non-devotees, senior devotees, or dreams — to bring us his message, often warning us before trouble comes.

🎙 Maharaj at 26:55 (auto-transcript): “i have i have practical life practical experience how the super source speaks he speaks directly inside the super source took directly inside that is one way the super soul speaks and a super also super soul also will arrange that somebody else will talk with us the same…”

children.topic: The stranger at the book shop
children.note:
During a painful conflict with a temple president he had tried to advise, a stranger came to Maharaj's BBT book counter, looked at every book, then sat and described his whole worry, told him not to worry and that Krishna would protect him — and left without buying anything. Maharaj never saw him again and understood the Supersoul had sent him.

🎙 Maharaj at 27:32 (auto-transcript): “sometimes back i was having i was having a very serious challenge with my temple president the temple president i out of out of out of my own my own sweet will my own nature as as i say as a devotee considering that we should help each other which is normal so i i advise one…”

Sometimes guidance comes before an event: an instruction, a caution, a warning to stop. Before we are 'charged' for anything, we have been warned one way or another.

🎙 Maharaj at 32:51 (auto-transcript): “Sometimes, the Special Master will inform us about something before it takes place. that's a super soul doing that something is going to take place it may be instruction maybe guidance maybe caution warning yes don't continue to do like this because it's not helpful you will…”

When Maharaj was condemning himself for years as a useless devotee, a senior sannyasi called him over after prasadam at a festival and said Srimati Radharani had told him to speak to him. He narrated Maharaj's hidden thoughts, even that morning's envy of a scholarly devotee reciting poetry, and sent him to offer obeisances to Radharani and ask her help.

🎙 Maharaj at 34:02 (auto-transcript): “ago in my school i was in my school and i was feeling i was feeling really bad i'm not making advancement i'm not a good devotee i i was looking at myself and remember i was i was condemning myself seriously look what can you offer as a you call yourself a devotee but what…”

Maharaj recalls his Gurudev's book of prayers asking the Lord where he was during tragedies such as worshippers killed in a church during war in Liberia. The Supersoul's reply turns it round: I was always with you — where were you? — “i have always been with you talking to you all the time”

🎙 Maharaj at 42:08 (auto-transcript): “with you can see this is just one my dear lord where were you and the good devil is asking the lord where were you when if so many incidences he mentioned so many i just i just will just mention one or two and people in liberia one of the countries saying was africa liberia…”

He also mentions an account of Srila Prabhupada, after his departure, coming again and again to tell a devotee to leave home and take sannyasa.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:08 (auto-transcript): “speak. I also remember Shilapapad is mentioning how Shilapapad is talking to tell him to take sannyas. But then Shilapapad was not physically on the planet. He has disappeared. But he came in to tell him, hey, my friend, take sannyas. He came quiet. He came again. I see you,…”

We, our acaryas and the Supersoul share a sweet eternal relationship; as we advance it becomes more meaningful and visible before our eyes.

🎙 Maharaj at 44:44 (auto-transcript): “So this will help us to understand that we have a very sweet relationship with the super soul and our acharyas. And our acharya have the same sweet relationship with the super soul and the supreme soul. Luxury Krishna. This relationship is eternal. And as we make advancement…”

The more we advance, the more we appreciate this relationship, and faith, determination and affection all increase with it.

🎙 Maharaj at 45:23 (auto-transcript): “As we continue to make advancements, you will see it before our faces, our eyes, and we will appreciate it more. The more we make advancements, the more appreciation we have for this relationship we have. And the more our faith will increase, the more determination will…”

Have full confidence in the spiritual masters and give your life to them: take me and use me. They smile and say: you were always mine, only foolish — now by causeless mercy you have become wise.

🎙 Maharaj at 46:05 (auto-transcript): “very nice so we have everything with us we should have a confidence in our special masters and follow them very nicely we follow them should give our life to them in full confidence check i'm giving myself to take and use me yes like and in that way they will smile smile at…”

Questions from devotees on the call, from chat and from YouTube.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:17 (auto-transcript): “Guru Maharaj, you mentioned that the Supersoul is speaking to us at all times. Yes. Unfortunately, because our senses are very dull, we cannot capture the message. So the question is, What are the things that make the senses become dull, that we become, we cannot hear the…”

If the Supersoul always speaks, what makes us unable to hear? Maharaj says he will repeat the answer until we hear it.

🎙 Maharaj at 47:17 (auto-transcript): “Guru Maharaj, you mentioned that the Supersoul is speaking to us at all times. Yes. Unfortunately, because our senses are very dull, we cannot capture the message. So the question is, What are the things that make the senses become dull, that we become, we cannot hear the…”

Strong desire for sense gratification absorbs us so fully that there is no space left for the Supersoul; its noise covers our ears. That is why Srila Prabhupada repeats the warning on every page — it steals our real self-interest. That is maya: absorption in what is not.

🎙 Maharaj at 48:04 (auto-transcript): “it is our strong desire for sense gratification our we have become absorbed in trying to gratify the senses you know what what we mean the word absorbed absorbed means that we are fully we are fully merged into sense gratification that there's no time for yet the super soul…”

How can we tell guidance from the Supersoul from the voice of our own mind and conditioning?

🎙 Maharaj at 51:31 (auto-transcript): “It is said that we should be able to differentiate when the super soul is speaking and when the mind is also speaking. So, So sometimes it is due to the conditioning or sometimes due to our psychological conditioning, it becomes very, very difficult for us to be able to…”

Whenever we are about to act, voices arise. The Supersoul says: don't do this, it will put you in trouble — your spiritual master is watching. The mind says: just for today, everyone does it, God gave it to enjoy. That is contaminated intelligence justifying our weakness.

🎙 Maharaj at 53:22 (auto-transcript): “any given time we want to do something these voices will come every time the voices will come hey my friend please do not do this that is a super show the super show will say do not do this because it will put you into trouble that is super so and we don't listen to that one…”

The Supersoul tells us the hard thing; the mind tells us the easy one. As other scriptures say, the road to hell is smooth and the road to Goloka is rough. Ask the mind: has its way ever made you successful? — “the road which is leading us to hell is very smooth”

🎙 Maharaj at 56:52 (auto-transcript): “the one which is hard the mind will tell you the one which is easy i wish you know today in the bible is there in other scriptures the road leading to hell is very very smooth the road which is leading us to hell is very smooth there is no for the greater principle for the…”

children.topic: Q3 · My guru is very busy
children.note:
My guru is far away and busy; how do I keep him in mind and stay serious when he is not physically present?

🎙 Maharaj at 58:58 (auto-transcript): “and then my question is basically like uh our group is very busy and do we initiated by him but uh they are its association is not available uh in a physical so how do we think of him all the time that uh in case my consciousness that we practice as per his instruction and…”

Maharaj worries whenever he hears 'my guru is very busy'. How would a wife or children feel if told every time, I'm busy, see you next year? Intelligent people take only what they can chew — cut your coat according to your size.

🎙 Maharaj at 59:56 (auto-transcript): “Every time we hear this, we hear devotees every time i i still hear devotees say this to my guru is very busy my good mother is very busy my mother is very busy i always hear this word and i always get worried in my mind when i hear what you say this my good man is very busy…”

The relationship with the guru who gives Krishna-prema is eternal and transcendental. Nothing stops us thinking of him, praying to him, keeping his picture, hearing his lectures and following his instructions. A son has the right to approach his father. — “Our relationship is beyond the physical.”

🎙 Maharaj at 62:42 (auto-transcript): “Now, the second thing is our vision, our consciousness, our understanding about our spiritual master. The spiritual master is not just a material being that our relationship will just end with the physical body. No. Our relationship is beyond the physical. So we are thinking,…”

children.topic: Q4 · What to pray before japa
children.note:
First pray for strength and protection to chant purely and to become Krishna's pure devotee and servant. Praying for protection from danger is not wrong, but it comes second.

🎙 Maharaj at 69:34 (auto-transcript): “Next question is from Jayesh Prabhu. Hare Krishna Gurudev, please accept my humble obeysences. Thank you for the wonderful class. What should our prayers be to Krishna daily before we start our japa? Should we pray for solutions to material problems? Can you please teach us…”

children.topic: Q5 · The purer, the more indebted?
children.note:
Yes: those who are purer appreciate more, feel more indebted and become humbler. We feel little debt because we do not yet appreciate.

🎙 Maharaj at 73:10 (auto-transcript): “Next are questions from YouTube. The first question is from Ramchurran Prabhu. Hare Krishna, Dandavats Shra Gurudev. Is the relationship with brain we get directly related to our indebtedness? So those who are more pure are more indebted. Is it that way? Thanks. Can you…”

To a devotee saddened by lifetimes wasted: it is good to realise it, but do not become despondent. Use the remaining time seriously; no moment in Krishna consciousness is wasted.
